Are you looking for a role that motivates and challenges you? Are you ready for an opportunity for growth? Do you want to work on teams where people roll up their sleeves to take on tough problems together, and regularly blow the doors off our clients with their outstanding teamwork? If you answered yes to those questions, 3Cloud might just be for you!

At 3Cloud, we hire people who aren’t afraid to experiment or fail. We hire people who are willing to give direct and candid feedback to their managers, leaders, and team members. We hire people who jump at those opportunities because they care about our collective growth and success. We hire people who challenge and hold each other accountable for living 3Cloud’s core values because they know that it will result in amazing experiences and solutions for our clients and each other.

Marketing Specialist

Thishands-on roleis idealfora self-motivated, organized, and creative marketerwho enjoysturningideasinto action.Reporting to the3Cloudmarketing leader, you’llsupport the marketing teamacrosscontent, events, presentations,and marketing operationswhile gainingexposure toawidevarietyof marketing disciplines.

We’re looking forsomeone whocommunicates clearly, takes ownership, and is comfortablerolling up their sleeves tohelpothersexecute. You’ll be a great fit if you like variety, enjoy creating compelling PowerPoint presentations, and are energized by coordinating the details that make events such as tradeshows, webinars,and in-person eventsrun smoothly.

Responsibilities

You’ll support themarketing team in theplanning, coordination, execution, and measurement of marketing initiatives, including:

•Coordinate marketing projects, calendars, and requests to keep priorities organized and on track.
•Coordinate logistics for tradeshows, webinars, roundtables, and other events, including planning details, vendor support, communications, materialsshipping, tracking, and follow-up.
•Help maintain website content and support digital marketing activities across key channels.
•Create and update marketing materials, includingpolished PowerPointpresentations,LinkedInposts, blog content, collateral, and sales enablement assets.
•Organize marketing files, templates, documentation, and asset inventories so resources are easy to find and use.
•Assist with vendor coordination, invoice processing, budget tracking, and administration of Microsoft MDF and Coop Funds.
•Partner with internal teams, external vendors, and stakeholders to support smooth communication, coordination,andhands-onexecution.
•Track campaign performance, summarize results, and identify insights that can improve future marketing efforts.

Requirements

•Bachelor’s degree in marketing, communications, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
•3-5years ofB2Bmarketing experience, preferably inatechnology, SaaS,orprofessional services environment.
•Experiencewith CRM and CMS platformssuch asSalesforceandWordPress.
•Experienceusingdesign and social media tools such as Canva, LinkedIn and Sprout Social.
•Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite,especially PowerPoint, along withOffice 365, Teams, Word, Excel, and SharePoint.
•Self-motivated, highly organized,andtask-oriented, with the ability to prioritize work, manage deadlines, and follow through on details.
•Clear verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to collaborate professionally across teams, vendors, and stakeholders.
•Creative mindset with an interest in developing visually clear, engaging presentations and marketing materials.
•Interest in coordinating event logistics and managing the details that help tradeshows, webinars, roundtables, golf outings, and similar programs run smoothly.
•Curiosity, adaptability, and a growth mindset, with a willingness to learn new tools, processes, and marketing approaches.
•Ability to use approved AI tools and productivity resources responsibly to improve efficiency, solve problems, and support high-quality work.

Don’t meet every single requirement? At 3Cloud we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but yourpast experiencedoesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway.

At this time, we cannot sponsor applicants for work visas.

  • Flexible work location with a virtual first approach to work! 
  • 401(K) with match up to 50% of your 6% contributions of eligible pay 
  • Generous PTO providing a minimum of 15 days in addition to 9 paid company holidays and 2 floating personal days 
  • Two medical plan options to allow you the choice to elect what works best for you!
  • Option for vision and dental coverage 
  • 100% employer paid coverage for life and disability insurance
  • Paid leave for birth parents and non-birth parents 
  • Option for Healthcare FSA, HSA, and Dependent Care FSA
  • $67.00 monthly tech and home office allowance
  • Utilization and/or discretionary bonus eligibility based on role

3Cloud offers competitive compensation. In addition to base pay employees are eligible to receive an annual discretionary/utilization bonus. If you are hired at 3Cloud your final base salary is based on factors such as skills, education, experience and/or geographic location. Please keep in mind that the range mentioned above includes the full base salary range for the role. It is not typical for offers to be made at or near the top of the range.

Job Description:

About SEKO

SEKO started out in business in 1976, operating out of a single Chicago office. Since then, we have built a solid reputation throughout the world as an innovative and flexible provider of first-class logistics services. We provide complete Supply Chain Solutions, specializing in transportation, logistics, forwarding and warehousing. We also lead the industry with innovative and customizable IT solutions, which provide a seamless flow of information and give our growing customer base true supply chain visibility. With over 120 offices in 40 countries worldwide, our unique shareholder management model enables you to benefit from Global implementation experience and expertise across all industry sectors, coupled with vital in-country knowledge and service at the local level.

KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES INCLUDE:

  • Acquisition and retention of profitable business relationships for SEKO with quota revenues generated through transportation, logistics services, and related business situations
  • Develop and maintain “expert” knowledge of customer, competitive and marketplace information
  • Development and execution of successful account sales strategies, effectively utilizing the tools, technology, network personnel and training provided by SEKO
  • Demonstrate internal and external communication excellence through written and verbal communication, utilizing a variety of styles to address a wide range of needs and audiences
  • Defines the optimal target account, analyzing the sales arena and uses positioning strategies to define and exploit SEKO’s unique value proposition
  • Provides information to management by recapping sales activity, business opportunities, results and competitor information.
  • Maintain professional and technical knowledge by attending professional training, workshops, reviewing professional publications, establishing personal networks, and participating in professional societies.
  • Development and execution of a yearly business plan, consistent with National Sales Plan, for the assigned territory, to be submitted to the Global Sales leadership
  • Sales calls, client entertainment, travel, weekend, and evening sales activities as required for business development
  • Comply with SEKO’s C-TPAT Security Profile and uphold SEKO’s Core Values
  • Participate in the development of a safe and healthy workplace. Comply with instructions given for their own safety and health and that of others, in adhering to safe work procedures. Co-operate with management in its fulfilment of its legislative obligations.
  • Other duties as assigned by management.

REQUIREMENTS:

  • Strong working Knowledge and ability to develop and apply sales strategies at every level of a client’s organization
  • Refined probing ability to identify customers ds, potential solutions, and SEKO opportunities
  • Possess a positive “can do” attitude while generating a compelling vision for their sales regions, accepts ownership and accountability for their actions, activities, personal development, and results
  • Demonstrates effective “closing” ability that brings the sales cycle successful conclusion for SEKO
  • Strong ability to handle objections, internally and externally, professionally and successfully
  • Strong relationship management skills, including effectively developing internal and external relationships by developing rapport and creating value for clients and SEKO
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills are required
  • Strong ability to effectively handle people, tasks, and market development problems/opportunities with the right attitude and correct action plans
  • Excellent negotiating skills to gain and maintain sufficient margins for their respective sales territory
  • Strong Organizational skills (able to remain organized and effective while traveling).
  • PC literate. Intermediate proficiency in Microsoft Office, internet, web-based and job specific applications.
  • Ability to become proficient in SEKO’s technology solutions

EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE:

Minimum:

  • Bachelor's Degree in Transportation, Logistics or Supply Chain Management or equivalent work experience
  • Minimum five years sales experience required.

Preferred:

  • Minimum ten years’ industry sales experience preferred.

SPECIALIST CERTIFICATIONS:

  • N/A

Compensation and Benefits

Base salary range and benefits information for this position are being included in accordance with requirements of various state/local pay transparency legislation. Please note that base salaries may vary for different individuals in the same role based on several factors, including but not limited to location of the role, individual competencies, education/professional certifications, qualifications/experience, performance in the role and potential for revenue generation (Producer roles only).

Compensation

The base salary compensation range being offer for this role is $114,100 - $163,050 USD per year. This role is also eligible for an annual incentive bonus.

SEKO Logistics is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or veteran status.

Benefits Designed with You in Mind:
At SEKO Logistics, we are committed to supporting your well-being, professional growth, and financial stability (eligibility requirements apply). Our comprehensive benefits package includes:

  • Health and Welfare Benefits: Medical (including prescription coverage), Dental, Vision, Health Savings Account, Commuter Account (IL only), Flexible Spendings Account, Health Care and Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts, Group Accident, Group Accident, Critical Illness and hospital indemnity program, Life Insurance, AD&D, Wellbeing Program and Work/Life Resources (including Employee Assistance Program)

Job Title: Project Manager

Location: Remote – Flexible (We are open to all applicants in the EST time zone)

Type: Full-Time

About Us

We are a fast-growing online gaming operator running a regulated casino targeting the Ontario market. Our platform is built for speed, performance, and a player-first experience. We operate with a lean, entrepreneurial team and a bias toward action.

About the role

We are looking for a mid-level Project Manager to bring structure, momentum, and accountability to our project portfolio. We're a lean, fast-moving iGaming team, you'll be the person who makes sure things don't slip through the cracks as we juggle feature development, strict regulatory requirements, and a new platform launch.

You'll work closely with our Operations Lead and Technical PM, owning the tracking, communication, and urgency side of project delivery making sure everyone knows what's due, what's late, and what needs attention today.

What you'll do

  • Keep our project roadmap and initiatives current in Jira, and maintain visibility across our team's initiative channels in Slack
  • Run regular check-ins with our Technical PM and team to track deliverables, flag slipping dates, and keep feature-development projects moving without needing to chase people
  • Support tracking and coordination on our current projects, keeping timelines, action items, and stakeholders aligned.
  • Start building/updating process documentation and tracking systems for two growing functions: compliance submission deadlines/requirements, and customer support readiness helping the business get ahead of these before they scale
  • Proactively flag risks, bottlenecks, and missed deadlines before they become fires
  • Bring order to ambiguity, we're a startup, so priorities shift and processes aren't always fully built yet

What we're looking for

  • 2–5 years of experience in a Project Manager or Program Coordinator role
  • Strong proficiency with Jira and Slack (or equivalent PM/comms tooling)
  • A genuine sense of urgency and ownership, you notice when something's off track and act on it without being asked
  • Comfortable working with technical teams and translating between "engineering timeline" and "business deadline"
  • Excellent written communication, much of this role runs through async updates and documentation
  • A builder's mindset, you're energized by creating structure and process where none exists yet, not just following an existing playbook
  • iGaming or regulated-industry experience is a strong plus, not a requirement
  • Comfortable in a small, fast-paced startup environment with shifting priorities

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary.
  • Comprehensive health, dental, and vision benefits.
  • Flexible work arrangements (remote/hybrid options).
  • Professional development opportunities and training.
  • A collaborative and innovative work environment where your voice matters.

raw.description:
Join the GTM Revolution at SalesCaptain — Where B2B Growth Happens

Since our beginnings in 2021, SalesCaptain has grown into a global force, working with fast-growing B2B brands, YC & Techstars startups, and Series B/C companies, helping them go to market using a predictable process.

We're looking for a systems-obsessed GTM Engineer to own and architect our outbound revenue infrastructure across client accounts. This is a hands-on builder role, the person who sits at the intersection of data, automation, AI, and Outbound strategy, designing fully automated outbound systems that run at scale.

This is a full-time, remote role, working EU hours.

About the role

This role is perfect for someone who loves Clay, lead generation, data, research, and outbound systems.

You will work closely with our GTM Strategists and Campaign Managers to turn ICPs into clean, accurate, campaign-ready lead lists. You will build Clay workflows, enrich data, identify the right companies and contacts, and help us improve the quality and speed of our outbound campaigns.

We are not looking for someone who only scrapes random leads.

We are looking for someone who understands why a lead is relevant, how to find better data, and how to build repeatable lead generation processes.

What you’ll do ✨

You will:

  • Architect end-to-end outbound systems: from ICP definition and TAM scoping all the way to campaign launch, CRM sync, and performance reporting
  • Build advanced Clay workflows: enrichment waterfalls, AI columns, Claygent researchers, conditional logic, custom API integrations
  • Design and implement signal-based triggers: job changes, funding rounds, hiring spikes, tech installs, web intent, and more (via RB2B, Trigify, Common Room, Clearbit, etc.)
  • Build multi-channel automation workflows using n8n, Make.com, and Zapier that connect data sources, enrichment layers, sequencers, and CRM
  • Use AI (Claude, GPT-4, and prompt engineering inside Clay) to generate hyper-personalized outreach at scale
  • Write lightweight scripts (Python/JS) or work with APIs directly when no-code tools aren't enough
  • Brief Outbound Strategists on new workflows, intent signals, and targeting approaches
  • Stay ahead of the tooling curve: test and adopt emerging data, enrichment, and AI tools before clients ask for them

Requirements

Who you are ❤️‍🔥

You should have:

  • You have 2+ years of experience building outbound or revenue systems: ideally at a B2B agency, GTM consultancy, or fast-moving SaaS company
  • You're a Clay power user, you don't just know the basics, you've built complex workflows with AI columns, Claygent, waterfalls, and custom API integrations
  • You think in systems, not tasks. When you see a manual process, your first instinct is to automate it
  • You're technical without being a developer. Comfortable with APIs, webhooks, and JSON, and you can write a basic Python or JS snippet when no-code isn't enough
  • You have a commercial mindset. You understand what a good ICP looks like, why a message fails, and how outbound performance connects to pipeline
  • You're obsessed with the GTM tooling ecosystem. You follow Clay updates, test new enrichment tools before anyone asks, and have opinions on what's worth adopting
  • You have native or advanced English (C1–C2). You can communicate clearly with clients and brief strategists on complex workflows without losing them
  • You're self-directed and accountable. You can take a client brief, define the system architecture, and ship without hand-holding
  • You have experience in the Tech, SaaS, or B2B software space, you understand the buyers our clients are targeting
  • Open to candidates coming from RevOps, outbound operations, Clay consulting, or senior BDR/SDR roles who have made the shift into systems building

What good looks like

You are successful in this role if:

  • GTM Strategists trust your lists and data quality without needing to recheck everything.
  • Prospect lists are relevant, accurate, and campaign-ready.
  • Clay workflows are clean, cost-efficient, and structured
  • You can explain why a company or contact fits the ICP.
  • You suggest better sourcing methods instead of only following instructions.
  • You help the team move faster without sacrificing quality.

This role is not for you if

  • You have never used Clay before.
  • You only know basic manual LinkedIn scraping.
  • You care more about lead quantity than lead quality.
  • You need very detailed instructions for every list.
  • You are not comfortable with repetitive but detail-heavy data work.
  • You do not enjoy experimenting with new tools and workflows.

Benefits

In addition to joining a fast-growing GTM team, we also offer:

  • Remote work, no more commutes
  • Collaborative, friendly, and passionate team
  • Paid vacation, days off, and sick leave
  • Exciting team-building activities
  • Free books and Kindles to help you grow
  • Specialized training programs to become the strongest Clay and GTM expert
  • Opportunity to work with international B2B brands, startups, and scaleups
  • Exposure to modern AI, outbound, and GTM tools
  • A role where your ideas can directly affect business growth for your clients

raw.description:
About Plooto

Plooto is a Canada-born fintech company on a mission to give small and mid-sized businesses the financial power to succeed on their own terms. We make payments secure, accurate, and stress-free so businesses and their accountants can spend less time in the books, confidently manage cash flow, and make smarter decisions every day. We're a team that builds with integrity, agility, and heart, and we're looking for customer-minded pros who share our passion to join us as we scale.

About the Role

We’re hiring a Strategic Finance Lead to embed with the teams that drive our business — GTM, Product, and others as we grow — and raise the quality of decisions across the company. This is a partnering seat, not a reporting one: you’ll be in the room when a decision is being framed, not summarizing it afterward.

You’ll own the financial models for the areas you support, end to end. Because you own them, you’re in the decision rather than downstream of it. When a metric moves, your job isn’t to report that it moved — it’s to explain why, say whether that’s good or bad, and recommend what to do about it. When your business partners are weighing a decision, you’re the person quantifying the return.

You won’t inherit a playbook. You’ll write one — defining how finance partners with the business as the function grows.

The bar we’re setting

Today, a conversation about CAC often ends at “CAC went to $X because spend changed.” That’s arithmetic. We want a partner who asks the next questions: why did spend move — was it a deliberate test? What was the hypothesis, and how did it perform? How do we know our experiments are working? Is this a healthy shift or an early warning?

That’s the difference between reporting numbers and driving decisions, and it’s the heart of this role. We have good visibility into top-line trends; what we want is the ability to go a level deeper, consistently. That takes persistence — following the signal and going to find the data rather than waiting for it.

What you’ll cover

Today this role partners most closely with GTM — subscriber forecasting — and Product, where you’ll forecast TPV and revenue by product line and payment rail. As we grow, that will likely extend to Payments Strategy, Risk, and Operations.

We’ll be straight with you: we haven’t fully defined what finance support for those teams looks like yet, and we don’t expect one person to cover everything at once. Part of this job is helping us decide where finance partnership earns the most — and saying so when something should wait.

Your models serve two audiences: the teams they’re built for, and the company plan they roll into. We want models shaped to how each part of the business actually works that still connect cleanly to the central budget — so we plan from one picture instead of reconciling siloed models before a board meeting.

Build the system, not just the model

We’re not planning to solve capacity by adding people. We’d rather solve it with infrastructure: SQL pulling live from Databricks into models that refresh themselves, analysis that’s reproducible instead of rebuilt each month, and AI in the workflow where it genuinely saves time. You should be the kind of person who, faced with a manual process, gets slightly irritated and fixes it.

Much of our forecasting runs on Excel today, supported by live pipelines from our data warehouse. We know we’ll need something more scalable — and we’re deliberately open about what that is, whether a dedicated FP&A tool, a rebuild that leans harder on automation, or a different architecture altogether. You’ll help us decide and build it.

The team, and where this goes

Strategic finance is three people: the Senior Director (your manager), a Senior Financial Analyst, and you. The analyst owns the core FP&A engine — the company model, actuals, month-end performance analysis, and investor reporting. You’ll own the function-level models that feed it. You’re peers with distinct focus areas, and the expectation is that the two halves knit into one operating plan rather than running in parallel. Over time we want you cross-trained enough to cover for each other.

This is a senior individual-contributor role today, with no direct reports. We closed a funding round two months ago and are investing in growth — but we’re deliberately scaling this team through better systems and AI leverage rather than headcount. If we do add analysts, this is the person who’d oversee them. We’re not promising a management track; we’re telling you it’s a live possibility, and that the route to it is making the function work better, not bigger.

You’ll work closely with the CFO, with exposure to the CEO, and your work will feed directly into what we take to our board and investors.

What good looks like in your first year

  • The models for your areas are rebuilt on clear drivers, with sensitivities and scenarios that leadership actually uses when making a call.
  • Finance is in product and GTM decisions early enough to shape them — not brought in to forecast something already decided.
  • We can trace what specific initiatives contribute against a base case, so “did that work?” has an answer.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own driver-based financial models for the business areas you support, built around how each team actually operates.
  • Embed with those teams — challenge assumptions, frame tradeoffs, and bring a return-on-investment lens to decisions before they’re made.
  • Explain the why behind the numbers — investigate what moved a metric, judge whether it’s good or bad, and turn that into a recommendation. Help teams get closer to their own KPIs and the data behind them.
  • Connect your models to the company plan so each area rolls cleanly into the central budget.
  • Build and maintain live data pipelines — write SQL against our data warehouse (Databricks) to keep models refreshing on live data rather than manual pulls.
  • Help modernize our planning infrastructure with the Senior Director — tooling, automation, or architecture.
  • Distill complex analysis into crisp stories for executive and board audiences.
  • Partner with the Senior Financial Analyst to keep forecasting, budgeting, and reporting coherent as Plooto scales.

Qualifications

  • 7+ years in strategic finance, FP&A, or business analytics — ideally in fintech, SaaS or another recurring-revenue business.
  • Payments or transaction economics — take rate, transaction mix across rails, cost per transaction, and how volume converts to revenue. This is core to how Plooto makes money, and you’ll be modeling it.
  • SaaS metrics in practice — ARR, MRR, churn, CAC, payback, LTV — and the judgment to know when a movement matters.
  • Hands-on SQL against a warehouse (Databricks or similar) wired into Excel, building live-refresh workflows rather than static exports.
  • Advanced Excel and driver-based modeling, with the ability to rebuild as the business and your understanding change.
  • Comfort reasoning about cause, not just correlation — you can tell a deliberate test from a drift, ask what the hypothesis was, and judge whether a result is real.
  • Exceptional communication — you can make a complex analysis simple and persuasive for technical and non-technical audiences, and hold your own with business leaders.
  • A partnering instinct, and the judgment to prioritize. With fluid scope and a lot of inbound, you’ll need to decide what earns your time and say no clearly.
  • Using AI tools to automate analytical workflows and work faster.
  • Experience helping select or implement FP&A planning tooling.

Why Become a Plootonian?

If you're looking to make a meaningful impact, look no further. We're transforming the payments space in North America by delivering an unrivalled product experience to solve a real and pressing problem for SMBs.

The biggest reason small businesses fail is poor financial management and cash flow — and Plooto fixes that. We have strong product-market fit, a massive opportunity ahead, and the backing of experienced fintech leaders.

You'll join a team that cares deeply about customer impact, takes pride in our craft, and moves with urgency. We're just getting started — and you'll help shape the next chapter of our growth story.

Join Plooto and be part of a mission that matters.

Our Commitment to Inclusion

Plooto is committed to building an inclusive workplace where people of all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives can thrive. We know great teams are built through diverse thinking, and we encourage you to apply even if your experience does not align perfectly with every qualification listed.

Accommodation is available throughout the recruitment process in accordance with applicable accessibility legislation. If you require accommodation at any stage, please let us know—we’re happy to work with you.

This posting is for one available position. Compensation will be determined based on the successful candidate’s knowledge, skills, experience, and overall alignment with the role.

Description

TripleTen is an EdTech company that designs and runs tech career learning programs for the US and Latin American markets. We've been doing it for over five years, teaching complete beginners — people with no prior tech background — through cohort-based programs built on our own platform and curriculum, developed in partnership with Nebius AI. Our team is fully remote and globally distributed, and we serve a large, active student base across both regions.

We are looking for Onboarding Sales Trainer to join our Sales Training team and own the onboarding and development of new sales hires working with the US market.

This is a hands-on role for a sales professional with leadership, coaching, or training experience who will lead two-week onboarding programs for new hires, develop practical sales skills, and maintain training materials. The role is fully remote, supports our LATAM-based sales team serving the US market, and requires native-level Spanish, fluent English.

What you will do

As one of the leading German HealthTech companies, we are reshaping discharge management – technology-driven, patient-centered, and free from bureaucracy. In addition to our market-leading SaaS platform, we develop AI solutions that radically simplify processes in hospitals and for aftercare providers, relieve healthcare professionals, and refocus attention on patients. Today, we already connect two-thirds of all German hospitals with over 650 rehabilitation clinics and 25,000 nursing and homecare providers. With currently around 100 employees, we continue to grow – and we are looking for people with character who want to help us improve the healthcare system and solve administrative complexity across care journeys in Europe.

Our AI portfolio spans model development through to production inference at scale, in a highly regulated healthcare context. This role exists to make sure that infrastructure runs reliably, scales predictably, and gets AI engineers' work safely into production.

What to expect

This is what you can expect from us as a Senior Forward Deployed Platform Engineer:

  • Purposeful work – your work keeps our AI portfolio reliable and performant for hospitals and aftercare providers who depend on it daily.

  • Company culture – we believe in flat hierarchies that promote high performance and strong team dynamics. We foster an environment characterized by mutual respect, loyalty, and recognition. Together, we strive for our goals – and expect the same from you.

  • Flexibility – want to pick up your child from daycare? Like to exercise during lunch? We'll support you. We are a remote-friendly company offering flexible working hours. Workations are also possible by arrangement.

  • Edenred card – which you can use according to your needs.

  • Extra vacation day – so you can celebrate your birthday with your loved ones, you'll have the day off.

This is how you will make an impact as a Senior Forward Deployed Platform Engineer:

  • Our AI portfolio needs to run reliably and perform well. Thus it has to be properly monitored.

  • Capacity needs planning, support scaling initiatives, and ensure our systems remain stable as the company grows.

  • SageMaker models need to be continuously delivered, following AWS' best practices.

  • AI engineers need assistance with productionalizing AI workloads end-to-end, from code to container build, and rollouts using optimal deployment strategies.

How we build

We run a modern cloud-native stack to build, ship, and operate AI workloads reliably in a regulated healthcare environment.

  • Cloud: AWS (The European Sovereign Cloud partition)

  • Runtime: Kubernetes and Postgres

  • Inference: Bedrock, SageMaker, ClearML

  • Observability: Datadog, LangFuse, OTEL

  • CI/CD: GitHub Enterprise Cloud with Actions

  • Plus various auxiliary tools for security, compliance and operations: DockerHub, Google as IdP, SonarCloud, VPNs, QuickSight, CDN, Snowflake, ETLs, etc.

Requirements

Requirements

Here's how we picture you as our Senior Forward Deployed Platform Engineer:

These are the knowledge and skills you need:

  • Experience with AWS (CloudFormation, IAM, ECR, SageMaker, Bedrock, S3, SQS, DynamoDB, RDS, KMS).

  • Experience with Kubernetes (EKS) in production (kustomize, HPA and KEDA based autoscaling).

  • Experience deploying SageMaker models, setting up custom inference containers (HuggingFace and/or OSS model) and endpoints (provisioning, autoscaling, and blue/green rollouts).

  • Familiarity with observability & LLMOps best practices and solutions (Datadog, Langfuse, LLM/GenAI tracing, OTel, CloudWatch).

  • Proficiency in Python, specifically with FastAPI and async task management.

  • Knowing how to set up ML/LLM GPU inference on EKS (GPU-backed instances, Nvidia driver/plugin).

  • Ability to own technical decisions and collaborate directly with other teams.

  • Troubleshooting, RCA, and resolving problems. When things get stressful, you stay cool headed and work through issues step by step, asking for support from SMEs when needed.

  • Preference for writing over talking, resulting in clear, concise, yet complete documentation and asynchronous communications.

  • This is a cross-functional role bridging the gap between applications and the platform. Ability to both explain complex concepts clearly to non-domain experts, and extract information through well-formed questions during verbal communication, is a must.

Bonus points:

  • Healthcare or regulated-domain experience (e.g. ISO 27001, C5).

  • Self-hosting/home lab.

  • Nvidia Triton/vLLM or similar.

  • MLflow, Kubeflow, ClearML, DVC, Vertex AI.

  • Slack and GitHub automations (bots, workflows, apps, etc.).

This will help you decide if you want to join us – our values are:

  • Strong opinions, weakly held. We adapt, negotiate trade-offs, and reconsider decisions when necessary. We don't stick to one implementation – we re-evaluate and adjust as needed (including throwing away the old one).

  • Pragmatic choice of tools and avoidance of one-size-fits-all thinking.

  • Bringing professionalism and empathy to how you work with others.

  • Strong belief in solid technical fundamentals and preference for understanding and first principles over memorization.

  • Language proficiency (at least English, but the more, the better).

  • Technical Aptitude: A solid background in navigating complex SaaS environments and a natural ability to master intricate technical use cases.
  • Strategic Problem-Solving: The ability to analyze customer configurations and workflows to provide optimal, scalable solutions.
  • Expert Communication & Training: Exceptional presentation skills with a talent for translating dense technical concepts into simple, actionable guidance for both clients and internal teams.

  • Proactive Drive: High level of initiative to identify adoption gaps, improve customer setup, and collect meaningful product feedback.
  • Analytical Thinking: The ability to identify trends across account cohorts and use data to track evolving product needs.
  • Adaptability & Evolution: A proven ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment and a proactive embrace of change—whether adopting new internal tools, evolving systems, or leveraging developing automations to improve efficiency.
  • (Bonus) Market Knowledge: Familiarity with the short-term rental market, the OTA landscape (Airbnb, Vrbo, etc.), and the property management software ecosystem.

  • Deep hands-on experience with trust accounting, property management accounting, or financial SaaS platforms.

raw.title: Product Owner
raw.excerpt: Bits In Glass (BIG) is a high-growth AI and automation consulting firm with offices across Canada, the United States, India, and the United Kingdom.
raw.description:
Bits In Glass (BIG) is a high-growth AI and automation consulting firm with offices across Canada, the United States, India, and the United Kingdom. Our portfolio spans more than 10 leading technologies across AI, cloud, data, automation, and business applications.

Recognized globally as a Great Place to Work and the recipient of multiple partner excellence awards, BIG is built on collaboration, innovation, and delivering measurable business outcomes for enterprise clients. We are a team of experienced technology professionals who enjoy solving complex challenges, celebrating wins together, and helping customers modernize with confidence.

AN EXCITING OPPORTUNITY WITH BIG AND CONVENE AI

BIG is excited to be partnering with Convene AI, an AI-focused technology company developing innovative solutions that leverage artificial intelligence to solve real-world business challenges.

As part of this partnership, we are looking for talented professionals to join BIG and work directly on Convene AI projects and initiatives. You will initially be hired as an employee of Bits In Glass, while working closely with the Convene AI team and contributing to the development and growth of their AI solutions.

The role is expected to remain on BIG’s payroll for approximately 12–18 months, with the intention of transitioning to a permanent position directly with Convene AI following this period, subject to business requirements and transition arrangements.This is an exciting opportunity to contribute to an emerging AI organization at an important stage of its growth, while benefiting from the support, culture, and established consulting expertise of Bits In Glass.

ABOUT THE ROLE

You are the tip of the spear. You own the client relationship, the scope, and the definition of done. You decide what gets built, what does not, and when to tell a client no. This is not an internal product management role and it is not a program management role. You will be embedded with an enterprise client, running discovery, converting messy business problems into AI requirements a pod can build against, and holding a weekly release cadence together while stakeholders change their minds. Because our contracts are fixed-fee and outcome-based, your scope discipline is directly connected to whether the engagement is profitable. That is real commercial responsibility and we will treat you

accordingly.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Run discovery: map the current process, quantify where the pain and the money are, and identify where an agent creates measurable value rather than novelty.
    • Convert business problems into AI requirements with acceptance criteria that can actually be tested, working with the AI Quality Engineer to make them measurable before build starts.
    • Own the outcome definition on outcome-based contracts: what "working"means, how it is measured, who signs off, and what happens if the threshold is missed.
    • Manage the client-provided domain expert: secure their time in writing up front, and escalate immediately when their availability slips. Weak domain SME support is the single most common cause of slipped go-lives in this model, and catching it early is your job.
    • Manage scope ruthlessly. Weekly releases only work if the backlog is disciplined and someone is willing to be unpopular.
    • Run the weekly cadence: demo to the client, capture feedback, re-prioritise, and keep the pod pointed at the highest value work.
  • Own stakeholder alignment across business, IT, security, procurement, and legal, and get security and procurement engaged in week one rather than week nine.
    • Partner with the client's change and adoption team so the system gets used, not just delivered.
    • Track and report delivery health: burn, risk register, decision log, and benefits realisation against the agreed outcome.
    • Surface commercial risk early. Scope creep, weak executive sponsorship, and integration surprises are margin erosion, and you are the early warning system.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

  • 3–8 years in product ownership, delivery management, or client-facing consulting, including at least 2 years shipping software rather than only running programmes.
    • A track record delivering under fixed-price or outcome-based commercial terms, where scope discipline had financial consequences.
    • Fluency in agile delivery at a genuine weekly release cadence, not two-week ceremony.
    • Enough technical literacy to challenge an engineer's estimate and to understand why a retrieval pipeline is returning poor answers. You do not need to write code.
    • A working understanding of what LLM-based systems can and cannot reliably do, and the confidence to tell a client when their request is not feasible.
    • Executive presence. You will hold steering committees with client CIOs, COOs, and business unit heads.
    • Experience in at least one of insurance, financial services, healthcare, or a comparably regulated industry.
    • Excellent written communication. Ambiguity that survives your documentation becomes a defect later.
    • Legally entitled to work in Canada and willing to travel to client sites.

BONUS POINTS

  • Prior experience at a top-tier strategy consultancy, Big Four, or a specialist delivery boutique.
    • A background as a business analyst, engineer, or data professional before moving into product.
    • Familiarity with AI quality concepts: evaluation design, acceptance thresholds, and human-in-the-loop workflow design.
    • Experience running engagements alongside a separate change management partner.

• Bilingual English and French.

WHY JOIN CONVENEAI

  • You will own client outcomes, not status reports.
    • Four-person pods mean your decisions translate into shipped software within days.
    • Outcome-based commercial terms mean the work is judged on whether it created value, which is a more interesting standard to be held to.
    • You will work directly with senior operators who have led AI delivery at Fortune 500 scale.
    • Real influence over how ConveneAI's delivery model evolves as we scale from the first pods to many.

raw.title: Industrial Design to UX Design Career Changer
raw.excerpt: About the Program:Every year, we sponsor 2 remote UX apprentices from anywhere in the world to join us for 7 months, either in the fall or spring seasons or online.
raw.description:
About the Program:

Every year, we sponsor 2 remote UX apprentices from anywhere in the world to join us for 7 months, either in the fall or spring seasons or online. Our UX apprentices work through the end-to-end UX design and UX research process for a startup idea of their choice that will help them attract hiring managers in that topic space or industry.
Apprentices take our program for free and receive 1:1 mentorship throughout the 7-month program. Alumni UX apprentices go on to make between $85,000 -$130,000 in UX design, product design, UX research, or service design roles after they complete the program.
We are committed to helping women, immigrants, POC, and LGBTQ folks break into tech and land 6-figure UX jobs. We help you land 6-figure UX jobs or coach you till you get it.

Apprenticeship Requirements:

This apprenticeship program is open to new grads and UX career changers alike! Here are some apprenticeship requirements to keep in mind before applying:
Interested in creative tech career paths in UX research, UX design, product design or service design
Willing to commit 5-10 hours of work per week to complete program deliverables
Willing to attend 2-3 hour weekend lectures to learn the end-to-end design process OR willing to complete online video course modules
Open to feedback from UX mentors and demonstrates a willingness to revise design work

Apprenticeship Program Learnings:

Build digital products and services 0-1
Lead end-to-end design process for a startup idea or topic of your choice
Lead product scoping and feature scoping, as well as entire project management
Identify target market for product and position product for launch success
Develop a business model for the product or service and demonstrate how the product/service will scale as the business model scales
Lead discovery research by managing user recruitment, creating research plans, writing interview guides, leading 8-16 discovery interviews, and synthesizing interview insights
Deliver a compelling UX design and business pitch for your startup idea, showcasing both qualitative and quantitative data to justify the problem space and the solution
Tell a compelling story about users by showcasing user types, personas, stakeholder maps, journey maps, process maps, service blueprints, ideation matrixes, sketches, wireframes, UX workflows, prototypes and other visual deliverables
Lead user testing of wireframes and prototypes to improve product/service usability and constantly iterate on your startup idea
Design a unique design system for your solution from scratch, creating components, a style guide, and branding for your solution
Analyze direct and indirect competitors to clearly articulate your solution’s differentiators and why your solution is innovative and more likely to succeed over competing options
Consult with startups to create a scope of work and fulfill UX research, UX design, product design and service design work based on your scope of work.

How to Apply:

The application takes a few minutes to complete and will ask you to send in your resume. You do NOT need to have a UX resume or portfolio to apply- we consider folks who are at the very beginning of their career change, who are still exploring multiple career options.
You will receive UX tips and challenges via email to help you with your transition into UX and will be contacted by us if you are being considered for the apprentice program. Once contacted, you will go through a brief interview process before joining the cohort. Due to the large volume of applicants, we cannot contact all applicants about their application status. If you don’t hear from us about an interview within 2 months of applying, please consider your application closed. We consider applicants on a rolling basis.

raw.description:
About the role

We’re building a robust, internet-facing API that runs both in on-premises and in the cloud, designed to support future innovation at scale. This means solving complex distributed systems challenges, ensuring high availability, and optimizing performance. Concepts like the CAP theorem aren’t just theory here—they’re part of our daily engineering conversations.

Our stack includes Java, Vert.x, RxJava, Groovy, Couchbase, and Kafka, running on Azure with a fully automated CI/CD pipeline. We follow Agile principles, adapting Kanban and other methodologies to fit the team’s needs. Collaboration is at the heart of our culture—pair programming is common, and all code is reviewed via GitHub.

You will be responsible for:

  • Design and implement end-to-end systems using your deep JVM and java ecosystem expertise. Translate product requirements into well-structured, maintainable code.
    Write test-driven features and follow the TDD and BDD cycle.
  • Apply SOLID principles and cohesive design to build scalable software.
    Collaborate with product stakeholders to shape and refine features.
  • Support production systems, resolve incidents, and conduct root cause analysis.
  • Mentor and support fellow engineers, fostering a culture of continuous learning.
  • Share knowledge across the wider engineering community.
  • Prototype and evaluate new tools and technologies.

You will need:

  • Strong experience with Java 8+.
  • Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, etc.).
  • Proficiency with both SQL and NoSQL databases.
  • Proven ability to scale systems effectively.
  • Familiarity with Agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban, Waterfall).
  • Exposure to reactive programming paradigms.
  • Bonus: Experience with eCommerce or search systems.

Location:

  • Spain and UK.

Some of the benefits you’ll enjoy working with us:

  • The chance to join an organization with triple-digit growth that is changing the paradigm on how software products are built.
  • The opportunity to form part of an amazing, multicultural community of tech experts.
  • A highly competitive compensation package.
  • Medical insurance.

Come and join our #ParserCommunity.

Follow us on Linkedin

raw.description:
Job Title: Marketing & Lead Generation

Location: South Africa

Job Type: Part-Time, Remote

Working Hours: US Hours 4 hours a day between 9:00AM - 5:00pm EST

Salary: South African Rand (ZAR)

We are seeking a creative, hands-on, and commercially minded Marketing Specialist to support the marketing and growth of a service-based business.

The successful candidate will be responsible for creating professional marketing materials, developing engaging LinkedIn content, designing brochures and other visual assets, and supporting email marketing campaigns and follow-up communications.

This role requires someone who can work independently, take a brief or idea and turn it into a polished marketing concept, and produce high-quality work suitable for a professional U.S. business audience.

Experience marketing services is essential. Previous experience within logistics, freight, transportation, or B2B services would be highly advantageous.

Key Responsibilities

  • Create professional, high-quality marketing materials, including brochures, presentations, service sheets, and other promotional assets.
  • Design polished visual content suitable for a professional U.S. business audience.
  • Create engaging and relevant content for LinkedIn.
  • Develop LinkedIn content targeted at decision-makers and business professionals, including:
    • Logistics Managers
    • Shipping Managers
    • Transportation Managers
    • Operations Leaders
    • Transportation and Logistics Executives
  • Support the development and execution of marketing campaigns.
  • Create and manage email marketing campaigns and follow-up communications.
  • Use Zoho or a comparable CRM/email marketing platform to manage mass email campaigns.
  • Assist with audience targeting, campaign messaging, and follow-up communications.
  • Translate marketing briefs and business requirements into clear and professional visual concepts.
  • Ensure all marketing materials are accurate, professional, and aligned with the company's brand and services.
  • Work independently and manage multiple marketing projects simultaneously.
  • Learn and adapt to new CRM and marketing systems quickly.
  • Identify opportunities to improve marketing content, campaigns, and communication.

Requirements

Proven experience working in a Marketing, Content Marketing, Digital Marketing, or Marketing Specialist role.

A strong portfolio demonstrating professional marketing and design work.

Proven experience creating:

  • Professional brochures
  • LinkedIn content
  • Email marketing campaigns
  • Service-based marketing materials
  • Professional visual marketing assets

Strong hands-on design skills with the ability to create polished, high-quality visuals.

Experience marketing services, rather than exclusively physical products.

Experience with LinkedIn marketing and B2B content creation.

Ability to create content targeted at senior decision-makers and business professionals.

Experience using Zoho or a comparable CRM and email marketing platform.

Experience managing mass email campaigns and follow-up communications.

Ability to learn and adapt to new CRM systems quickly.

Strong written and verbal English communication skills.

Excellent attention to detail and ability to produce accurate work.

Ability to work independently without requiring repeated direction.

Thinking of applying? Here's the inside scoop.

Let us walk you through the next steps.

Step 1 – Complete Your Application

Fill in our application form and upload your CV. This stores your profile in our Applicant Tracking System (ATS) and places you into our active job pipelines, making it easier for us to match you with current and future opportunities.

Step 2 – The First Look (One-Way Video Interview)

This is where your application comes to life. We review your CV and video interview to get a feel for your experience, communication style, and overall fit. If we like what we see, you're on to the next step!

Why do we ask for a video?

Because a résumé can tell us what you've done, but it can't show us you. Your video is your moment to shine, and it helps us see:

  • How you communicate and connect with people.
  • How you present yourself professionally.
  • Other opportunities you might be an even better fit for (bonus surprises!).

Think of it as your personal trailer. One great video means we can pitch you for multiple roles and get you in front of the right employers, faster.

Heads up: Some clients watch your video directly, so make it one you'd be proud to have represent you. This is your highlight reel—make it count!

Step 3 – Let's Actually Talk

A Recruitment Specialist calls to chat about your experience, your availability, what you want to earn, and the role itself. Consider it a friendly vibe check.

Step 4 – The Fine Print, Made Fun

We break down what it's like working as an independent contractor—hours, pay, contract terms, the whole deal. No surprises, no fine-print sneakiness. You'll get it all in writing.

Step 5 – Matchmaking Time

Our Talent Delivery Team plays cupid, matching you to clients where you're most likely to shine. We can't promise everyone gets picked, but we're rooting for you.

Step 6 – Showtime

Got shortlisted? We'll set up your interview, prep you like a pro, and have your back the whole way—with a Reworks teammate right there facilitating.

Step 7 – The Verdict

We chase feedback the second it lands and keep you in the loop.

Fraud Disclaimer: ReWorks Solutions will never request payment during recruitment or require in-person office visits. All official communication will come from a ReWorks Solutions email address. Please verify any suspicious messages with our team directly.

raw.description:
Cloud Infrastructure Network Engineer – Remote

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.
This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: Cloud Infrastructure Network Engineer
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $100,000–$115,000 Annually
Experience Required: 6+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary
We are seeking a Cloud Infrastructure Network Engineer to design, deploy, and operate cloud networking infrastructure across one or more major cloud providers. The role covers VPC/VNet design, hybrid connectivity, transit topologies, edge networking, DNS, and the security controls that make cloud networking reliable and safe at scale. The ideal candidate combines deep traditional networking knowledge with cloud-native networking patterns, has built production cloud networks at meaningful scale, and brings strong automation discipline to networking work. In this role you will work closely with cross-functional partners — product, design, engineering, operations, and business stakeholders — to translate ambiguous requirements into well-engineered solutions, and will be expected to raise the bar through code review, design review, and mentorship of more junior engineers. The successful candidate brings strong engineering discipline, a clear communication style, and a track record of shipping meaningful work that holds up well in production.

Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Networking, or a related field.
  • Five or more years of experience in networking, with significant time on cloud networking.
  • Deep hands-on experience with networking on at least one major cloud provider.
  • Strong understanding of routing, switching, BGP, and modern networking fundamentals.
  • Hands-on experience with hybrid connectivity (Direct Connect, ExpressRoute, or equivalents).
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code for cloud networking, especially Terraform.
  • Strong understanding of cloud security and network controls.
  • Familiarity with Kubernetes networking and service mesh fundamentals.
  • Strong troubleshooting and packet-level analysis skills.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Cloud networking specialty certifications (AWS Advanced Networking, Azure Network Engineer).
  • Experience with multi-cloud networking and cloud-to-cloud connectivity.
  • Familiarity with SD-WAN platforms and SASE architectures.
  • Experience with eBPF-based networking tools.
  • Exposure to regulated industries with strict network segmentation requirements.
How to Apply
Would you like to know more about this opportunity? For immediate consideration, please send your resume to
Vision Technologies is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) Statement

Bright Vision Technologies (BV Teck) is committed to equal employment opportunity (EEO) for all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, genetic information, disability, veteran status, or any other protected status as defined by applicable federal, state, or local laws. This commitment extends to all aspects of employment, including recruitment, hiring, training, compensation, promotion, transfer, leaves of absence, termination, layoffs, and recall.

BV Teck expressly prohibits any form of workplace harassment or discrimination. Any improper interference with employees' ability to perform their job duties may result in disciplinary action up to and including termination of employment.

Lead end-to-end design process for a startup idea or topic of your choice
Lead product scoping and feature scoping, as well as entire project management
Identify target market for product and position product for launch success
Develop a business model for the product or service and demonstrate how the product/service will scale as the business model scales
Lead discovery research by managing user recruitment, creating research plans, writing interview guides, leading 8-16 discovery interviews, and synthesizing interview insights
Deliver a compelling UX design and business pitch for your startup idea, showcasing both qualitative and quantitative data to justify the problem space and the solution
Tell a compelling story about users by showcasing user types, personas, stakeholder maps, journey maps, process maps, service blueprints, ideation matrixes, sketches, wireframes, UX workflows, prototypes and other visual deliverables
Lead user testing of wireframes and prototypes to improve product/service usability and constantly iterate on your startup idea
Design a unique design system for your solution from scratch, creating components, a style guide, and branding for your solution
Analyze direct and indirect competitors to clearly articulate your solution’s differentiators and why your solution is innovative and more likely to succeed over competing options
Consult with startups to create a scope of work and fulfill UX research, UX design, product design and service design work based on your scope of work.

How to Apply:

The application takes a few minutes to complete and will ask you to send in your resume. You do NOT need to have a UX resume or portfolio to apply- we consider folks who are at the very beginning of their career change, who are still exploring multiple career options.
You will receive UX tips and challenges via email to help you with your transition into UX and will be contacted by us if you are being considered for the apprentice program. Once contacted, you will go through a brief interview process before joining the cohort. Due to the large volume of applicants, we cannot contact all applicants about their application status. If you don’t hear from us about an interview within 2 months of applying, please consider your application closed. We consider applicants on a rolling basis.

The successful candidate will be responsible for creating professional marketing materials, developing engaging LinkedIn content, designing brochures and other visual assets, and supporting email marketing campaigns and follow-up communications.

This role requires someone who can work independently, take a brief or idea and turn it into a polished marketing concept, and produce high-quality work suitable for a professional U.S. business audience.

    • Transportation and Logistics Executives
  • Support the development and execution of marketing campaigns.
  • Create and manage email marketing campaigns and follow-up communications.
  • Use Zoho or a comparable CRM/email marketing platform to manage mass email campaigns.
  • Assist with audience targeting, campaign messaging, and follow-up communications.
  • Translate marketing briefs and business requirements into clear and professional visual concepts.
  • Ensure all marketing materials are accurate, professional, and aligned with the company's brand and services.
  • Work independently and manage multiple marketing projects simultaneously.
  • Learn and adapt to new CRM and marketing systems quickly.
  • Identify opportunities to improve marketing content, campaigns, and communication.

Requirements

Proven experience working in a Marketing, Content Marketing, Digital Marketing, or Marketing Specialist role.

A strong portfolio demonstrating professional marketing and design work.

Proven experience creating:

  • Professional brochures
  • LinkedIn content
  • Email marketing campaigns
  • Service-based marketing materials
  • Professional visual marketing assets

Strong hands-on design skills with the ability to create polished, high-quality visuals.

Experience marketing services, rather than exclusively physical products.

Experience with LinkedIn marketing and B2B content creation.

Ability to create content targeted at senior decision-makers and business professionals.

Experience using Zoho or a comparable CRM and email marketing platform.

Experience managing mass email campaigns and follow-up communications.

Ability to learn and adapt to new CRM systems quickly.

Strong written and verbal English communication skills.

Excellent attention to detail and ability to produce accurate work.

Ability to work independently without requiring repeated direction.

Thinking of applying? Here's the inside scoop.

Let us walk you through the next steps.

Step 1 – Complete Your Application

Fill in our application form and upload your CV. This stores your profile in our Applicant Tracking System (ATS) and places you into our active job pipelines, making it easier for us to match you with current and future opportunities.

Step 2 – The First Look (One-Way Video Interview)

This is where your application comes to life. We review your CV and video interview to get a feel for your experience, communication style, and overall fit. If we like what we see, you're on to the next step!

Why do we ask for a video?

Because a résumé can tell us what you've done, but it can't show us you. Your video is your moment to shine, and it helps us see:

  • How you communicate and connect with people.
  • How you present yourself professionally.
  • Other opportunities you might be an even better fit for (bonus surprises!).

Think of it as your personal trailer. One great video means we can pitch you for multiple roles and get you in front of the right employers, faster.

Heads up: Some clients watch your video directly, so make it one you'd be proud to have represent you. This is your highlight reel—make it count!

Step 3 – Let's Actually Talk

A Recruitment Specialist calls to chat about your experience, your availability, what you want to earn, and the role itself. Consider it a friendly vibe check.

Step 4 – The Fine Print, Made Fun

We break down what it's like working as an independent contractor—hours, pay, contract terms, the whole deal. No surprises, no fine-print sneakiness. You'll get it all in writing.

Step 5 – Matchmaking Time

Our Talent Delivery Team plays cupid, matching you to clients where you're most likely to shine. We can't promise everyone gets picked, but we're rooting for you.

Step 6 – Showtime

Got shortlisted? We'll set up your interview, prep you like a pro, and have your back the whole way—with a Reworks teammate right there facilitating.

Step 7 – The Verdict

We chase feedback the second it lands and keep you in the loop.

Fraud Disclaimer: ReWorks Solutions will never request payment during recruitment or require in-person office visits. All official communication will come from a ReWorks Solutions email address. Please verify any suspicious messages with our team directly.

Your Purpose

At Bitso, the Senior Mobile Software Engineer on the Registration Squad owns the identity verification and onboarding experience across iOS and React Native, the entry point for every user who joins Bitso. You will design and deliver reliable, high-quality mobile flows that connect users to KYC providers, guide them through identity verification, and ensure compliance across multiple markets (MX, BR, CO, AR, GI, US).

Working closely with product, backend, and compliance stakeholders, you will shape the technical direction of a domain where quality, security, and user experience are non-negotiable, and where your work directly determines whether a user can access financial services.

Reports To
This role reports to the Registration Engineering Manager.

Who You Are

  • You are experienced in React Native development, with a proven track record of shipping production mobile apps at scale across iOS and RN, with a strong depth in iOS native development.
  • You have hands-on experience integrating third-party SDKs, including identity verification or biometric providers, and understand the constraints and tradeoffs of mobile SDK integration in regulated environments.
  • You have designed and maintained mobile architectures that are testable, maintainable, and resilient to the rapid iteration cycles of a fintech product.
  • You are comfortable working across the mobile/backend boundary, understanding REST APIs, async flows, and how mobile state interacts with backend systems.
  • You communicate complex technical decisions clearly in English, written and spoken, to engineering peers, product managers, and senior leadership.
  • You work with a high degree of autonomy and ownership. You identify problems, propose solutions, and see them through to production.
  • You have a strong sense of urgency and are comfortable operating in a fast-paced, high-stakes fintech environment where compliance and user trust are on the line.
  • Nice to have: familiarity with KYC/AML flows, identity verification providers (Incode, Jumio, IDWall, or similar), or onboarding funnels in regulated financial products.

What You Will Do

  • Own KYC and onboarding mobile flows: design, build, and maintain the screens, navigation, and SDK integrations that take a user from signup through identity verification and level upgrade.
  • Drive React Native architecture decisions: define patterns, set standards, and ensure consistency across the mobile surfaces owned by the Registration Squad.
  • Integrate and maintain identity provider SDKs: own the technical relationship with providers like Incode and Jumio at the mobile layer, including version upgrades, migration work, and incident response.
  • Deliver high-quality code: write clean, well-tested React Native and iOS code and champion engineering best practices through code reviews.
  • Ensure mobile reliability: proactively monitor, debug, and resolve production issues with a focus on root-cause analysis and lasting fixes.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally: partner with Product, Compliance, and backend engineers to translate regulatory requirements and user needs into sound mobile solutions.
  • Mentor and uplift: share knowledge with fellow engineers, contribute to technical discussions, and raise the bar for mobile craft within the squad.

Research in Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion suggests that individuals may hesitate to apply for jobs if they do not meet all the listed criteria. At Bitso, we value diversity and your unique strengths could be just what we're looking for. If this role excites you but you don't match every point in the description, we still want to hear from you.

JOB TITLE: Senior Organizer

GRADE: UUR III; Annual Salary is $95,779.60

LOCATION: All USA

ORGANIZATIONAL OVERVIEW: We are the Service Employees International Union (SEIU), a union of about 2 million diverse members in healthcare, the public sector, and property services. We believe in and fight for our Vision for a Just Society: where all workers are valued and all people respected—no matter where we come from or what color we are; where all families and communities can thrive; and where we leave a better and more equitable world for generations to come. We are an anti-racist union determined to check corporate power and uproot structural racism through unions—worker power and collective action—and government—legislative and political action. We fight for Unions for All and a Government that Works for All so that all of us, across race and place, can have power together in unions and participate fully in our democracy.

PURPOSE: To represent and assist the International Union in organizing; to take responsibility for major campaigns and to act in a leadership role with respect to program and other staff; to perform advanced training for organizers, staff, and worker leaders of SEIU; and to design and implement organizing goals of SEIU.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES: Performs a wide range of duties as assigned by the International Union, including but not limited to the following:

  • Designs and manages large organizing campaigns or multiple smaller campaigns including organizing, comprehensive campaigns, strikes, and political action. Works with field, industry division, and local staff to coordinate all aspects of the campaign including vision, strategy, timeline, communication, community outreach, and politics.
  • Develops and implements division, regional, or political programs.
  • Coordinates and directs organizing staff including scheduling, assigning turf, debriefing, and training.
  • Develops and implements training for staff and worker leaders on the campaign to further develop skills and understanding of the campaign.
  • Provides feedback to staff on their performance while on the campaign. Provides information on staff performance to the campaign director.
  • Assists local unions in the development of an organizing program.
  • Oversees management of the campaign database, list, and cards.
  • Develops and monitors the campaign budget for the campaign.
  • Directs major negotiations tied to organizing campaigns.
  • Coordinates affiliations and mergers campaigns.
  • Performs other duties as required to assist the International Union.
  • Must be available for frequent travel with overnight stays required. Long and irregular hours.

DIRECTION & DECISION MAKING

  • Must be able to act and organize time with extreme independence.
  • A high level of judgment, ability to take initiative and work independently; must be able to work with elected leaders, worker leaders, and staff in complex and sometimes political situations.
  • Must be able to handle multiple “priority” projects simultaneously and meet established deadlines.

EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE

  • Bachelor’s Degree is preferred.

PREVIOUS WORK EXPERIENCE

  • Three to five years of work in external labor union organizing.
  • Demonstrated experience in developing and leading organizing campaigns.
  • Previous experience with the labor movement or other advocacy organizations preferred.

SPECIALIZED KNOWLEDGE AND TRAINING

  • Excellent writing, verbal, and analytical communication skills.
  • Thorough knowledge of organizing and political campaign strategies.
  • Ability to develop and train staff and worker leaders in the skills needed for the campaign.
  • Knowledge of organizing campaign data base management tools such as Organizer Toolbox or other similar applications. Skill in the use of Microsoft Office programs.
  • Ability to write and proofread campaign communications materials.

PROBATIONARY PERIOD: Twelve Months

Job title: Payroll and Accounts Payable Analyst

Job type: Full-time

Location: Remote (US only)

Job Summary:

We are looking for a Payroll & Accounts Payable Analyst to own the accurate and timely processing of employee payroll and vendor payments. You will sit at the heart of our finance operations — ensuring employees and vendors are paid correctly and on schedule, controls are followed, and payroll and A/P data reconcile cleanly to the general ledger.

Responsibilities:

  1. Own end-to-end payroll processing across all pay cycles, including new hires, terminations, status changes, bonuses, commissions, and off-cycle runs
  2. Calculate, reconcile, and remit payroll taxes, garnishments, benefits deductions, and 401(k) contributions, ensuring compliance with federal, state, and local regulations
  3. Manage the full accounts payable lifecycle, including invoice intake, GL coding, approval routing, and timely vendor payments via ACH, check, and wire
  4. Perform three-way matching of invoices to purchase orders and receipts, resolving discrepancies with vendors and internal stakeholders
  5. Maintain vendor master data, collect W-9s, and prepare and file annual 1099s
  6. Reconcile payroll and A/P subledgers to the general ledger and prepare related journal entries and accruals for month-end close
  7. Monitor A/P aging and payment terms to optimize cash flow and capture early-payment discounts
  8. Administer employee expense reimbursements and corporate card programs, ensuring policy compliance
  9. Respond to employee payroll inquiries and vendor payment questions with accuracy, professionalism, and discretion
  10. Support internal and external audits by preparing schedules, documentation, and reconciliations
  11. Maintain and strengthen internal controls across the payroll and A/P functions
  12. Identify and implement opportunities to automate and scale payroll and A/P workflows as the company grows

Requirements:

  1. Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field
  2. 2–4 years of hands-on payroll and/or accounts payable experience
  3. Working knowledge of payroll tax regulations and wage-and-hour compliance
  4. Solid understanding of A/P processes, GL coding, and accrual accounting fundamentals
  5. Hands-on experience with a payroll platform and an ERP/accounting system
  6. Strong command of Google Sheets and Excel
  7. High degree of accuracy and discretion when handling confidential payroll and financial data
  8. Strong attention to detail with the ability to manage recurring, non-negotiable deadlines
  9. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English
  10. Comfortable working independently in a fully remote, fast-paced startup environment

Preferred Qualifications:

  1. FPC or CPP certification, or progress toward a professional payroll or accounting certification
  2. Multi-state payroll experience
  3. Experience with 1099 and monthly/quarterly/year-end payroll tax reporting

Job Summary

Bright Vision Technologies is seeking a highly experienced Cloud-Native Architect with 10+ years of software engineering experience, including extensive experience designing cloud-native platforms and distributed systems. The ideal candidate will lead the architecture and modernization of enterprise-scale applications using microservices, Kubernetes, container platforms, and cloud-native technologies while driving engineering standards, platform strategy, and technical excellence across multiple teams.

  • Define enterprise-wide microservices architecture standards, service boundaries, and domain-driven design (DDD) principles.

  • Define data ownership strategies, distributed transaction models, and scalable persistence architectures.
  • Design and implement cloud-native platform capabilities, including Kubernetes, service mesh, API gateways, identity management, observability, and platform automation.
  • Drive performance engineering, scalability planning, capacity management, and system reliability across mission-critical services.
  • Establish CI/CD, GitOps, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), automated testing, and deployment strategies for cloud-native applications.
  • Define enterprise observability standards leveraging distributed tracing, centralized logging, metrics, dashboards, and SLO/SLI-based monitoring.
  • Partner with security teams to implement Zero Trust architecture, secrets management, runtime security, compliance, and cloud governance.
  • Lead architecture reviews, technical design sessions, and technology evaluations across multiple engineering organizations.
  • Mentor architects, technical leads, and senior engineers while promoting cloud-native engineering best practices.
  • Evaluate emerging cloud-native technologies and recommend strategic adoption based on business value and technical maturity.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • 10+ years of professional software engineering experience, including significant experience in software architecture and cloud-native solution design.

  • Extensive hands-on experience with Kubernetes, container orchestration, Docker, and cloud-native platforms.
  • Strong proficiency in one or more backend programming languages such as Java, Go, C#, or Python.
  • Strong knowledge of API design, asynchronous messaging, event streaming technologies (Kafka, RabbitMQ, Azure Service Bus, or similar), and distributed application architecture.
  • Experience designing and operating highly available, latency-sensitive production systems at enterprise scale.
  • Strong expertise with at least one major cloud platform, including AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform, Pulumi, CloudFormation, or Bicep.
  • Excellent leadership, communication, stakeholder management, and technical mentoring skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience building Internal Developer Platforms (IDPs) and platform engineering capabilities.
  • Hands-on experience with service mesh technologies such as Istio, Linkerd, Envoy, or Consul Connect.
  • Knowledge of GitOps tools such as Argo CD or Flux.
  • Experience with FinOps, cloud governance, and enterprise cloud cost optimization.

  • Experience working in regulated industries such as Healthcare, Financial Services, Insurance, or Government.
