Our philosophy is that we are a small, close-knit team, and we care deeply about you:

  • Highly competitive salary + Bonus

  • Fully remote work environments.

  • Self-managed time off.

Requirements

Who We Want

• You have personally helped take a deeply technical B2B security, infrastructure, identity, developer, cloud, or AI

product from near-zero to repeatable initial revenue.

• You can sit with a CISO, CTO, security architect, platform engineer, and AI-platform leader and earn credibility.

• You understand enough security architecture to reason about identity, delegated authority, credentials, policy,

enforcement, trust boundaries, auditability, and blast radius.

• You are comfortable selling before there is a polished playbook and learning directly from rejection.

• You treat AI as operating leverage. Your instinct is to build agentic workflows before asking for headcount.

• You are analytical enough to distinguish activity from evidence and evidence from causality.

• You are comfortable challenging the CEO and product assumptions when customer evidence disagrees.

Strong Background Signals

• Early-stage Zero Trust, identity, cloud security, developer security, infrastructure security, AI security, developer infrastructure, or adjacent enterprise-security categories.

• Founder, first-GTM, product-led commercial operator, technical seller, or hands-on GTM executive backgrounds can all fit.

• Large-company titles alone are not compelling.

Anti-Profile

• Your first answer to a growth problem is "hire a team."

• You depend on agencies for core positioning or customer discovery.

• You optimize lead volume before proving deployment and retention.

• You cannot personally run technical discovery or executive selling.

• You treat AI as a copywriting assistant rather than an operating system.

• You blur probabilistic AI recommendations with authorization or security enforcement.

First 90 Days: Window Expected outcome

• 0-30 days: 10-15 qualified ICP conversations; ~5 credible design-partner candidates; evidence-backed recommendation on ICP, problem, buyer, positioning, and wedge.

• 31-60 days: Convert the strongest partners into real or production-like deployments; measure time-to-value, blockers, security objections, and willingness to pay.

• 61-90 days: Target 5+ production or production-intent deployments where product readiness permits; first paying customers; prove or disprove repeatability with a second cohort; document the acquisition/onboarding motion.

How Success Is Measured

• Business: paid customers, initial ARR/MRR, expansion and eventually defensible unit economics.

• Customer: time-to-first-value, production activation, repeated authorized usage, protected resources/principals,

retention and expansion.

• Funnel: qualified conversations -> design partners -> deployments -> production -> paid -> expansion.

• Learning velocity: experiment cycle time, evidence quality, speed at which weak assumptions are killed or corrected.

Operating Model and Reporting

This role works directly with the CEO during zero-to-one discovery and partners closely with Rod, Head of Growth.

Decision rights will be explicit: CipherScale market discovery cannot become an overlapping second growth

organization, and OpenVPN growth priorities cannot dilute CipherScale category discovery. As the motion becomes

repeatable, responsibilities can be consolidated based on evidence rather than titles.

Security Expectations

You will operate with customer and prospect data, AI agents, email/CRM systems, call transcripts, and potentially

technical environments. Treat agents as potentially compromised actors. Use scoped identities, least privilege,

deterministic authorization for external actions, credential isolation, customer-data boundaries, prompt-injection

defenses, audit trails, and human approval for high-impact commitments until explicitly delegated.

Compensation Philosophy

We would rather pay exceptional compensation and meaningful upside for one outstanding founder-level operator

than assemble a large conventional GTM organization. Final structure should reflect experience, location, scope, and

demonstrated ability to create zero-to-one enterprise value.

The Test

A strong candidate should be able to take the Cipherscale thesis, identify the first market to attack, design the first ten

customer experiments, explain what evidence would invalidate the strategy, and show how they would use AI to

execute the work with minimal human headcount.

Status:Full Time, exempt

Our compensation model is designed to promote equity and alignment with our values. We actively work to reduce pay disparities across roles and responsibilities. We utilize an equitable compensation framework to determine the salaries for each position, and therefore our salaries are not negotiable.

Note: We’re thrilled by the interest in this role! To help our team manage the volume of applications, we kindly ask that you avoid calling or emailing to check on your status. We’ll be sure to reach out if you’re selected to move forward.

About Transgender Law Center

Transgender Law Center (TLC) is the largest national, trans-led organization working to set all people free. We champion the rights of all transgender and gender-nonconforming people to make their own choices and live freely, safely, and authentically. Prioritizing BIPOC, disabled, and HIV+ communities, we advance community-driven strategies that harness trans knowledge, power, and joy to ensure that we all not only survive but thrive at all ages and phases of life.

You can learn more about our work at .

About the Position

Transgender Law Center's National Organizer will build power with trans communities across the country by developing leadership, strengthening local and state organizing efforts, and advancing campaigns rooted in racial, gender, and HIV justice. We are seeking a skilled and self-motivated organizer to design and facilitate trainings, convenings, and cohorts that use popular education techniques to build political analysis and grow community leadership. This person will identify emerging issues, support base-building, campaign, and narrative change work, and translate research and needs assessments into strategies that resource and amplify local organizing.

Working across a national network of staff, community leaders, and partners, this person must be able to build authentic relationships while navigating the distinct needs and contexts of different regions and communities. This role requires strong communication skills, including facilitation and writing, sound judgment in issue identification and campaign development, and the project management skills to keep multiple trainings, partnerships, and deliverables moving forward. The ideal candidate is a true organizer at heart, with the instincts to build relationships, read a room, and move people toward shared action. They are flexible and adaptable as priorities shift, follow through on commitments, and jump in to support teammates with coverage as emerging issues arise. Most importantly, they have a deep commitment to advancing racial, gender, and HIV justice through the collective power of BIPOC trans and disabled communities.

Key Responsibilities

National Organizing & Campaign Leadership

  • Lead national organizing efforts aligned with TLC's key priorities, including but not limited to serving as an organizer for the Positively Trans+ program
  • Co-coordinate advocacy campaigns and on-the-ground ballot measure support in priority states
  • Work with partners to develop advocacy and narrative change strategies addressing HIV criminalization and anti-trans legislation
  • Identify emerging policy issues and translate them into organizing, campaign, and narrative priorities
  • Contribute to and support campaigns and organizing across TLC’s programmatic work

Partnership & Coalition Building

  • Build and steward relationships with coalition partners, community organizations, and allied movements
  • Coordinate and collaborate with the Positively Trans+ National Advisory Board (NAB)
  • Represent TLC in external meetings, advocacy spaces, and conferences
  • Collaborate with TLC staff to advance shared strategic goals across programs

Trainings, Convenings & Leadership Development

  • Plan and facilitate regional convenings and national training institutes
  • Develop curriculum and training materials grounded in popular education techniques
  • Design and lead cohorts and workshops that build political analysis and community leadership
  • Facilitate key internal and external meetings related to program and campaign work

Program Management & Communications

  • Manage day-to-day program operations, including meetings, trainings, convenings, and participant engagement
  • Support participants through ongoing communication and relationship-building
  • Disseminate research and needs-assessment findings to inform narrative change and education efforts
  • Draft memos to partners, conference abstracts, and other written materials supporting program and campaign work
  • Track project timelines and deliverables to ensure programs run smoothly and on schedule
  • Participate in organization-wide activities and shared responsibilities that support team alignment and culture

Qualifications & Requirements

  • 1-3 years of experience in national organizing work
  • Demonstrated experience in relationship-building and community organizing, including base-building, fostering community leadership, and supporting local and state organizing efforts nationally
  • Experience planning and facilitating trainings, convenings, and cohorts using popular education techniques grounded in political and popular education
  • Experience with campaign development and narrative change work, including issue identification and disseminating research (such as needs assessments) to inform strategy
  • Strong project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple trainings, timelines, and deliverables simultaneously
  • Strong communication skills, including facilitation and writing, with the ability to draft curriculum, partner memos, and conference abstracts
  • Demonstrated commitment to racial, gender, and HIV justice
  • Experience working with transgender migrants, Black trans communities, communities of color, poor, working class, transgender youth and disability communities and transgender and gender nonconforming communities.

Benefits

  • Medical/dental/vision (TLC covers 100% of premiums for employees, 80% for dependents)
  • Employer-funded Health Reimbursement Account (currently $3,500 per year)
  • Employer-funded Lifestyle Spending Account (currently $1,500 per year)
  • Optional employee-funded Flexible Spending Account
  • Employee Assistance Fund that can grant financial assistance for certain qualifying disasters and personal hardships
  • Short-term and long-term disability insurance
  • 3 weeks’ sick leave
  • 19 days’ vacation (24 after 3 years’ employment) and 12 holidays
  • Organizational ‘slowdown’ in winter and summer, including, historically, 2 weeks paid time off in the summer and 2 weeks paid time off at the end of the year (separate from employee vacation time)
  • 2-month paid sabbatical program available after 5 years of employment
  • Retirement plan with partial organizational matching
  • Indemnity insurance for critical illness, hospital confinement, and accidents
  • Professional development & coaching
  • Office setup, phone and internet reimbursement (if working from home)
  • Additional mental health, budgeting, travel, and pet benefits

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

Transgender Law Center is proud to be an affirmative action employer. All interested individuals, including Black, Indigenous, and other people of color; women and femmes; people with disabilities; and people who are transgender, intersex, lesbian, gay, bisexual, or queer are particularly urged to apply. For more information about Transgender Law Center please visit our website: .

Salary: $98,300-$103,000

Every year, 350 million people move between cities—yet today’s housing options haven’t caught up with the needs of this modern, mobile generation. Blueground was built to change that.

With 40,000+ homes across the globe, available for stays from a few days to a year or more, we’re just getting started. Keep It Honest – Transparency accelerates progress—and strengthens relationships.

About the Role

We are looking for a Housing Consultant (HC) Admin based in Brazil to support the growth of our housing supply by identifying and securing new housing opportunities across assigned markets. The Housing Sourcing Administrator is responsible for researching markets, locating available housing, and presenting qualified housing options that meet client needs and company standards. This role works closely with internal sales and operations teams while building relationships with property managers, landlords, and housing providers to ensure consistent housing availability.

If you are a resourceful problem solver with strong research skills, attention to detail, and the ability to move quickly in a fast-paced environment, this role may be a great fit.

What you will focus on

  • Review and evaluate housing requests to identify client requirements including location, budget, and housing specifications
  • Perform research within assigned markets to identify potential housing opportunities
  • Source available housing through property management companies, apartment communities, real estate agents, private landlords, and online platforms.
  • Think creatively to identify housing solutions when inventory is limited or difficult to source
  • Present qualified housing options with pricing and property details to internal teams and clients

  • Build and maintain positive relationships with landlords, property managers, and housing partners

  • Maintain accurate records by entering property and client information into internal systems
  • Add newly sourced properties to the company database and introduce potential partners to Blueground’s partnership program

What we are looking for

  • Strong research and problem-solving skills with the ability to identify housing options quickly
  • Excellent organizational skills and ability to manage multiple requests simultaneously
  • Strong communication and relationship-building skills with external partners
  • High attention to detail when gathering and documenting property information
  • Ability to work independently and move quickly in a fast-paced environment
  • Proficiency in Google suite and internal systems for data entry and tracking
  • Entrepreneurial mindset with a proactive, solution-oriented approach

Benefits

raw.title: Lead QA Engineer
raw.excerpt: About the RoleAs a Lead QA Engineer, you'll own testing strategy and quality standards across our most important work; Deciding what should be automated, what needs a human eye, where the real risk is hiding, and acting on it.
raw.description:
About the Role

As a Lead QA Engineer, you'll own testing strategy and quality standards across our most important work; Deciding what should be automated, what needs a human eye, where the real risk is hiding, and acting on it. You'll work hands-on across both manual and automated testing, splitting your time based on what a given release actually needs, while mentoring other engineers and acting as the go-to voice on quality across projects. You've got the critical thinking skills to chase down a hard bug yourself, know when to ask for help and delegate, and the range to set direction for how the whole team approaches quality. You seek to help your coworkers and do so regularly.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead test strategy and quality standards across multiple projects, deciding what warrants automated coverage versus focused manual and exploratory testing.
  • Build and maintain automated test suites in Playwright, and use BrowserStack to validate compatibility across browsers, devices, and platforms.
  • Define and run deep manual and exploratory testing on new, ambiguous, or high-change-rate work where automation isn't the right investment yet.
  • Translate requirements into concrete test plans and acceptance criteria, catching gaps in the requirements themselves before they become gaps in the product.
  • Act as the technical point of contact for quality with stakeholders: communicate risk, resolve disagreements about scope, and negotiate realistic testing timelines.
  • Write clear, actionable defect reports in Jira, drive them to resolution, and verify fixes actually hold up under retest rather than just passing a second glance.
  • Use Jira's linking and epic structure to keep testing work traceable, and flag workflow friction in the board with the team before it slows down the SDLC.
  • Mentor other QA engineers in both manual technique and automation practice, including how to write tickets clearly and so well that they need no follow-up clarification, raising the bar on testing across the team, not just on your own projects.
  • Step into any project at any phase to assess its quality risk and recommend a concrete path forward.
  • Stay ahead of testing tools and practices worth adopting, and bring the right ones into real workflows deliberately.
  • Operate and champion the use of AI tooling with an understanding that its output is useful, but not infallible. You treat AI as a tool, not a coworker.

Craft & Leadership Balance

Estimated 60% leadership, 40% craft.

Qualifications

Required

  • 6-8 years of experience in software quality assurance or testing, ideally with exposure to consulting or multi-stakeholder environments.
  • Strong, hands-on experience with Playwright for building and maintaining automated test suites and frameworks.
  • Experience using BrowserStack (or a comparable cross-browser/device testing platform) to validate compatibility across platforms.
  • Deep grounding in manual, exploratory, and regression testing, with the judgment to know when automation is and isn't the right investment.
  • Proven ability to translate ambiguous requirements into concrete, actionable test plans and acceptance criteria.
  • Strong Jira practice: writing tickets so well that no follow-up or clarification is needed, using issue-linking for traceability, and spotting workflow friction before it becomes a team-wide problem.
  • Experience testing across a range of CMS or SaaS platforms rather than a single stack, since our client environments vary and this role needs to move between them.
  • Exceedingly strong communication skills, including presenting technical risk and testing tradeoffs to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. It cannot be stressed enough how important this item is: communication is the whole ballgame.
  • Prior experience as a technical or testing lead on large or multi-phase projects.

Preferred

  • Familiarity with performance testing (e.g. Lighthouse) and accessibility testing (e.g. Axe, WCAG guidelines).
  • Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Experience with structured test-case formats (e.g. Gherkin) and test case management tooling.
  • A track record of debugging and performance investigation at scale.
  • Creation and implementation of SDLC processes and norms at project and team scales.

Why Current

At Current, we believe the best digital work happens when strategy, design, production, and technology operate as one team. We partner with ambitious brands to create digital experiences that are thoughtful, scalable, and built to drive real impact.

We’re a remote-first agency with teams across the US, working collaboratively across websites, platforms, campaigns, CRM ecosystems, and digital product experiences. Our environment is fast-paced, highly collaborative, and built for people who enjoy solving complex technical challenges alongside smart, supportive teammates.

You’ll have the opportunity to work across a variety of clients and technologies, contribute to meaningful digital experiences, and help shape the future of engineering within a growing agency environment.

The target range of base compensation for this role is $85,000 - $110,000 annually. Actual compensation is influenced by a wide array of factors, including but not limited to skill set, level of experience, and location.

raw.excerpt: Location: RemoteOverviewWe are seeking a theologically trained writer to join a collaborative team developing a Christ-centered commentary on the Gospels and Acts.
raw.description:
Location: Remote

Overview

We are seeking a theologically trained writer to join a collaborative team developing a Christ-centered commentary on the Gospels and Acts. This project is written for the thoughtful, everyday Bible student who wants to go deeper—without requiring highly technical academic detail. The commentary should reflect careful exegesis and a clearly articulated Christ-centered hermeneutic. Our goal is to land between conversational pastoral commentaries and academic volumes—accessible, theologically rich, and intellectually serious. An ecumenical tone is imperative throughout, engaging interpretive differences with charity and avoiding unnecessary polemics.

Scope of Work

  • Collaborate with a team of contributors under editorial and theological oversight
  • Research and write assigned portions of the Gospels and/or Acts
  • Provide clear, structured commentary that includes:
    • Literary and historical context
    • Explanation of key theological themes
    • Engagement with major interpretive questions
    • Selective interaction with the original languages where illuminating (without becoming technical)
  • Articulate how each passage contributes to the revelation of Christ and the mission of the early church
  • Write for serious lay readers—clear and accessible, but not simplified
  • Address areas of theological disagreement with fairness, clarity, and ecumenical charity
  • Revise material in response to editorial and peer review
  • Ensure alignment with the organization’s doctrinal commitments
  • Explicit Christ-centered and redemptive-historical connections
  • Draw out thoughtful, textually grounded practical application for contemporary readers
  • Write not merely to inform, but to form aiming at spiritual transformation, worship, and deeper trust in Christ

Qualifications

  • Master of Divinity (M.Div.) or another advanced theology degree required
  • Demonstrated competency in New Testament exegesis
  • Working knowledge of Koine Greek
  • A clearly articulated Christ-centered hermeneutic
  • Familiarity with major evangelical scholarship on the Gospels and Acts
  • Demonstrated capacity to engage diverse theological perspectives with humility and care
  • Experience in pastoral ministry, theological education, or substantive Bible teaching preferred
  • Ability to write clearly for educated lay readers
  • Comfortable collaborating within a multi-author theological project
  • Willingness to receive and implement substantive editorial feedback

Commitment

Contract, per-project basis.

Compensation

Compensation is determined based on project scope and complexity.

Additional Information

Contractors are engaged based on the needs of specific projects and are not guaranteed ongoing or full-time work. Participation in meetings, workshops, or collaborative sessions may be requested depending on the project timeline.

Why Publish with The Daily Grace Co.?

With over a decade of publishing experience, The Daily Grace Co. creates Christ-centered resources marked by theological depth, biblical faithfulness, and practical encouragement. We value thoughtful, faithful writers and partner closely from concept development through launch. Our goal is not simply to publish Bible studies—but to serve readers with resources that meet real needs and help them treasure Christ.

Submission Requirements

Because this is a collaborative theological project, we require a CV, writing sample, and two statements from applicants. Applicants must submit the following materials in a single PDF document:

Important: Incomplete submissions will not be reviewed.

1. Curriculum Vitae (CV)

Include:

  • Academic degrees (M.Div. required; advanced degrees preferred)
  • Institutions attended
  • Greek coursework and competency
  • Ministry, teaching, or academic experience
  • Previous publications (if applicable)

2. Exegetical Writing Sample (5–10 pages)

Submit one of the following:

  • A previously published exegetical work (preferred), or
  • A freshly written commentary-style sample on a passage from the Gospels or Acts

The sample should demonstrate:

  • Careful engagement with the biblical text
  • Awareness of historical and literary context
  • Clear articulation of theological themes
  • A Christ-centered, covenantal approach
  • Writing accessible to thoughtful lay readers (not overly technical)
  • An ecumenical tone when addressing interpretive differences

3. Hermeneutical Statement (1–2 pages)

Please include a brief statement describing your hermeneutical approach to the Bible.

4. Personal Doctrinal Statement (1–2 pages)

Submit a concise personal doctrinal statement summarizing your theological convictions and expand upon how you approach theological disagreements.

Salary: Determined per project

raw.description:
About NOCD

NOCD is the #1 telehealth provider for the treatment of obsessive-compulsive disorder (OCD). OCD is one of the most severe, prevalent, and misunderstood mental health conditions. NOCD creates access to online therapy for people with OCD through our telehealth platform. In the NOCD app, Members can quickly access and schedule live, face-to-face video therapy sessions with our national network of licensed Therapists that specialize in Exposure and Response Prevention Therapy (ERP) - considered the "gold standard" in OCD treatment.

At NOCD, we help people reclaim their lives with clinically proven OCD treatment, by removing barriers to OCD care, and reducing the stigma associated with OCD. We’re changing the world and need other like-minded individuals to accelerate and expand our efforts.

About the Role

As the specialist virtual behavioral health provider, at NOCD, we want our Therapists to focus on what's most important - treating and caring for our members.

NOCD is looking for Independently Licensed Therapists (LMHC, LMFT, LICSW or Licensed Psychologist) in Washington State to join our team.

As a NOCD Therapist, you will see our team is committed to achieving clinical excellence, an exquisite Therapist experience and providing proven & visible clinical outcomes. We have dedicated teams to handle your marketing, billing, credentialing, and scheduling. Therapists will use valuable previous clinical experience, good judgment, and our clinical guidelines to discern when to refer members to external resources.

You'll enjoy growth and support through: ongoing consultation with other team members; specialized clinical training with experienced OCD providers; information on the latest research advancements in the field; technical support and clinical protocols; 1:1 mentorship to discuss complex cases; and an open, receptive environment to provide feedback.

What You'll Do

  • Help people with OCD get better and stay better by providing top-notch care through diagnoses, assessments, and evidence-based psychotherapy via the NOCD video platform
  • Manage your caseload and schedule
  • Maintain complete and timely clinical documentation using the NOCD EHR system
  • Participate in NOCD clinical consultation, training, and advance your knowledge and practice of evidence-supported treatments for OCD
  • Collaborate with our network of providers to help develop and reinforce treatment decisions

Requirements:

  • See credentialing information here.
  • Full Time Providers:
    • 40 hour work week
    • Complete 15-25 hours of direct clinical work during evening and/or weekend hours
    • Attend 2 hours of weekly group clinical consultation
    • Evening Availability Consists of:
      • Monday - Friday: 3:00 - 10:00 PM local time
      • Saturday & Sunday: 8 hours of availability per day
    • Will participate in and complete cross-license application process during Onboarding
    • Open and willing to treat children and adolescents after attending NOCD Child and Adolescent training
  • Practical experience independently diagnosing is required for this role (this practical experience can be during your pre-licensed experience).
    • If you do not have this direct practical experience, proof of completion (with certificate) of the following training will be accepted in its place: Tolin & Diamond Training Video.
    • Please note: submission of proof of completion does not guarantee hire, NOCD will not reimburse the cost of this course.

Who You Are

  • Full and unrestricted license in good standing to practice in your state.
    • Masters Degree Required
    • Washington: Licensed Psychologist, Licensed Mental Health Counselor, Licensed Marriage and Family Therapist, Licensed Independent Clinical Social Worker
  • At least 6 months of relevant experience with evidence-based therapies (e.g., ERP, CBT, ACT)
  • Knowledge and experience with treating OCD with ERP is preferable but not required
  • Organized, quick and enthusiastic learner, excellent communicator, good with time management
  • Have a confidential, private location to work remotely from with reliable internet access
  • Comfortable and efficient with using technology to communicate
  • Ambitious and ready to keep up with a goal-driven, start-up environment

What We Offer

  • A commitment to clinical excellence, an exquisite Therapist experience and proven & visible clinical outcomes.
  • Gain world-class training from experienced OCD providers to become a specialized Therapist in treating OCD and related disorders through evidence-based care.
  • A full suite of support through continued mentorship & feedback
  • Investment in new technology built to improve the NOCD Therapist experience and allow our Therapists to continue to focus on Member care.
  • Centralized scheduling
  • An investment in your personal growth through a clear career path
  • Access to NOCD Professional Development Trainings and ongoing consultation with other team members
  • One-on-one mentorship to discuss complex cases
  • Ability to work remotely from the comfort of your own home or office
  • Competitive compensation with a robust bonus program
    • Base Salary Comp Range in Washington State = $65,000 - $117,500
    • Bonus Program = $12,400 per year earned on average by those eligible
  • Comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision coverage, and 401(k) match for qualifying employees
  • Casual and engaging startup environment with an outstanding mission-driven team atmosphere
  • Generous PTO
  • NOCD provides 12 weeks of fully paid parental leave for the primary caregiver, and 6 weeks of fully paid leave for the secondary caregiver, for qualifying full-time employees.

Have Questions Before Applying?

Book an informational call with our recruitment team here.

We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. NOCD is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures.

Please note: we’re a remote-first company and offer the flexibility to work remotely within the country listed in the job posting.

At Bitrise, we’re transforming how mobile products are developed and deployed for thousands of customers worldwide. Many customers discover us through events that either introduce them to our platform or help them understand a problem they’re facing and how we can solve it.

As the Head of Demand Generation at Bitrise, you’ll be responsible for developing, implementing, and optimizing our Demand Generation engine across our self-serve and direct sales GTM motions. You will be responsible for generating high-quality leads that fuel our sales pipeline and drive digital customer acquisition..

Additionally, you will own and manage our marketing tech stack, working closely with Revenue Operations including sales ops, marketing ops, and product teams to create impactful campaigns that resonate with our target audience and deliver on business objectives.

Our Ideal Candidate

  • A get-things-done attitude with an entrepreneurial spirit
  • 7+ years of experience in demand generation at B2B SaaS companies, with working for companies in the $10M-$80M ARR range
  • Experience with building or rebuilding a DemandGen engine, not just inheriting or managing one
  • Proven track record owning a pipeline number and delivering against it with a small team and realistic budget
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to do reverse funnel math, build dashboards, and translate data into actionable decisions
  • Experience with developer marketing or technical buyers, focused on ideal customer profiles in the developer ecosystem
  • Experience operating in a hybrid PLG + sales-led environment and solid understanding on how DemandGen supports both motions
  • Deep familiarity with paid digital (Google Ads, LinkedIn), ABM, content syndication, email nurture, and event-driven pipeline programs
  • Comfortable with intent data platforms (6sense, Bombora) and knows when to keep the martech stack simple rather than adding more tools
  • Actively uses AI tools in their marketing work to move faster, not because it's trendy
  • Strong project management skills with the ability to run multiple campaigns simultaneously without dropping things
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, especially with sales teams
  • Experienced people manager, hiring and scaling growth marketing teams
  • Previously owned SEO & GEO

What would really knock our socks off

  • Experience in DevOps, CI/CD, mobile development tools, or developer platforms
  • Familiarity with running DemandGen during a company positioning shift
  • Experience working directly with BDR/SDR teams to align outbound and marketing programs

Your Role & Responsibilities

  • Own the marketing-sourced and marketing-influenced pipeline number across both self-serve and direct sales motions
  • Work backward from bookings targets to define required volume of MQLs, SQLs, and opportunities by channel, by month
  • Build and run multi-channel DemandGen campaigns: paid digital (Google, LinkedIn), email nurture, content syndication, webinars, ABM plays, and event-driven programs
  • Execute campaigns hands-on, not just plan them. Set up campaigns in HubSpot, manage paid media, write briefs, pull reports, and optimize based on performance data
  • Manage and optimize the marketing tech stack with a focus on keeping it lean and effective. Partner with RevOps on lead scoring, routing, attribution, and reporting
  • Build and maintain dashboards tracking pipeline generated, conversion rates by stage, cost per MQL/SQL, channel ROI, and pipeline velocity. Share these openly with no spin
  • Partner with sales and BDRs regularly. Provide the right content, intent signals, and talk tracks. Listen to feedback and actually adjust programs based on it
  • Collaborate with content and product marketing to ensure campaigns reflect Bitrise's positioning as the best platform for mobile, broader DevOps, and AI agent infrastructure
  • Run continuous experiments on subject lines, landing pages, audience segments, channel mix, and messaging. Kill what doesn't work quickly, double down on what does
  • Plan and execute events (owned webinars + third-party conferences) as pipeline programs with measurable targets, not just brand plays
  • Document playbooks, campaign templates, and processes so what you build is repeatable and scalable
  • Managing a team of 3 Marketing Managers - own their performance management, coaching, mentoring and growth with Bitrise

Required Skills & Competencies

  • Pipeline Ownership & Accountability: Can do the math from bookings targets back through conversion rates to figure out exactly how many leads are needed per channel. Builds programs to hit those numbers. Flags issues early and comes with a plan to fix them.
  • Campaign Execution at Speed: Gets campaigns from idea to live fast. Doesn't need 6 weeks to launch an email sequence or a webinar. Bias toward shipping and iterating rather than perfecting in a vacuum.
  • Data Fluency & Analytical Rigor: Builds own reports and dashboards. Understands multi-touch attribution and its limitations. Checks numbers weekly and makes decisions based on data, not gut feel or what worked at their last company.
  • Developer Audience Marketing: Understands that developers and engineering leaders don't respond to traditional B2B marketing. Knows how to create demand through technical content, community involvement, and product-led motions rather then pushy outbound.
  • Cross-Functional Partnership: Works well with sales, BDRs, content, PMM, and RevOps. Not territorial. Actively seeks feedback from sales on lead quality and adjusts programs accordingly. The kind of marketer sales teams actually want to work with.
  • Marketing Technology Proficiency: Hands-on with HubSpot (or equivalent MAP), Salesforce, paid media platforms, and ABM/intent tools. Can troubleshoot a broken workflow, set up lead scoring, and evaluate whether a new tool is actually worth adding to the stack.
  • Experimentation Mindset: Constantly tests and iterates. Has killed programs that weren't delivering even if they were "supposed to work." Brings ideas to the table proactively, doesn't just execute what they're told.
  • Project Management & Organization: Keeps multiple workstreams moving without letting things slip. Uses project management tools to track timelines and deliverables. Keeps work visible to cross-functional partners.
  • Resilience & Bias to Action: Moves fast in ambiguous environments. Doesn't get stuck waiting for perfect information. Ships, learns, adjusts. Comfortable with the messy reality of building demand gen at a growth-stage company.
  • Transparency & Communication: Tells people what's working and what isn't, straight up. Doesn't hide behind vanity metrics. Gives the CEO and sales leadership a clear, honest picture at all times.

What We Offer

  • The opportunity to learn about app development by playing a crucial role in the mobile development process for the world’s most successful companies
  • The security of working in a financially stable, growing company with an ever-expanding global customer base
  • A remote working environment with opportunities for in-person collaboration
  • A global customer portfolio to manage
  • A competitive stock options package
  • Private medical insurance & life assurance

About Bitrise

Bitrise is a continuous integration and delivery platform, built by and for mobile app developers. Our mission? To help everyone build and operate better mobile apps. By streamlining, automating and optimizing recurring mobile development processes, we free up time and resources for creative, interesting and impactful development tasks, resulting in better, faster releases.

As a successful graduate of Y Combinator, we are born of the same DNA as Airbnb and Dropbox. Since Bitrise was launched in 2015, we have grown exponentially: Today, tens of thousands of developers release apps via Bitrise that end up on billions of mobile devices around the world.

Some of the teams who already trust us are Tripadvisor, Shopify, Get Your Guide, or GoDaddy.. Pick up any mobile device, and chances are you’ll encounter multiple apps that were built on Bitrise. Working at Bitrise means contributing to all of that.

Salary: £100,000 - £130,000

Thinking of applying? Here's the inside scoop.

Let us walk you through the next steps.

Step 1 – Complete Your Application

Fill in our application form and upload your CV. This stores your profile in our Applicant Tracking System (ATS) and places you into our active job pipelines, making it easier for us to match you with current and future opportunities.

Step 2 – The First Look (One-Way Video Interview)

This is where your application comes to life. We review your CV and video interview to get a feel for your experience, communication style, and overall fit. If we like what we see, you're on to the next step!

Why do we ask for a video?

Because a résumé can tell us what you've done, but it can't show us you. Your video is your moment to shine, and it helps us see:

  • How you communicate and connect with people.
  • How you present yourself professionally.
  • Other opportunities you might be an even better fit for (bonus surprises!).

Think of it as your personal trailer. One great video means we can pitch you for multiple roles and get you in front of the right employers, faster.

Heads up: Some clients watch your video directly, so make it one you'd be proud to have represent you. This is your highlight reel—make it count!

Step 3 – Let's Actually Talk

A Recruitment Specialist calls to chat about your experience, your availability, what you want to earn, and the role itself. Consider it a friendly vibe check.

Step 4 – The Fine Print, Made Fun

We break down what it's like working as an independent contractor—hours, pay, contract terms, the whole deal. No surprises, no fine-print sneakiness. You'll get it all in writing.

Step 5 – Matchmaking Time

Our Talent Delivery Team plays cupid, matching you to clients where you're most likely to shine. We can't promise everyone gets picked, but we're rooting for you.

Step 6 – Showtime

Got shortlisted? We'll set up your interview, prep you like a pro, and have your back the whole way—with a Reworks teammate right there facilitating.

Step 7 – The Verdict

We chase feedback the second it lands and keep you in the loop.

About NOCD

NOCD is the #1 telehealth provider for the treatment of obsessive-compulsive disorder (OCD). OCD is one of the most severe, prevalent, and misunderstood mental health conditions. NOCD creates access to online therapy for people with OCD through our telehealth platform. In the NOCD app, Members can quickly access and schedule live, face-to-face video therapy sessions with our national network of licensed Therapists that specialize in Exposure and Response Prevention Therapy (ERP) - considered the "gold standard" in OCD treatment.

At NOCD, we help people reclaim their lives with clinically proven OCD treatment, by removing barriers to OCD care, and reducing the stigma associated with OCD. We’re changing the world and need other like-minded individuals to accelerate and expand our efforts.

About the Role

As the specialist virtual behavioral health provider, at NOCD, we want our Therapists to focus on what's most important - treating and caring for our members.

NOCD is looking for Independently Licensed Therapists to join our team.

As a NOCD Therapist, you will see our team is committed to achieving clinical excellence, an exquisite Therapist experience and providing proven & visible clinical outcomes. We have dedicated teams to handle your marketing, billing, credentialing, and scheduling. Therapists will use valuable previous clinical experience, good judgment, and our clinical guidelines to discern when to refer members to external resources.

You'll enjoy growth and support through: ongoing consultation with other team members; specialized clinical training with experienced OCD providers; information on the latest research advancements in the field; technical support and clinical protocols; 1:1 mentorship to discuss complex cases; and an open, receptive environment to provide feedback.

What You'll Do

  • Manage your caseload and schedule
  • Maintain complete and timely clinical documentation using the NOCD EHR system

Who You Are

  • A full suite of support through continued mentorship & feedback

Hard Rock Digital is a team focused on becoming the best online sportsbook, casino, and social casino company in the world. We’re building a team that resonates passion for learning, operating, and building new products and technologies for millions of consumers. We care about each customer interaction, experience, behavior, and insight and strive to ensure we’re always acting authentically.

Rooted in the kindred spirits of Hard Rock and the Seminole Tribe of Florida, Hard Rock Digital taps a brand known the world over as the leader in gaming, entertainment, and hospitality. We’re taking that foundation of success and bringing it to the digital space - ready to join us?

Across Slots, Card & Table, and Arcade games, we are creating differentiated experiences that combine proven player appeal, outstanding creative execution, innovative mechanics, and the quality expected from the Hard Rock brand. You will have the opportunity to help shape games from the earliest concepts through launch, working with our internal Studio team and external development partners to create content that becomes an important part of the Hard Rock Bet Casino experience.

What’s the position?

We’re looking for an Associate Product Manager / Associate Game Producer, Casino Games to help create the next generation of proprietary games for Hard Rock Bet Casino.

This is an exciting opportunity for someone early in their casino gaming career who wants to develop across Product Management, Game Production, Game Design, Creative Development, and game performance.

Working closely with Senior Product Managers and Game Producers, you will help take games from concept through development, QA, certification, launch, and performance review.

Depending on Studio priorities and your experience, you may work across Slots, Card & Table, Arcade, or multiple game categories.

You will help coordinate internal teams, external game studios, artists, mathematicians, technical partners, QA, Compliance, and Release teams while learning how great casino games are designed, produced, launched, and optimized.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Support the Full Game Lifecycle: Help manage casino games from early concept through design, development, QA, certification, launch, and post launch review.

  • Support Game Production: Maintain requirements, GDDs, development priorities, action items, game feedback, milestone plans, and production documentation.

  • Own Defined Game Workstreams: Take responsibility for specific features, smaller projects, game variants, or titles under the guidance of senior Studio leaders.

  • Contribute to Game Concepts: Research successful games, mechanics, themes, player behaviors, and industry trends to help identify new game opportunities.

  • Support Creative Development: Participate in reviews of gameplay, art, animation, audio, UI/UX, features, and overall game presentation.

  • Coordinate Development Partners: Work closely with external game studios and internal teams to track deliverables, feedback, decisions, and next steps.

  • Support Game Quality: Play and review games throughout development, identify issues, provide structured feedback, and help ensure games meet Studio quality standards.

  • Support Regulated Market Delivery: Help coordinate game documentation, testing, certification requirements, compliance feedback, and release readiness.

  • Track Game Performance: Work with Analytics, Casino Product, and senior Studio team members to understand how games perform after launch and identify learnings for future development.

  • Maintain Competitive Intelligence: Regularly play and analyze leading casino games and suppliers across Slots, Card & Table, and Arcade categories.

  • Keep Projects Moving: Help maintain project trackers, timelines, decisions, risks, and dependencies while following up with stakeholders to keep delivery on schedule.

  • Champion the Player Experience: Bring curiosity, player empathy, and attention to detail to every game.

Requirements

What are we looking for?

We are looking for someone who is passionate about casino games and wants to build a career creating them.

You are curious about why games work, not just whether they are fun. You enjoy understanding mechanics, math, features, art, player behavior, user experience, and what makes one game perform better than another.

You are organized, proactive, comfortable receiving feedback, and eager to learn from experienced game producers, developers, artists, mathematicians, and product leaders. You do not need to know everything on day one. You do need strong ownership, attention to detail, curiosity, and a genuine desire to build great games.

You will:

  • 3 years+ of experience in product management, game production, game development, casino content, gaming, or another relevant digital product environment.

  • A strong interest in casino games, including Slots, Card & Table, Arcade, social casino, mobile games, or related gaming categories.

  • Some understanding of the game or software development lifecycle from concept through testing and launch.

  • Strong organizational and project coordination skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

  • A collaborative mindset and comfort working with creative, technical, mathematical, and business teams.

  • Strong attention to detail and willingness to play, review, test, and critique games throughout development.

  • An analytical mindset with an interest in player behavior, game performance, market trends, and competitive intelligence.

  • Ability to translate feedback and ideas into clear requirements, actions, or documentation.

  • Familiarity with Jira, Confluence, Figma, wireframing, analytics tools, game development tools, or similar platforms is a plus.

  • Experience with regulated iCasino, social casino, mobile gaming, game development studios, or casino operations is a plus.

  • A player first mindset, strong curiosity, creativity, and a desire to continually improve.

  • A sense of humor and genuine passion for games.

What’s in it for you?

We offer our employees more than just competitive compensation. Our team benefits include:

  • Competitive pay and benefits

  • Flexible vacation allowance

  • Flexible work from home or office hours

  • Startup culture backed by a secure, global brand

  • Opportunity to learn from experienced casino game leaders and development partners

  • Opportunity to help build proprietary Hard Rock casino games played by millions

  • Clear opportunity to grow into a Product Manager / Game Producer role as the Studio expands

Roster of Uniques

We care deeply about every interaction our customers have with us, and trust and empower our staff to own and drive their experience. Our vision for our business and customers is built on fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment where regardless of background or beliefs you feel able to be authentic and bring all your talent into play. We want to celebrate you being you (we are an equal opportunity employer).

Du übernimmst von Anfang an Verantwortung, lernst moderne Tools kennen und leistest einen wichtigen Beitrag zum Erfolg unserer Revenue-Teams.

Description

TripleTen is an EdTech company that designs and runs tech career learning programs for the US and Latin American markets. We've been doing it for over five years, teaching complete beginners — people with no prior tech background — through cohort-based programs built on our own platform and curriculum, developed in partnership with Nebius AI. Our team is fully remote and globally distributed, and we serve a large, active student base across both regions.

We are looking for Onboarding Sales Trainer to join our Sales Training team and own the onboarding and development of new sales hires working with the US market.

This is a hands-on role for a sales professional with leadership, coaching, or training experience who will lead two-week onboarding programs for new hires, develop practical sales skills, and maintain training materials. The role is fully remote, supports our LATAM-based sales team serving the US market, and requires native-level Spanish, fluent English.

What you will do

  • Lead end-to-end onboarding for new sales hires, running a structured two-week onboarding program for our LATAM-based sales team working with the US market.
  • Train regular cohorts of new hires — currently around 4–5 people once a month, with cohort sizes expected to grow to 10+ people as the team scales.
  • Develop practical sales skills, including discovery, probing, objection handling, closing, follow-up, negotiation, customer communication, and working with different customer profiles.
  • Train new hires on our product, sales processes, and day-to-day tools, including CRM systems, telephony, WhatsApp-based communication tools, and other digital sales platforms.
  • Run highly interactive training sessions using role plays, mock sales calls, real-life scenarios, demonstrations, practical exercises, and continuous feedback to make sure trainees can apply what they learn in real conversations.
  • Assess each trainee’s progress throughout the two weeks, identify individual gaps, adapt your coaching approach, and provide clear feedback on their readiness before handing them over to their Sales Supervisor.
  • Partner closely with Sales Supervisors and managers to ensure a smooth handover, share feedback on each trainee, and jointly investigate performance gaps if a new hire struggles after onboarding.
  • Maintain and improve onboarding materials, including presentations, scripts, exercises, guides, and process documentation, keeping them accurate and up to date whenever sales processes or operations change.
  • Use AI and modern productivity tools to create and improve training materials, scripts, presentations, exercises, and other onboarding content more efficiently.

Requirements

  • Hands-on sales experience. You should understand the full sales process from your own practical experience, not only from managing or training others.
  • 2+ years of leadership, team supervision, coaching, or sales management experience, ideally working directly with sales teams.
  • Native-level Spanish and fluent English, with the confidence to train, coach, and provide feedback in both languages.
  • Strong communication and facilitation skills — you can explain complex concepts simply, keep a group engaged, and adapt your communication style to different levels of experience.
  • Patience, empathy, and emotional maturity. You are comfortable working with struggling trainees, handling difficult conversations, receiving critical feedback, and resolving disagreements constructively.
  • Strong ownership and accountability. You can recognize when something is not working, admit mistakes, review the situation objectively, and adjust your approach rather than becoming defensive or blaming others.
  • Energy and charisma to motivate people, maintain engagement, and create a positive but demanding learning environment.
  • Comfort with digital tools and the ability to quickly learn new systems, including CRM, telephony, messaging, presentation, and online training tools.
  • Ability to work remotely with stable internet connectivity and availability aligned with Colombia working hours.

Nice-to-have:

  • Experience in B2C sales, especially high-ticket, consultative, or fast-paced sales where discovery, objection handling, negotiation, and closing happen directly with the customer.
  • Previous experience as a Sales Trainer, Sales Coach, Team Lead, Supervisor, or Sales Manager.
  • Experience coaching or developing underperforming salespeople and helping them improve through practice, feedback, and structured follow-up.
  • Experience working in high-volume sales environments, including call centers or similar teams.
  • Experience creating or maintaining training materials, scripts, presentations, onboarding guides, or process documentation.
  • Experience using AI and modern productivity tools to create or improve training content, scripts, exercises, presentations, or documentation.
  • Experience working with LATAM-based sales teams serving the US market.

What we can offer you

  • A supportive and proactive work environment.
  • Competitive compensation: 1000-2000 USD Gross per month
  • Fully remote and full-time collaboration.
  • Modern digital tools for seamless collaboration.
  • Tangible results measured by student success.

You will collaborate closely with content, outreach, paid media, and development teams to ensure SEO recommendations are implemented in ways that support both rankings and revenue.

This is a full-time, remote position that reports to the Director of SEO.

Our SEO team is trusted to lead, not just support. This role is central to how we help partners grow.

Also known as: SEO Strategist, Technical SEO Manager, Organic Search Specialist

About Searchbloom
Searchbloom is an established and growing company. This provides you with the unique opportunity to share your expertise with exceptional digital marketers, make your mark in the organization, and create opportunities for future advancement.

Searchbloom is in search of an experienced SEO Specialist. Come join our team of digital marketers who work great together to do an amazing job for our partners, and play hard along the way. To fit in, you’ve got to be an advanced SEO with a real passion for organic search. We’re looking for people who stay on top of what’s really working and have strong opinions about the implications of strategic approaches. The majority of your workday will be spent identifying, documenting, and prioritizing SEO issues for clients.

Compensation
$75,000 – $90,000 annually, depending on experience, technical depth, and client management skills.

Qualifications

Must-Have:

Ecommerce SEO Expertise (Required)

  • Proven experience scaling SEO for ecommerce sites with hundreds to tens of thousands of SKUs
  • Proven client-facing experience in an agency environment
  • Expertise in Microsoft Excel/Google Sheets
    • Advanced proficiency in using formulas, & data manipulation techniques to create meaningful, client-facing analysis through Microsoft Excel/Google Sheets
  • Outstanding communication skills with the ability to influence multiple stakeholders
  • Deep knowledge of SEO tools: Ahrefs, Moz, SEMrush, Screaming Frog, Google Search Console, Google Analytics
  • Experience implementing and validating ecommerce structured data, including Product, Review, Offer, and Breadcrumb schema
  • Hands-on experience optimizing category pages and product detail pages (PDPs) for search visibility and conversion support
  • Experience developing, managing, executing, and measuring SEO campaigns for medium-to-large brands and eCommerce websites
  • Strong understanding of page-level SEO, site architecture, technical audits, and structured data
  • Experience with AEO/ AI SEO strategies including featured snippet and AIO targeting, FAQ markup, entity optimization, and search intent mapping
  • Familiarity with basic HTML, CSS, PHP and JavaScript concepts
  • Experience supporting or collaborating on product feed optimization and feed management solutions that impact organic shopping visibility
  • Working knowledge of recent and ongoing algorithm changes including Helpful Content updates, Core Web Vitals, spam signal updates (e.g., SpamBrain), and the implications of generative AI on search
  • Proven experience collaborating with Paid Media, Dev, and Content teams though: meeting preparation, client-facing communications, running joint meetings,
  • Specialist in ecommerce SEO

Nice to Have:

  • Experience with Looker Studio (Data Studio), Supermetrics, or other reporting tools

  • Attitude > Aptitude
  • “Core Values” - Candidates live and execute these values regularly
  • Transparency / Integrity - As a remote workforce we expect high-degrees of proactivity & self-management. Work must be completed on time, and according to standards. We expect not to have to manage ‘the basics’ (standards of professional conduct, etc)
  • 6 week ramp-up - Successful candidates must be able to manage accounts in a partner-facing capacity within six weeks
  • Strategic thinking - Candidates must be able to create, articulate, execute, & pivot strategic actions (roadmap). Doing so requires ability to be empathetic and understand true partner goals beyond just results

Responsibilities

  • Lead the SEO relationship for your assigned clients
  • Own SEO strategy for category, subcategory, and product detail pages, balancing crawl efficiency, rankings, and conversion support
  • Audit and optimize PDP and category templates for structured data, internal linking, indexation, and performance at scale
  • Lead client calls as the primary SEO voice, educate, recommend, and defend strategic direction
  • Perform advanced audits using a suite of SEO tools to surface technical and content opportunities
  • Write Point of View (POV) documents and recommendations based on partner needs and data
  • Prioritize initiatives by difficulty, cost, and potential impact, make budget recommendations
  • Partner with Paid Media and ecommerce teams on product feed optimization to improve organic shopping visibility
  • Collaborate with Paid Media, Content, and Development teams to execute multi-channel strategies
  • Execute SEO deliverables such as keyword research, on-page optimization, internal linking, competitive gap analysis, and technical improvements
  • Conduct QA on SEO deliverables produced by SEO peers
  • Identify risks and opportunities related to SKU sprawl, thin PDPs, duplicate categories, and parameter driven URLs
  • Monitor performance and iterate strategy based on analytics and client KPIs
  • Mentor junior SEO talent as needed and contribute to improving our internal SEO playbooks
  • Proactively surface new opportunities and test ideas that improve results (within above-mentioned frameworks of prioritization)
  • Use AI to scale audits, surface gaps, or assist with content ideation, while relying on human strategy for final decision-making

Key Performance Indicators

  • ROI for your partners
  • Partner retention
  • Organic traffic growth
  • SEO-driven conversion volume
  • Technical SEO health scores
  • Net Promoter Score

Why Choose Searchbloom?

Work Environment:

As a Field Marketer, you will own regional field strategy and activation for Vena’s UK & EMEA business, translating regional market opportunity, Sales priorities and Vena’s global go-to-market strategy into integrated activations that generate and progress pipeline.
You will identify high-value audiences, segments and account concentrations, then determine and execute the right field marketing mix across Vena-led programs, partner-led activations, industry and community events, webinars and other targeted experiences. You will also extend Vena's corporate Marketing activations through the regional ecosystem, identifying opportunities to engage partners, customers, prospects and communities around priority market moments.
As the connection between UK & EMEA and Vena's primarily North America-based Marketing organization, you will bring regional market intelligence into GTM planning and adapt global campaigns, content and programs where regional relevance requires it.

This is a highly collaborative, hands-on role that works closely across Marketing, Sales, Enablement, Partners and Ecosystem, to turn regional opportunities into measurable business pipeline and revenue impact.
This is a highly collaborative, hands-on role that works closely across Marketing, Sales, Enablement, Partners and Ecosystem, to turn regional opportunities into measurable business pipeline and revenue impact.

How You'll Make an Impact

  • Manage UK & EMEA field marketing strategy and activation, translating regional market opportunity, target-account concentration, pipeline needs and Vena's GTM priorities into an integrated field marketing plan.
  • Identify and prioritize high-value segments, audiences and market opportunities using pipeline, account and market intelligence, then recommend the field marketing plays most likely to generate or progress demand.
  • Own the end-to-end execution of regional field programs, including Vena-led events, partner-led and co- in market activations, industry/community opportunities, webinars, and other targeted programs that drive results
  • Extend Vena's corporate event and campaign investments through the regional ecosystem, partnering with Vena's Events and Marketing teams to activate relevant partners, customers, prospects and communities around priority market moments.
  • Partner closely with Sales, Enablement, Ecosystem and broader Marketing organization to align to regional activation with target accounts, active pipeline and priority GTM plays.
  • Drive field activation from concept through conversion, including audience strategy, promotion, content requirements, vendors/logistics, attendee experience, lead capture, Sales follow-up and post-program nurture.
  • Measure success through qualified demand, pipeline creation, conversion and revenue impact, establishing clear tracking, attribution and reporting requirements.
  • Translate global Vena campaigns, content and enablement into regional activation, identifying where localization or regional requirements are needed and bringing those requirements back to the appropriate Marketing or Enablement owner.
  • Build strong relationships with UK & EMEA partners and identify where partner expertise, audiences, and distribution can strengthen GTM programs and shared pipeline goals.
  • Act as the regional market intelligence loop, ensuring regional insights, buyer feedback, field learnings, competitive intelligence and program performance flow back into broader marketing planning.
  • Travel (as required) to events
  • Other duties, as assigned.

We'd Love to See

  • 5+ years of experience in B2B field marketing, integrated demand generation or partner marketing, ideally within EPM SaaS or a high growth technology company.
  • Demonstrated ability to identify regional or segment-level growth opportunities and translate them into integrated field marketing programs that generate and progress pipeline.
  • Experience owning programs end to end, from audience and segmentation strategy through execution, Sales follow-up, and measurement of pipeline impact.
  • Demonstrated experience in executing repeatable in person programs and events that deliver our brand experience, elevate buyer and customer engagement and deliver measurable results.
  • Exceptional collaboration and relationship-building skills, with the ability to work effectively across Marketing, Sales, Enablement, Partners, Customer Success, and senior regional leaders.
  • A hands-on, team-first approach and willingness to move between strategic planning and detailed execution based on what the business needs, along with comfort proactively bridging time zone and communication gaps across a globally dispersed team.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to create or localize compelling content and messaging for North American buyers and sales teams.
  • Commercial and data-driven mindset with experience using pipeline, conversion, and campaign performance data to prioritize activity and evaluate impact.
  • Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple events, stakeholders, timelines, and follow-up actions concurrently.
  • Confidence engaging with external partners, customers, vendors, and senior stakeholders, including supporting executive-level and CFO/Finance audiences.
  • Interest in AI and willingness to explore AI-driven solutions to enhance performance and drive efficiencies
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience with HubSpot or similar marketing automation platforms.
  • Experience with Salesforce or similar CRM platforms, including campaign and pipeline reporting.
  • Experience marketing within or alongside the Microsoft ecosystem, including Microsoft partners, Marketplace or Microsoft-aligned GTM motions.

  • Experience implementing and managing privileged access management (CyberArk preferred) solutions

  • Experience implementing and managing IdP (Okta preferred) solutions

  • Experience collaborating with cyber threat management and insider threat teams to enable detection, monitoring, and incident response efforts

  • Ability to adapt and prioritize in a fast-paced work environment

  • Excellent written and oral communication skills

raw.description:
Location: Remote

Position Overview

Home is more than a place—it is where much of life unfolds. We are seeking a contract writer and photographer to create a visually rich, inspiring book that explores the beauty, meaning, and everyday experiences of home through photography, storytelling, Scripture, and biblical reflection. This project should encourage readers to see God's grace and presence in the ordinary rhythms of life, offering hope and inspiration for a variety of life stages, family structures, and living situations. The strongest proposals will demonstrate a compelling visual vision and a thoughtful approach to integrating photography with encouraging, Christ-centered content.

Scope of Work

  • Conceptualize, photograph, and write a highly visual book (approximately 20,000–30,000 words)
  • Develop content that thoughtfully integrates photography, Scripture, personal reflection, storytelling, and biblical encouragement
  • Collaborate closely with the editorial team through multiple rounds of revision
  • Work with the design and editorial teams to ensure strong integration between visual and written content

Commitment

Contract, per-project basis.

Compensation

Compensation is determined based on project scope and complexity.

Additional Information

Contractors are engaged based on the needs of specific projects and are not guaranteed ongoing or full-time work. Participation in meetings, workshops, or collaborative sessions may be requested depending on the project timeline.

Why Publish with The Daily Grace Co.?

With over a decade of publishing experience, The Daily Grace Co. creates Christ-centered resources marked by theological depth, biblical faithfulness, and practical encouragement. We value thoughtful, faithful writers and partner closely from concept development through launch. Our goal is not simply to publish books—but to serve readers with resources that meet real needs and help them treasure Christ.

Proposal Requirements


Important:Proposals that do not include all required components listed below cannot be reviewed.

Please submit all materials inasingle PDF(not a Word Doc or Google Doc) that includes:

1. Title and Subtitle

2. Controlling Idea (1–2 sentences)

3. One-Paragraph Summary

Provide a concise overview of the book’s purpose, scope, structure, and tone.

4. Target Audience Description (One of the Most Important Sections)Who this book is specifically for

  • Their stage or season of life
  • The particular struggles, questions, or longings they are experiencing
  • Why this book matters to them now
  • Tip: Specificity is essential. Broad descriptions such as “Christian women” or “believers” are not sufficient.

5. Comparable Titles (2–3 from the Past 5 Years)
Identify 2–3 comparable books published within the last five years and explain:

  • How your book overlaps with each one
  • How it is meaningfully distinct in approach, audience, tone, or theological emphasis

6. Author Bio

Explain what uniquely qualifies you to write this book, including:

  • Education
  • Ministry, counseling, academic, or professional experience
  • Subject-matter expertise
  • Lived experience relevant to the topic (if appropriate)
  • Previous publishing or writing experience

7. Detailed Chapter Outline

Provide a working table of contents that includes:

  • Chapter titles
  • The main idea of each chapter and how it supports the controlling idea of the book

8. Front and Back Matter (Optional)

Describe any supplemental materials (e.g., photography, illustrations, reflection questions, discussion guides, recommended resources, liturgies, appendices, etc.).

9. Timeline and Specifications

Include:

  • Current manuscript status (idea stage, in progress, complete, etc.)
  • Estimated total word count (typically 45,000–75,000 words)
  • Anticipated manuscript delivery date

10. Other Book Ideas (Optional)

If you have additional book concepts that may be a fit for The Daily Grace Co., please include a brief description of each idea (1–3 sentences per concept). While these ideas will not be considered part of the current proposal, they may be considered for future publishing opportunities.

11. Sample Material

  • The complete book introduction
  • Two fully written sample chapters representative of the final manuscript
Salary: Determined per project

CancerNavigator is a healthcare startup dedicated to supporting cancer patients in their hour of need.

Our Mission & Our Work, in Brief

Cancer is the number one cause of death for commercially insured Americans and the top cost driver for health plans. And, cancer patients are struggling.

CancerNavigator is a white-glove, end-to-end, cancer support service for patients and their families. We work with health plans across the country to provide 1-1 support to members facing a cancer diagnosis. Our support is delivered through dedicated Oncology Certified Nurses, who help members get to fantastic experts for their care and help them through the thousands of other problems that arise across the cancer journey.

Join us to serve cancer patients in their hour of need.

The “VP of Engineering” Role

Role and Team:

As VP of Engineering, you’ll join CancerNavigator at a pivotal stage of growth and have the opportunity to shape what our engineering function becomes. Reporting directly to the CEO, you’ll initially operate as a highly hands-on technical leader—setting the technical strategy, defining the roadmap, and building alongside the team. Over time, you’ll take on leadership of our existing technical resources and build out the engineering organization needed to support our next stage of scale.

This is not a role where you’ll inherit a mature engineering organization or a predefined roadmap. You’ll work closely with leaders across the business to understand how our service operates today, identify the highest-impact opportunities for technology, and determine what we should build, buy, automate, or redesign.

Daily Work:

This is a highly entrepreneurial, hands-on leadership role. You’ll have significant autonomy to shape both what we build and how engineering operates at CancerNavigator. You will:

  • Partner with our CEO and functional leaders to set the technical strategy and roadmap for the business.
  • Identify the highest-impact opportunities to use technology and AI to help our team serve more patients at scale.
  • Design and build foundational systems, particularly in the early stages of the role.
  • Lead the development of tools across patient navigation, communication, research, and healthcare data processing.
  • Grow and lead our engineering function, establishing the team, infrastructure, and practices we’ll need for our next stage of growth.

The Requirements

  • Engineering leadership experience, ideally in a VP Engineering, Head of Engineering, or similar role within a health tech company.
  • Strong experience building technology in healthcare, with a deep understanding of HIPAA and the security, privacy, and data considerations that come with handling sensitive health information.
  • A track record of taking complex technical problems from strategy through architecture and hands-on execution.
  • Experience building and scaling technology for a tech-enabled service or other operationally complex business.
  • Experience with modern data infrastructure and cloud-based systems, with familiarity in Python and SQL.
  • Experience applying AI to automate back-end workflows, augment human operations, and build real-world products.
  • An entrepreneurial, hands-on approach—you’re comfortable setting the strategy, operating with ambiguity, and rolling up your sleeves to build.

Strongly preferred: Experience working with medical claims, prior authorization, or other complex healthcare data.

Compensation and Benefits

  • Competitive salary and stock option package

TripleTen is an EdTech company that designs and runs tech career learning programs for the US and Latin American markets.
