Our team is fully remote and globally distributed, and we serve a large, active student base across both regions.

We are looking for Onboarding Sales Trainer to join our Sales Training team and own the onboarding and development of new sales hires working with the US market.

This is a hands-on role for a sales professional with leadership, coaching, or training experience who will lead two-week onboarding programs for new hires, develop practical sales skills, and maintain training materials. The role is fully remote, supports our LATAM-based sales team serving the US market, and requires native-level Spanish, fluent English.

What you will do

  • Lead end-to-end onboarding for new sales hires, running a structured two-week onboarding program for our LATAM-based sales team working with the US market.
  • Train regular cohorts of new hires — currently around 4–5 people once a month, with cohort sizes expected to grow to 10+ people as the team scales.
  • Develop practical sales skills, including discovery, probing, objection handling, closing, follow-up, negotiation, customer communication, and working with different customer profiles.
  • Train new hires on our product, sales processes, and day-to-day tools, including CRM systems, telephony, WhatsApp-based communication tools, and other digital sales platforms.
  • Run highly interactive training sessions using role plays, mock sales calls, real-life scenarios, demonstrations, practical exercises, and continuous feedback to make sure trainees can apply what they learn in real conversations.
  • Assess each trainee’s progress throughout the two weeks, identify individual gaps, adapt your coaching approach, and provide clear feedback on their readiness before handing them over to their Sales Supervisor.
  • Partner closely with Sales Supervisors and managers to ensure a smooth handover, share feedback on each trainee, and jointly investigate performance gaps if a new hire struggles after onboarding.
  • Maintain and improve onboarding materials, including presentations, scripts, exercises, guides, and process documentation, keeping them accurate and up to date whenever sales processes or operations change.
  • Use AI and modern productivity tools to create and improve training materials, scripts, presentations, exercises, and other onboarding content more efficiently.

Requirements

  • Hands-on sales experience. You should understand the full sales process from your own practical experience, not only from managing or training others.
  • 2+ years of leadership, team supervision, coaching, or sales management experience, ideally working directly with sales teams.
  • Native-level Spanish and fluent English, with the confidence to train, coach, and provide feedback in both languages.
  • Strong communication and facilitation skills — you can explain complex concepts simply, keep a group engaged, and adapt your communication style to different levels of experience.
  • Patience, empathy, and emotional maturity. You are comfortable working with struggling trainees, handling difficult conversations, receiving critical feedback, and resolving disagreements constructively.
  • Strong ownership and accountability. You can recognize when something is not working, admit mistakes, review the situation objectively, and adjust your approach rather than becoming defensive or blaming others.
  • Energy and charisma to motivate people, maintain engagement, and create a positive but demanding learning environment.
  • Comfort with digital tools and the ability to quickly learn new systems, including CRM, telephony, messaging, presentation, and online training tools.
  • Ability to work remotely with stable internet connectivity and availability aligned with Colombia working hours.

Nice-to-have:

  • Experience in B2C sales, especially high-ticket, consultative, or fast-paced sales where discovery, objection handling, negotiation, and closing happen directly with the customer.
  • Previous experience as a Sales Trainer, Sales Coach, Team Lead, Supervisor, or Sales Manager.
  • Experience coaching or developing underperforming salespeople and helping them improve through practice, feedback, and structured follow-up.
  • Experience working in high-volume sales environments, including call centers or similar teams.
  • Experience creating or maintaining training materials, scripts, presentations, onboarding guides, or process documentation.
  • Experience using AI and modern productivity tools to create or improve training content, scripts, exercises, presentations, or documentation.
  • Experience working with LATAM-based sales teams serving the US market.

What we can offer you

  • A supportive and proactive work environment.
  • Competitive compensation: 1000-2000 USD Gross per month
  • Fully remote and full-time collaboration.
  • Modern digital tools for seamless collaboration.
  • Tangible results measured by student success.

raw.description:
Join Runware as a Senior Machine Learning Engineer and be at the forefront of developing innovative AI solutions across various media modalities including text, image, video, 3D, and audio. We're building a powerful AI media creation platform designed to revolutionize how content is generated.

As a Senior Machine Learning Engineer, you’ll take the lead on critical projects, guiding the end-to-end lifecycle from research and experimentation to production deployment and performance monitoring. Your work will help shape the capabilities of our platform and enhance the experiences of users who rely on our cutting-edge AI technologies.

What You'll Be Doing

    • Integrate open-source and third-party models into our inference platform
    • Lead fine-tuning initiatives (LoRA, adapters, PEFT, domain adaptation)
    • Optimise inference workloads for latency, batching, memory efficiency, and throughput
    • Benchmark model quality vs cost vs performance across modalities
    • Improve inference startup times and stability under high load
    • Build evaluation frameworks and internal tooling for model validation
    • Work closely with Infrastructure and Backend teams on scalable serving systems
    • Monitor production performance and drive continuous optimisation
    • Mentor engineers and help raise the ML engineering bar across the team

Requirements

What We’re Looking For

    • Deep, hands-on expertise in Python and PyTorch, comfortable working at a level well beyond standard framework usage, including the quirks and edge cases that come with pushing Python for ML workloads
    • Demonstrated experience building ML applications and models yourself, not just running or deploying existing ones (e.g. serving a pre-built model via vLLM doesn't qualify on its own)
    • Hands-on experience writing GPU kernels in CUDA/C++, or in Triton
    • Low-level experience with model internals e.g. working directly with diffusion model architectures (diffusers or equivalent), not just calling high-level APIs
    • Experience with the PyTorch compiler (torch.compile) or comparable low-level PyTorch tooling
    • Practical experience fine-tuning large models as a repeatable service (LoRA, PEFT, adapters), built for speed and reuse across many models, not a single one-off training run
    • Real, verifiable project history e.g. GitHub repos, demonstrating what you have personally wrote
    • High ownership and comfort operating in a fast-paced startup environment

Nice to have

    • Experience optimizing inference workloads in GPU environments
    • Experience with vLLM or custom inference servers
    • Experience with diffusion models, LLMs, or multimodal architectures more broadly
    • Experience with Kubernetes, Docker, or containerised ML workloads
    • Experience building internal ML tooling or developer-facing APIs
    • Experience working in high-throughput distributed systems
    • Background in AI media generation (image, video, audio)

Benefits

We’re a remote-first team that comes together in person twice a year to plan, collaborate, and celebrate wins. Day to day we keep a few core hours for teamwork, but outside of that you set the schedule that helps you do your best work.

Our environment is fast-moving and ambitious. Big pushes are part of building category-defining products, but we balance that with flexible working, generous time off, and regular retreats so the team can stay sharp and motivated.

    • Generous paid time off – vacation, sick days, public holidays
    • Meaningful stock options – share in the upside you create
    • Remote-first setup – work from home anywhere we can employ you
    • Flexible hours – own your schedule outside core collaboration blocks
    • Family leave – paid maternity, paternity, and caregiver time
    • Company retreats – twice-yearly gatherings in inspiring locations

Our Engineering Culture…

raw.description:
We’re looking for a Staff/Senior Software Engineer to technically lead and build Runware’s serverless platform. You’ll be part of a small team working closely with senior leadership to bring a new product line to market.

Runware is evolving beyond model APIs into a platform where developers can deploy models and run AI workloads without managing GPUs, servers or infrastructure. You’ll build the software layer that connects our proprietary high-performance sonic inference engine and turns complex infrastructure into a compelling developer experience.

This is a role for someone who enjoys technical leadership, hard platform problems and clean, simple systems. Your work will help enterprises, model labs and developers move from idea to production faster, then scale without needing to build and operate the infrastructure themselves.

What you’ll do

  • Build the core systems behind Runware’s serverless platform, including workload execution, routing, scheduling, isolation and scaling leveraging our inference engine
  • Make it simple for developers to deploy models and run AI workloads without managing GPUs, servers, queues or infrastructure through a simple SDK interface
  • Design and improve the control plane for serverless execution, including APIs, workers, lifecycle management, retries and failure handling
  • Work closely with our infrastructure and ML teams to improve workload startup time, GPU utilisation, model warm-up, caching and placement
  • Build observability that makes serverless workloads easy to monitor, debug and operate at scale globally
  • Lead the technical design, mentor other engineers and help define the engineering standards for a new product area

Requirements

  • Strong experience as a Staff Engineer, Senior Software Engineer, Backend Engineer, Platform Engineer or similar
  • Experience building backend services, distributed systems, developer platforms or workload orchestration systems
  • Strong understanding of async processing, queues, scheduling, retries, back pressure and failure handling
  • Comfortable working across APIs, control planes, workers, databases and observability systems
  • Strong engineering fundamentals in one or more backend languages ideally Go
  • Good judgement around trade-offs between reliability, latency, scale, cost and developer experience
  • Clear communication, strong ownership and the ability to lead technical direction in a fast-moving environment

Nice to have

  • Experience building serverless platforms, job execution systems, container platforms or compute orchestration systems
  • Experience with GPU-backed workloads, AI/ML inference, model serving, batch processing or high-performance compute
  • Familiarity with technologies such as vLLM, TensorRT, Triton, Kubernetes, Nomad or Knative
  • Experience improving workload performance through batching, autoscaling, model warm-up, caching, request routing or queue management
  • Experience with multi-tenant isolation, sandboxing, quotas, rate limits, resource accounting or usage-based billing

Benefits

We’re a remote-first collective, meeting in person twice a year to plan, brainstorm, celebrate wins, and enjoy some face-to-face time. We have core hours for cooperative working and calls, but outside of that your calendar is yours. Work the hours that let you perform at your peak while also building a healthy life.

Our release cycles are fast and intense, but they’re followed by real downtime. After big pushes we expect the team to unplug, recharge, and come back ready & stronger than ever for the next leap.

  • Generous paid time off – vacation, sick days, public holidays
  • Meaningful stock options – share in the upside you create
  • Remote-first setup – work from home anywhere we can employ you
  • Flexible hours – own your schedule outside core collaboration blocks
  • Family leave – paid maternity, paternity, and caregiver time
  • Company retreats – twice-yearly gatherings in inspiring locations

Our client is a U.S.-based technology company working with large-scale geospatial data and imagery.

We are looking for an experienced Backend & Data Engineer to join their data team, with an expected start as soon as possible.

This role combines software engineering, backend development, and data processing with specialized hands-on experience in GIS, photogrammetry, and geospatial imagery processing.

The engineer will work daily with core processing systems and large-scale imagery captured from drones (UAVs), fixed-wing aircraft, and/or high-resolution satellite sources.

Strong AWS experience is a significant plus.

• Strong professional experience in software engineering, backend engineering, and/or data engineering.

• Strong proficiency in Python.

• Hands-on professional experience with GIS and geospatial data processing.
• Hands-on experience with photogrammetry and imagery processing.
• Proven experience processing imagery from at least one of the following sources:

  • Drones / UAVs
  • Fixed-wing aircraft
  • High-resolution satellite imagery
    • Practical experience with geospatial and photogrammetry tools or libraries such as GDAL, Agisoft Metashape, Pix4D, or similar technologies.

raw.title: Contract Writer for a Bible Study
raw.excerpt: Location: RemotePosition OverviewWe are seeking contract writers to develop Christ-centered Bible studies.
raw.description:
Location: Remote

Position Overview

We are seeking contract writers to develop Christ-centered Bible studies. These studies should offer in-depth theology readers can truly understand—grounded in careful exegesis and a Christ-centered hermeneutic—while remaining accessible to serious lay readers and church groups. Our aim is not merely to inform but to cultivate spiritual transformation, helping readers experience the grace of Jesus and grow in faithful obedience.

Scope of Work

  • Research, outline, and write a complete Bible study in Daily Grace's Bible study format
  • Write with theological depth that remains clear and understandable
  • Intentionally guide readers toward spiritual formation and lived obedience
  • Maintain an ecumenical tone when engaging theological issues and interpretive differences
  • Collaborate with the editorial team through multiple rounds of review and revision
  • Ensure theological alignment with the organization’s doctrinal commitment

Qualifications

  • Master of Divinity (M.Div.) or another advanced theological degree strongly preferred
  • Demonstrated competency in biblical exegesis
  • A clearly articulated Christ-centered hermeneutic
  • Experience writing or teaching Bible studies for lay audiences
  • Ability to communicate complex theological ideas with clarity and pastoral sensitivity
  • Comfortable collaborating within a team-based editorial process
  • Willingness to receive and implement substantive feedback

Commitment

Contract, per-project basis.

Compensation

Compensation is determined based on project scope and complexity.

Additional Information

Contractors are engaged based on the needs of specific projects and are not guaranteed ongoing or full-time work. Participation in meetings, workshops, or collaborative sessions may be requested depending on the project timeline.

Why Publish with The Daily Grace Co.?

With over a decade of publishing experience, The Daily Grace Co. creates Christ-centered resources marked by theological depth, biblical faithfulness, and practical encouragement. We value thoughtful, faithful writers and partner closely from concept development through launch. Our goal is not simply to publish Bible studies—but to serve readers with resources that meet real needs and help them treasure Christ.

Proposal Requirements


Important: Proposals that do not include all required components listed below cannot be reviewed.

Please submit all materials in a single document and include:

1. Suggested title and subtitle.

2. Controlling idea of the Bible study: In one sentence, state the central theological message of the biblical text as this study will present it, and the transformation it aims to produce in the reader.
3. A summary of resources that will be used and how they will inform your theological approach: Describe the key sources that will inform your interpretation and application of this biblical text, including commentaries or theological works, and explain how these sources shape your approach and serve the intended reader.
4. A list of potential theological issues and interpretive issues: Provide a brief list of potential theological tensions, debated interpretive issues, or common application pitfalls that arise from this biblical text, and explain how you plan to address them faithfully and in accordance with TDGC’s ecumenical approach.

5. Target audience description: Explain who is this Bible study written for and why it matters to them.

6. Comparable titles: Include 2–3 comparable Bible studies and explain how this study is distinct from each one.

7. Author bio: Explain what makes you uniquely qualified to write this book.

8. Complete Bible study outline: For each day of the study, please include the passage to be studied and a one sentence summary of the the main idea of the passage. It should be clear how the outline supports the controlling idea. Except for year-long Bible studies, each week of the study should contain 5 days of study content and two rest days.
9. Three complete sample Bible study days: Please include at least three sample days of the study. Each day should provide 750–1000 words of commentary on one passage of Scripture. The commentary should be engaging, informational, Christ-centered, and should offer specific real-life points of application. It should also include two questions for reflection and application and one prayer prompt.
10. Front and back matter: describe any supplemental material the Bible study will include such as maps, charts, illustrations, timelines, etc.

11. Timeline and specifications: include current manuscript status (work in progress, complete, etc.), anticipated manuscript delivery date, and any other information that is relevant to provide.

Bible Study Topics of Particular Interest

We are especially interested in proposals in the following categories:

Expositional Studies

  • Leviticus
  • Deuteronomy
  • Ezra
  • Proverbs
  • Song of Songs
  • Jeremiah
  • Matthew
  • 1 & 2 Corinthians (one cohesive study covering both books)
  • 1 & 2 Timothy

Topical Exposition Studies

  • Forgiveness
  • Creating and Living a Rule of Life
  • Addressing Current Cultural Issues
  • God’s Goodness
  • Developing Biblical Discernment
  • Marriage

Studies to Guide Readers Through Church Calendar Seasons

  • Lent
  • Advent

Year-Long Studies

  • 52-Week Studies
  • 365-Day Studies
Salary: Determined per project

Description

TripleTen is an EdTech company that designs and runs tech career learning programs for the US and Latin American markets. We've been doing it for over five years, teaching complete beginners — people with no prior tech background — through cohort-based programs built on our own platform and curriculum, developed in partnership with Nebius AI. Our team is fully remote and globally distributed, and we serve a large, active student base across both regions.

We are looking for Onboarding Sales Trainer to join our Sales Training team and own the onboarding and development of new sales hires working with the US market.

This is a hands-on role for a sales professional with leadership, coaching, or training experience who will lead two-week onboarding programs for new hires, develop practical sales skills, and maintain training materials. The role is fully remote, supports our LATAM-based sales team serving the US market, and requires native-level Spanish, fluent English.

What you will do

  • Lead end-to-end onboarding for new sales hires, running a structured two-week onboarding program for our LATAM-based sales team working with the US market.
  • Train regular cohorts of new hires — currently around 4–5 people once a month, with cohort sizes expected to grow to 10+ people as the team scales.
  • Develop practical sales skills, including discovery, probing, objection handling, closing, follow-up, negotiation, customer communication, and working with different customer profiles.
  • Train new hires on our product, sales processes, and day-to-day tools, including CRM systems, telephony, WhatsApp-based communication tools, and other digital sales platforms.
  • Run highly interactive training sessions using role plays, mock sales calls, real-life scenarios, demonstrations, practical exercises, and continuous feedback to make sure trainees can apply what they learn in real conversations.
  • Assess each trainee’s progress throughout the two weeks, identify individual gaps, adapt your coaching approach, and provide clear feedback on their readiness before handing them over to their Sales Supervisor.
  • Partner closely with Sales Supervisors and managers to ensure a smooth handover, share feedback on each trainee, and jointly investigate performance gaps if a new hire struggles after onboarding.
  • Maintain and improve onboarding materials, including presentations, scripts, exercises, guides, and process documentation, keeping them accurate and up to date whenever sales processes or operations change.
  • Use AI and modern productivity tools to create and improve training materials, scripts, presentations, exercises, and other onboarding content more efficiently.

Requirements

  • Hands-on sales experience. You should understand the full sales process from your own practical experience, not only from managing or training others.
  • 2+ years of leadership, team supervision, coaching, or sales management experience, ideally working directly with sales teams.
  • Native-level Spanish and fluent English, with the confidence to train, coach, and provide feedback in both languages.
  • Strong communication and facilitation skills — you can explain complex concepts simply, keep a group engaged, and adapt your communication style to different levels of experience.
  • Patience, empathy, and emotional maturity. You are comfortable working with struggling trainees, handling difficult conversations, receiving critical feedback, and resolving disagreements constructively.
  • Strong ownership and accountability. You can recognize when something is not working, admit mistakes, review the situation objectively, and adjust your approach rather than becoming defensive or blaming others.
  • Energy and charisma to motivate people, maintain engagement, and create a positive but demanding learning environment.
  • Comfort with digital tools and the ability to quickly learn new systems, including CRM, telephony, messaging, presentation, and online training tools.
  • Ability to work remotely with stable internet connectivity and availability aligned with Colombia working hours.

Nice-to-have:

  • Experience in B2C sales, especially high-ticket, consultative, or fast-paced sales where discovery, objection handling, negotiation, and closing happen directly with the customer.
  • Previous experience as a Sales Trainer, Sales Coach, Team Lead, Supervisor, or Sales Manager.
  • Experience coaching or developing underperforming salespeople and helping them improve through practice, feedback, and structured follow-up.
  • Experience working in high-volume sales environments, including call centers or similar teams.
  • Experience creating or maintaining training materials, scripts, presentations, onboarding guides, or process documentation.
  • Experience using AI and modern productivity tools to create or improve training content, scripts, exercises, presentations, or documentation.
  • Experience working with LATAM-based sales teams serving the US market.

What we can offer you

  • A supportive and proactive work environment.
  • Competitive compensation: 1000-2000 USD Gross per month
  • Fully remote and full-time collaboration.
  • Modern digital tools for seamless collaboration.
  • Tangible results measured by student success.

Job Summary:

Responsible for the performance of tasks related to application implementation, adoption, enhancement, and support. This includes but is not limited to analysis, development, training, testing, documentation, go-live and on-going support, problem resolution, and maintenance.

Job Duties:

  • Develops a strong understanding of assigned application(s).
  • Meets with relevant personnel to perform data collection through discussions, workflow observations and document review. Develops an understanding of best practice workflows. Identifies opportunities to modify current state workflows to increase efficiency or effectiveness.
  • Produces documentation including current and future state workflows, pros/cons, gap analysis, needs assessments, design specifications, build documentation, test plans, project plans, status reports and transitionary documentation.
  • Performs application testing including unit and scenario-based testing.
  • Learns to apply critical thinking to problem solving and strives to understand the root cause of the issue.
  • Communicates effectively with peers, informaticians, stakeholders, project teams, and leadership. Provides regular updates regarding work status via standard documentation tools and/or huddles, meetings, etc. Learns and begins to apply appropriate issue escalation.
  • Completes system build and documentation in accordance with department guidelines and in adherence to change management policy.
  • Actively participates in meetings by being an engaged listener and offering both feedback and input.
  • Prepares training material and conducts training classes in either virtual or in-person settings.
  • Adheres to best practices regarding information security.
  • Participates in team on-call rotation to provide 24x7x365 support to assigned areas.
  • Provides remote and/or on-site support as needed to end-users.
  • Supports system upgrades, patches, and monitoring.
  • Assists in the preparation of department guidelines, standards, procedures, and policies.
  • Participates in vendor review and selection processes.
  • Participates in testing the integration and technical requirements of peripherals and devices that interface with or integrate with assigned applications. Examples include laboratory instruments, radiology modalities, medication cabinets, printers, and scanners.
  • Performs other duties as required or assigned by emergency or other operational reasons for which the employee is qualified to perform.

Work is typically performed in an on-campus or home office environment. Accountable for satisfying all job specific obligations and complying with all organization policies and procedures. The specific statements in this profile are not intended to be all-inclusive. They represent typical elements considered necessary to successfully perform the job.

*Relevant experience may be a combination of related work experience and degree obtained (Associate’s Degree = 2 years; Bachelor’s Degree = 4 years).

Position Details:


Preferred Government Programs, Business & Technical Analysis Experience:


  • Demonstrated experience supporting Medicare, Medicaid, Dual Eligible, and other government-sponsored healthcare programs.
  • Proven ability to perform business analysis and technical analysis, including gathering, documenting, and translating business, operational, and regulatory requirements into system solutions.
  • Strong understanding of healthcare payer operations, CMS regulations, compliance requirements, and government program processes.
  • Experience partnering with business stakeholders and technical teams to analyze processes, define requirements, support system enhancements, and implement regulatory initiatives.
  • Experience with requirements management, data analysis, testing, system integration, and production support in a regulated healthcare environment.
  • Knowledge of healthcare administration systems, data flows, reporting, and technology solutions supporting government programs.

Education:

High School Diploma or Equivalent (GED)- (Required)

Experience:

Minimum of 2 years-Relevant experience* (Required)

Certification(s) and License(s):

Skills:

Communication, Critical Thinking, Interpersonal Communication

OUR PURPOSE & VALUES: Everything we do is about caring for our patients, our members, our students, our Geisinger family and our communities.

  • KINDNESS: We strive to treat everyone as we would hope to be treated ourselves.
  • EXCELLENCE: We treasure colleagues who humbly strive for excellence.
  • LEARNING: We share our knowledge with the best and brightest to better prepare the caregivers for tomorrow.
  • INNOVATION: We constantly seek new and better ways to care for our patients, our members, our community, and the nation.
  • SAFETY: We provide a safe environment for our patients and members and the Geisinger family.

We offer healthcare benefits for full time and part time positions from day one, including vision, dental and domestic partners. Perhaps just as important, we encourage an atmosphere of collaboration, cooperation and collegiality.

raw.description:
What are we building?

Hard Rock Digital is a team focused on becoming the best online sportsbook, casino, and social casino company in the world. We're building a team that resonates passion for learning, operating, and building new products and technologies for millions of consumers. We care about each customer's interaction, experience, behavior, and insight and strive to ensure we're always acting authentically.

Rooted in the kindred spirits of Hard Rock and the Seminole Tribe of Florida, the new Hard Rock Digital taps a brand known the world over as the leader in gaming, entertainment, and hospitality. We're taking that foundation of success and bringing it to the digital space — ready to join us?

What's the position?

We are looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to join our Quantitative Sports team. We’re building the next generation of our in‑house pricing engine — a low‑latency, high‑throughput system that powers live odds for millions of users. As a Senior Backend Engineer, you’ll own major architectural decisions, partner directly with quantitative analysts, and shape the core backend that drives our sportsbook.

This is a high‑impact role with significant autonomy. If you thrive in fast‑moving environments and love solving complex real‑time engineering challenges, you’ll feel at home here.

What You’ll Do

  • Architect and build backend services that operate reliably under intense data and user load

  • Reduce system latency and optimize real‑time performance across the pricing pipeline

  • Collaborate closely with quantitative developers to integrate models and pricing logic

  • Design and maintain ingestion pipelines for multiple live data feeds

  • Implement robust testing and monitoring to ensure system resilience

  • Build internal tools that support trading, operations, and analytics teams

  • Contribute to technical strategy and long‑term platform evolution

  • Foster a culture of knowledge sharing and engineering excellence

Requirements

Core Requirements

  • 8+ years of backend engineering experience

  • Deep proficiency in Python for production systems

  • Experience with low‑latency, real‑time, or high‑throughput systems

  • Background in multi‑feed ingestion architectures

  • Strong understanding of microservices and distributed systems

  • Experience deploying and operating systems in AWS

  • Familiarity with relational databases (Postgres, MySQL)

  • Experience with analytical stores (Snowflake, ClickHouse)

  • Strong knowledge of messaging systems (Kafka, RabbitMQ)

  • Excellent communication skills and comfort working cross‑functionally

Bonus Points

  • Experience with pricing engines, trading algorithms, or live odds generation

  • Interest in sports and sport analytics

  • Familiarity with game state feeds such-as Radar & Genius

  • Prior hands-on experience in sportsbook platforms is highly desirable

Who you are

  • Self-driven and comfortable owning large areas of the system

  • Meticulous in your approach to testing, reliability, and performance

  • Able to prioritize effectively in a fast-paced environment

  • Excited by complex technical challenges and real-time systems

What’s In It for You?

We offer our employees more than just competitive compensation. Our team benefits include:

  • Competitive pay and benefits.

  • Flexible vacation allowance.

  • A hybrid / remote working environment.

  • Startup culture backed by a secure, global brand.

Roster of Uniques

We care deeply about every interaction our customers have with us, and trust and empower our staff to own and drive their experience. Our vision for our business and customers is built on fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment where regardless of background or beliefs you feel able to be authentic and bring all your talent into play. We want to celebrate you being you (we are an equal opportunity employer).

raw.excerpt: WHAT WE DO At Vocalytics, we make understanding noisy spaces simple, robust, and actionable.
raw.description:
WHAT WE DO

At Vocalytics, we make understanding noisy spaces simple, robust, and actionable. Vocalytics partners with hospitals, commercial real estate, smart cities, and governments to provide the most actionable acoustic intelligence for any space.

Backed by top VC's & Angels, we’re growing fast, building the most powerful sound intelligence platform for the physical world.

Sound is everywhere - indoors, outdoors, underwater, and in the sky.

The past couple of years have proven noise in hospital rooms is especially painful.

It leads to poor experience, life-threatening outcomes, and costs hospitals more than $40B every year.

That’s a lot of lives at stake and a very expensive problem to solve.

Vocalytics was founded to unlock value in today’s noisy world from any connected microphone. Never has this mission been more important in a world that is more socially distanced and health-conscious.

Privacy is a fundamental human right, and trust is a core pillar of everything we build.

We are seeking a sr. full-stack engineer to help build the next version of our platform. This is a hands-on role we would like to see grow into leadership as we're moving quickly to serve a very challenged population in healthcare.

ABOUT THE JOB

As a key engineering role, you will be a foundational member of the growing Vocalytics engineering team. Our engineering team supports multiple hospitals, commercial real estate, and other enterprise facilities, with the most robust sound analytics and a fleet of edge based IoT devices. Our software is edge-based and must process thousands of sound events per minute. API’s, databases, analytics, reporting, data retention policies, device fleet management, and more are areas of active development. We also have teams working on embedded systems, computer vision, machine learning, mobile applications, and web interfaces and services. We use a variety of tools, which we regularly evaluate to make sure developer productivity is protected, if not enhanced. We rely heavily on automation.

ABOUT YOU

Responsibilities

  1. Design and create the core software for Vocalytics’ internal and customer-facing services. Write, review, and implement software architecture proposals in compliance with edge best practices.
  2. Be a foundational leader of our engineering team and work collaboratively with other developers on the team. Work collaboratively with DevOps, Product Design, Embedded Systems, AI/ML/Data Science, and other teams at Vocalytics.
  3. Test and document your work.

Qualifications

  1. Bachelor’s degree and/or Master’s degree, preferably in Computer Science, or equivalent experience.
  2. Proficient in ReactJS, NodeJS, Google Vue, and programming with CS training. Familiarity with Typescript or npm is desirable.
  3. Proficient in back-end programming in Python, preferably with FastAPI, Alembic, PostgresSQL, Pytorch/Tensorflow, and audio processing experience.
  4. Experience with Docker/Kubernetes is desirable.
  5. Recent participation in software development and deployment on a Tier 1 cloud service provider, IoT applications, machine learning, or embedded systems.
  6. Experience with wireless networking protocols, systems, and optimizing signal strength/coverage via wifi, PoE, cellular, LoRa, etc.
  7. Excited about working in a fast-paced, dynamic startup environment.
  8. Nice to have (and a bonus if interested in learning!):
    1. Natural Language Processing, Transformers, Deep Convolutional Neural Networks.
    2. Sound Source Localization, Beamforming, Scene Classification.
    3. Security, Encryption, and Anonymization Techniques.
    4. AWS EC2, S3, Sagemaker, Greengrass.

Vocalytics is your opportunity to join a fast-growing seed-stage startup solving real-world problems. Our management has built successful startups, so we understand work/life balance, don’t take ourselves too seriously, and value everyone.

CAREERS

Vocalytics is committed to equal employment opportunities and providing employees with a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. All employment decisions are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications. Vocalytics encourages applicants of all ages.

NOTE TO RECRUITERS

Vocalytics will not accept unsolicited resumes from any source other than directly from a candidate. Any unsolicited resumes sent to Vocalytics, including unsolicited resumes sent to a Vocalytics mailing address, email address, directly to Vocalytics employees, or to the Vocalytics resume database will be considered Vocalytics property. Vocalytics will NOT pay a fee for any placement resulting from the receipt of an unsolicited resume. Vocalytics will consider any candidate for whom an Agency has submitted an unsolicited resume to have been referred by the Agency free of any charges or fees.

raw.description:
Job Title: Director, Major Gifts

Organizational Unit: Development

Reports To: Chief Development Officer

Supervises: Mid-level Giving & Prospecting Officer

Location: Equality Now is a remote organization. This position may be based in Massachusetts, New Jersey, New York, Virginia, or Washington, D.C., with a strong preference for candidates based in New York.

MISSION OBJECTIVE:

The Director, Major Gifts plays a pivotal role in advancing Equality Now’s global mission by leading and growing a major gifts portfolio, including gala sponsorships, mid-level giving and donor engagement. In partnership with the Chief Development Officer and Chief Executive Officer, the Director translates Equality Now’s development strategy into actionable fundraising plans, strengthens donor pipelines and systems, and cultivates meaningful relationships with individuals, family foundations, and philanthropic networks.This role spans strategy, donor cultivation and stewardship, portfolio management, events, executive engagement, and team leadership, and collaborates closely with Annual Giving & Development Operations functions. It requires an experienced fundraising leader with sound judgment, strong relationship-management skills, cross-cultural fluency, and the ability to translate Equality Now’s complex legal and programmatic work into compelling opportunities for philanthropic investment.

The Director will have the opportunity to shape and strengthen Equality Now’s Individual and Major Giving program during an important period of organizational growth. The successful candidate must be comfortable building systems, navigating complexity, inspiring donors and colleagues, and building the capacity of supervisee(s) and other junior staff focused on securing sustainable revenue to advance legal and systemic change for women and girls worldwide.

MAJOR DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

The following provides a general outline of the role. It is not exhaustive, and responsibilities may evolve at the discretion of the CDO based on organizational needs and priorities.

Purpose: Innovate for Mission Expansion

  • Serve as the senior lead for operationalizing the Individual & Major Giving strategy, translating our 2026-2030 development strategy into actionable plans, systems, and donor pathways across the full Individual Giving portfolio.
  • Drive the execution and refinement of Equality Now’s high-touch major donor growth strategy, including implementing a network-mapping approach, strengthening Advisory Board and Ambassador engagement, building individualized strategies for UHNW, and designing innovative donor/prospect engagement initiatives (eg-salons, donor cohorts, donor journeys, in-kind/volunteer opportunities for mission impact)
  • Partner with the CEO and CDO to support high-value donor/prospect cultivation and shape donor-facing opportunities aligned with organizational priorities, advising on donor motivations, portfolio insights, and potential engagement opportunities.
  • Provide strategic leadership to align all tiers of individual giving—major gifts, gala sponsorships, mid-level, and annual giving—ensuring cohesive messaging, clear donor journeys, and seamless handoffs between donor segments.
  • Lead maintenance and continuous improvement of pipeline development and tracking practices, including
    donor qualification, engagement strategies, moves management, and standardized systems that enhance efficiency, clarity, and visibility across the portfolio.
  • Lead/guide the development of donor-facing cases for support, investment opportunities, and strategic offerings, ensuring they reflect Equality Now’s mission, program vision, and funder-aligned messaging.

Engagement: Advocate

  • Manage a portfolio of high-value donors and prospects, cultivating deep, trust-based relationships with individuals and family foundations capable of $10,000–$250,000+ giving, while identifying opportunities and supporting leadership-level engagement.
  • Support CEO and CDO engagement with top-tier donors and prospects, preparing strategic briefings, donor intelligence, outreach recommendations, follow-up plans, and bespoke cultivation opportunities.
  • Oversee and elevate the mid-level donor program, ensuring a compelling donor journey that supports upgrades and helps to surface and convert major donor prospects.
  • Engage and activate Advisory Board members and other supporters and ambassadors, partnering with them to leverage networks, cultivate prospective donors, support events, and build community around Equality Now.
  • Serve as an external ambassador for Equality Now, representing the mission with fluency in global women’s rights and human rights–cultivating relationships and expanding networks in philanthropic and peer spaces.
  • Ensure donor experiences reflect mission-driven, community-centered engagement, including opportunities to meet international staff, join learning conversations, attend cultivation events, and participate in curated donor experiences.
  • Strengthen departmental and cross-departmental collaboration, to ensure donor messaging is programmatically accurate, compelling, and aligned with organizational impact narratives, and that the development program gains efficiencies and effectiveness through collaboration across corporate, institutional and individual giving.

Delivery: Define Project Cycle

  • Lead the operational management of the entire Major & Mid-levelGiving portfolio, overseeing processes, timelines, deliverables, and performance standards across major gifts, gala sponsorships, mid-level giving, and annual giving.
  • Implement and oversee strong systems for donor/prospect planning and tracking, including moves management, portfolio assignment, forecasting, and performance analytics, ensuring leadership always has clear visibility into pipeline health.
  • Partner with the Manager, Annual Fund & Development Operations, to ensure excellence in development operations, data integrity, analytics, and annual fund growth strategies.
  • Contribute to the planning and execution of high-impact donor events with Comms & Development colleagues, including the gala, cultivation salons, and community-building convenings, ensuring events advance the 2026-2030 development strategy and build momentum for donor/prospect engagement and pipeline development.
  • Develop individualized donor strategies and annual engagement plans, ensuring they are tailored to the donors’ interests, mission-centered, and coordinated with leadership involvement and organizational priorities and opportunities.
  • Produce high-quality donor communications and materials, partnering with Programs and Communications to prepare proposals, impact updates, donor briefings and reports, strategic correspondence, and leadership-level messaging.
  • Ensure accurate reporting, analytics, and revenue projections, synthesizing donor engagement metrics, portfolio movement, and pipeline health to support leadership decision-making and organizational planning.
  • Drive continuous learning and adaptive planning, integrating donor insights, event performance, campaign outcomes, and Strategic Plan benchmarks into ongoing improvements to Major Giving and Mid-level gift operations.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES:

This position supervises staff and is responsible for providing leadership, guidance, development, and performance management. Responsibilities may evolve based on organizational needs.

Leadership and Team Management

  • Provide clear direction, priorities, and performance expectations to direct reports.
  • Hold regular check-ins, monitor performance, provide timely feedback, and support professional growth.
  • Foster an inclusive, accountable, transparent, and high-performing team culture.
  • Address operational and personnel issues promptly, fairly, and in coordination with People & Culture when appropriate.

Performance and Development

  • Conduct performance reviews and identify individual and team development needs.
  • Coach and mentor staff to strengthen fundraising, leadership, and interpersonal skills.
  • Promote cross-functional learning and knowledge sharing.

Operations and Workflow

  • Manage workflows, priorities, workloads, leave, and coverage to maintain operational continuity.
  • Monitor progress, quality, and outcomes against agreed objectives.
  • Hold regular team meetings to communicate priorities, share updates, and address challenges.

Compliance and Collaboration

  • Ensure adherence to organizational policies, ethical standards, safeguarding requirements, and applicable laws.
  • Facilitate effective communication and collaboration across departments and leadership.
  • Model Equality Now’s values of integrity and accountability, inclusiveness, resilience, and empathy.

POSITION REQUIREMENTS & TARGET SKILLS PROFILE:
The Director will be thoroughly committed to Equality Now’s mission. The position requires deep subject-matter expertise, visionary leadership, and functional integration capacity. Specific requirements include:

Substantive Knowledge

  • Deep expertise in major gift fundraising, high-touch donor engagement strategies, and best practice moves management, ideally in a global nonprofit setting, with demonstrated success in securing 5–7 figure gifts from individuals and family foundations
  • Strong understanding or direct experience in event fundraising, high-touch donor engagement and strengthening development operations and workflows.
  • Familiarity with global human rights, women’s rights and gender equality funding landscapes (highly desirable). Understanding of legal, advocacy and movement building approaches is a plus.
  • Proven ability to manage, mentor and develop staff.


Communication Skills

  • Fluent in English; proficiency in Spanish, French, or Arabic is a plus.
  • Adept at fostering cross-cultural collaboration and cultivating trust-based relationships consistent with the mission and values of Equality Now.
  • Exceptional donor relationship management and communication skills, with a demonstrated aptitude for translating complex legal, financial, and programmatic concepts into compelling, polished, audience-specific decks, proposals and cases for support.
  • Strong listening, verbal and interpersonal skills to engage professionally and effectively with HNW donors, senior leadership, partners, and staff across geographies and cultures.
  • Adept at facilitating cross-functional collaboration, ensuring clarity, transparency, and strategic alignment between Development, Programs, and Finance, while fostering trust, accountability, and mutual respect across diverse and dispersed teams.


Execution Skills

  • Demonstrated leadership experience, with a focus on strategic delivery and operational excellence.
  • Proven ability to recruit, mentor, and manage staff, fellows, and consultants, fostering high-performing, accountable teams, while modeling inclusive leadership, ensuring all voices are heard, valued, and meaningfully integrated into decision-making processes.
  • Strategic and creative thinker with a record of translating vision into measurable outcomes.
  • Strong project management skills with a track record of meeting deadlines and producing high-quality deliverables in fast-paced environments.
  • Highly organized, results-oriented, and adaptable, with experience in database management (Raiser’s Edge NXT or equivalent).
  • Willingness and ability to travel internationally and domestically, sometimes on short notice, to support regional teams, engage with partners, and represent Equality Now.

Targeted Specialized Knowledge

  • Bachelor's degree required, Master’s degree, Continuing Education or significant professional experience in relevant fields is highly desired (e.g., International Relations, Nonprofit Management, Public Policy, Law, Human Rights, CFRE certification, etc)
  • 10+ years of progressively responsible fundraising experience, including substantial, independent donor-facing work and staff/program management responsibilities.
  • Demonstrated success working in a global human rights, gender equality, or related international NGO context, with proven ability to navigate diverse and complex organizations is preferred.

COMPENSATION:

At Equality Now, our compensation philosophy reflects our commitment to advancing the human rights of women and girls through lasting legal and systemic change. We approach pay holistically, recognizing base salary as one part of a broader total rewards package designed to support employee wellbeing, growth, and long-term engagement.

  • Base Salary Range: $120,000–$140,000 USD

The final offer will be determined based on several factors, including geographic location, relevant experience, demonstrated skills, qualifications, and internal equity. Equality Now also provides a comprehensive total rewards package, including health and retirement benefits, generous leave, and professional development opportunities.

HOW TO APPLY:

Applicants must submit a resume or CV and a cover letter. Incomplete applications will not be considered. The application period will close at 11:59 p.m. Eastern Time on September 30, 2026. Due to the anticipated volume of applications, only shortlisted candidates will be contacted for an interview.

Equality Now is strong because it is diverse. We actively seek a diverse applicant pool and encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply. Equality Now is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employees are selected based on their qualifications and ability, without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, language, political or other opinion, nationality, ethnic or social origin, disability, pregnancy, mental status, HIV status, age, marital status, sexual orientation, or any other status protected by applicable law. We welcome and value all forms of diversity.

Salary: Base Salary Range: $120,000 - $140,000 USD

raw.description:
Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States. This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title

Lead Software Architect

Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $175,000–$200,000 Annually
Experience Required:10+ Years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary

We are seeking a highly accomplished Lead Software Architect with 10+ years of professional software engineering experience to lead enterprise-wide architecture initiatives, define long-term technology strategy, and deliver highly scalable, resilient, and secure distributed systems. This role represents one of the highest levels of individual technical contribution within the organization, requiring deep expertise in software architecture, cloud-native technologies, distributed systems, performance engineering, and technical leadership. The ideal candidate will influence engineering strategy across multiple organizations, establish architectural standards, mentor senior engineers, and drive the successful delivery of mission-critical platforms.

Key Responsibilities

  • Define and drive enterprise software architecture strategy across multiple products, platforms, and engineering organizations.
  • Design highly scalable, fault-tolerant, cloud-native distributed systems capable of supporting enterprise-scale workloads.
  • Establish architecture principles, technical standards, and governance practices that improve software quality and consistency.
  • Lead architecture reviews, technical design sessions, and engineering decision-making for high-impact initiatives.
  • Partner with executive leadership, engineering managers, product teams, and business stakeholders to align technology strategy with organizational objectives.
  • Drive platform modernization initiatives, including microservices adoption, cloud migration, API strategy, and event-driven architectures.
  • Lead performance optimization, scalability planning, reliability engineering, and system resiliency improvements.
  • Mentor Staff and Senior Engineers while fostering engineering excellence, architectural best practices, and technical innovation.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend strategic investments that improve engineering capabilities and business outcomes.
  • Author and review architecture documentation, technical RFCs, design specifications, and Architecture Decision Records (ADRs).
  • Contribute hands-on to critical architectural components, proof-of-concepts, and complex technical implementations when appropriate.
  • Champion DevSecOps, observability, automation, and operational excellence across engineering teams.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • 10+ years of professional software engineering experience, including significant experience designing and delivering enterprise-scale software platforms.
  • Proven expertise architecting and deploying large-scale distributed systems in production environments.
  • Advanced programming proficiency in Java, Go, C++, C#, or similar backend technologies.
  • Deep understanding of software architecture, microservices, distributed computing, API design, messaging systems, and event-driven architectures.
  • Strong expertise in cloud platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
  • Extensive experience with performance engineering, scalability, high availability, disaster recovery, and system optimization.
  • Demonstrated success leading cross-functional technical initiatives spanning multiple engineering teams or business units.
  • Strong understanding of Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), observability, CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, and modern DevOps practices.
  • Excellent communication, leadership, analytical, and stakeholder management skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Public technical contributions, including conference presentations, published papers, technical blogs, patents, or leadership in open-source projects.
  • Experience leading multi-year enterprise modernization or digital transformation programs.

About NOCD

NOCD is the #1 telehealth provider for the treatment of obsessive-compulsive disorder (OCD). OCD is one of the most severe, prevalent, and misunderstood mental health conditions. NOCD creates access to online therapy for people with OCD through our telehealth platform. In the NOCD app, Members can quickly access and schedule live, face-to-face video therapy sessions with our national network of licensed Therapists that specialize in Exposure and Response Prevention Therapy (ERP) - considered the "gold standard" in OCD treatment.

At NOCD, we help people reclaim their lives with clinically proven OCD treatment, by removing barriers to OCD care, and reducing the stigma associated with OCD. We’re changing the world and need other like-minded individuals to accelerate and expand our efforts.

About the Role

As the specialist virtual behavioral health provider, at NOCD, we want our Therapists to focus on what's most important - treating and caring for our members.

NOCD is looking for Independently Licensed Therapists (LP, LCPC, LCMFT, LCSW-C) in Maryland to join our team.

As a NOCD Therapist, you will see our team is committed to achieving clinical excellence, an exquisite Therapist experience and providing proven & visible clinical outcomes. We have dedicated teams to handle your marketing, billing, credentialing, and scheduling. Therapists will use valuable previous clinical experience, good judgment, and our clinical guidelines to discern when to refer members to external resources.

You'll enjoy growth and support through: ongoing consultation with other team members; specialized clinical training with experienced OCD providers; information on the latest research advancements in the field; technical support and clinical protocols; 1:1 mentorship to discuss complex cases; and an open, receptive environment to provide feedback.

  • Ambitious and ready to keep up with a goal-driven, start-up environment

  • An investment in your personal growth through a clear career path

raw.description:
OVERVIEW

A thriving, mission-driven multimedia organization, NPR produces award-winning news, information, and music programming in partnership with hundreds of independent public radio stations across the nation. The NPR audience values information, creativity, curiosity, and social responsibility – and our employees do too. We are innovators and leaders in diverse fields, from journalism and digital media to IT and development. Every day, our employees and member stations touch the lives of millions worldwide.

Across our organization, we’re building a workplace where collaboration is essential, diverse voices are heard, and inclusion is the key to our success. We are committed to doing the right thing in our journalism and in every role at NPR. This means that integrity, adherence to our ethical standards, and compliance with legal obligations are fundamental responsibilities for every employee at NPR.

Intro to Position

A Software Architect exemplifies technical expertise and excellence at NPR. Working alongside engineering leadership and cross-functional discipline teams, you will guide strategic technology decisions, design scalable solutions, and build robust pipelines, services, and tools that support NPR and our Member Station Network.

In this role, you will lead technology strategy across our most complex engineering initiatives—those impacting multiple product lines, distributed systems, and mobile platforms simultaneously. Responsible for end-to-end architecture from platform services to client applications and downstream data pipelines, you will balance system performance, developer velocity, data privacy, and cost-efficiency to deliver exceptional public media experiences at scale.

Responsibilities

Architectural Strategy & System Design

  1. Architect Unified Mobile & Cross-Platform Systems: Define and implement shared architectural patterns and modular design systems across native iOS and Android codebases and cross-platform integrations to maximize code reuse and development velocity.
  2. Design Scalable Personalization & Delivery Pipelines: Lead platform-to-client architecture for personalized content delivery, supporting high-traffic, localized media experiences across owned digital properties and member station networks.
  3. Drive Technology Standards & Evaluation: Conduct technical evaluations for custom builds versus vendor solutions; introduce modern technologies and establish architectural standards across divisions.

Cross-Team Collaboration & Governance

  1. Lead Multi-Team Engineering Initiatives: Provide technical oversight and direction across cross-divisional product roadmaps, project proposals, and OKR planning cycles for multi-team initiatives.
  2. Establish Quality & Code Governance: Conduct architectural proposals and code reviews, providing substantive feedback on system designs, security protocols, workflows, and peer-written software.
  3. Integrate Compliance & Cost Controls: Architect solutions with explicit focus on privacy compliance (GDPR/CPRA), security standards, CDN caching strategies, and cloud cost optimization frameworks.

Operational Excellence & Mentorship

  1. Support Deployment & Operational Resilience: Participate in automated deployments across QA, UAT, and production environments; join the developer on-call rotation to diagnose and resolve critical incidents.
  2. Contribute High-Quality Code: Author documented, resilient code and reusable core libraries aligned with department standards and sprint commitments.
  3. Foster Technical Mentorship & Team Growth: Assist in onboarding, training, and interviewing software engineering staff, advocating for efficient agile processes and inclusive team practices.

The above duties and responsibilities are not an exhaustive list of required responsibilities, duties and skills. Other duties may be assigned, and this job description can be modified at any time.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Multi-Team System Architecture: 7+ years of progressive software engineering experience, including demonstrated success designing and leading technical architecture for complex, multi-team platform environments.
  • Native Mobile Engineering Expertise: Deep technical proficiency in native mobile architecture (iOS and Android) using languages such as Swift, Kotlin, Java, or Objective-C.
  • Scalable Platform & API Design: Proven track record designing high-traffic, resilient distributed systems, RESTful/GraphQL APIs, and client-server integration patterns.
  • Media Delivery & Infrastructure: Practical experience architecting media playback, streaming protocols, CDN configurations, and cloud infrastructure ecosystems (e.g., AWS or GCP).
  • Data Privacy & Cost Optimization: Hands-on experience integrating data privacy and compliance standards (GDPR, CPRA) alongside cloud cost optimization frameworks in high-availability environments.
  • CI/CD & Quality Automation: Demonstrated experience with modern version control systems (Git), continuous integration pipelines, and automated testing frameworks.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Polyglot Backend Systems: Familiarity with modern backend languages such as Go or PHP in event-driven or microservice architectures.
  • Advanced Caching & Open Source: Experience optimizing edge media caches, working with relational databases/SQL, or contributing to open-source software initiatives.

Required Skills/Competencies

  • Cross-Functional Technical Governance: Ability to translate complex business and product requirements into clear, practical architectural designs accepted across multiple engineering teams.
  • Technical Mentorship & Code Quality Advocacy: Strong commitment to promoting engineering best practices, conducting empathetic code reviews, and elevating overall code quality.
  • Operational Resilience & Diagnostic Vision: Ability to systematically isolate, diagnose, and resolve production incidents under high-urgency conditions during on-call rotation.
  • Structured Stakeholder Communication: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills to present software architecture proposals, trade-offs, and technical roadmaps to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Mission-Driven Innovation: Passion for leveraging modern technology to advance public media, accessibility, and audience engagement.

Education Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, OR equivalent practical work experience demonstrating equivalent technical architecture capability.

Work Location & Requirements

  • NPR Remote-Permitted: This is a remote-permitted role. This role is based out of our Washington, D.C. office, but the employee may choose to work on a remote basis from a location that NPR approves. You will have the option of working (a) remotely from a location of your choosing within the United States that is supported by NPR; (b) on-site at an NPR facility, based on the availability of desks and approval from NPR; or (c) a combination of both. Regardless of where you choose to work from, you may be expected to travel to other locations from time to time to perform the duties of your position.

Job Type

  • This is a full-time, exempt position.

Compensation

Salary Range: The U.S.-based anticipated salary range for this opportunity is $184,758.33 - $205,933.12 plus benefits. The range displayed reflects the minimum and maximum salaries NPR expects to provide for new hires for the position across all US locations.

NPR Benefits: NPR provides comprehensive benefits for employees and dependents. Regular, full-time employees scheduled to work 30 hours or more per week are eligible to enroll in NPR’s benefits options. Benefits include access to health and wellness, paid time off, and financial well-being. Plan options include medical, dental, vision, life/ accidental death and dismemberment, long-term disability, short-term disability, and voluntary retirement savings to all eligible NPR employees.

raw.description:
Sidekick, an injury rehab products company, is running a fully virtual clinical study of a balance-training device for people recovering from ankle sprains. About 80 participants across Canada will complete a 28-day at-home program with virtual check-ins.

You'll be the participant's main point of contact. You will screen and enroll participants, run virtual study visits by video, guide them through standardized functional assessments, monitor daily symptom diaries and follow up on missed entries, and record data in the electronic data capture system according to protocol. You'll be trained on all assessments by the study's physiotherapist investigator and work alongside a clinical trial consultant on protocol compliance.

Requirements

  • Graduate degree (or in progress) in a health-related field: physiotherapy, kinesiology, nursing, public health, rehabilitation science, or similar
  • Experience with human-subject research, ideally in a coordinator or RA role
  • Current GCP certification, or willingness to complete it before start
  • Comfortable running structured video sessions with participants and keeping meticulous records
  • Available 20–25 hours per week, with some flexibility for participant scheduling (evenings/weekends)
  • Based in Canada

Benefits

  • $30/hour
  • Fully remote, set your own hours within participant availability
  • Hands-on clinical trial experience from enrolment through study close, on a study intended for peer-reviewed publication
  • Training on standardized functional assessments from a practicing physiotherapist
  • Small team with direct access to the investigator and study sponsor

CUSTOMER EXPERIENCE SPECIALIST

Allied Roofing Partners

Remote | Full-Time | Hourly

$18.00–$22.00 per hour, based on experience

ABOUT THE ROLE

A Customer Experience (CX) Specialist is often the first person a homeowner talks to—whether they've called, filled out a web form, or clicked a social ad.

The CX Specialist role is designed to make sure customers hear back in minutes, not hours. CX will also help existing customers with questions and/or basic information as needed.

This role blends customer service and appointment setting. You'll work from proven scripts and playbooks while bringing real listening and judgment to every call.

You'll start by supporting Capstone Roofing, with room to grow into other brands and tools as our CX team expands.

Our goal is simple: Homeowners feel supported, not processed.

POSITION DETAILS

  • Location: Remote – United States(preferred Pst TIme)

• Employment Type: Full-Time, Hourly

  • Compensation: $18.00–$22.00 per hour, based on experience
    • Schedule: Daytime business hours, with evening and Saturday coverage during peak season
    • Overtime available
    • Reports to: Assistant Director, Customer Experience

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Outbound – Appointment Setting & Recovery

  • Call back homeowners who reached out but haven't booked and get them scheduled.
    • Work our recovery list of missed calls and unworked web leads. These are a high priority because they are leads we've already paid for.
    • When time allows, re-engage past quotes, older estimates, and past customers to help fill the calendar further out.

Inbound Customer Experience

  • Answer inbound calls from homeowners requesting to book an inspection or estimate.
    • Assist existing customers with job-related or basic questions.
    • Respond to new website and social media leads within minutes.

• Log every interaction in the CRM.

  • Transfer billing questions finance team.

Expectations

  • Follow our calling cadence, scripts, and playbooks while adapting with good judgment when a situation calls for it.
    • Meet daily and weekly targets for response speed, contact rate, and appointments booked.
    • Provide a professional, friendly, and helpful experience during every customer interaction.

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Required

  • Phone-based customer service, appointment setting, inside sales, or call-center experience, including experience working with scripts or playbooks.
    • Clear, confident, and friendly phone presence.

• Persistent without being pushy.

  • Empathy, patience, and quick thinking with the ability to respond thoughtfully rather than react.
    • Strong comfort with technology and the ability to learn and move between a CRM, dialer or softphone, and other tools as they evolve.
    • Self-discipline and the ability to work productively from home.
    • Quiet, professional home workspace with reliable high-speed internet.
    • Coachable and goal-driven mindset.
    • Authorization to work in the United States.

NICE TO HAVE

  • Experience in roofing, home services, or another trades or contractor business.

• Bilingual with conversational Spanish.

  • Previous lead-recovery calling experience.

YOUR FIRST 90 DAYS

Weeks 1–2

  • Learn Capstone's scripts and systems.

• Shadow live calls.

  • Begin handling inbound calls with support.

By Day 30

  • Handle inbound calls independently.

• Begin working the recovery list.

By Day 90

  • Consistently meet contact-rate and appointment-setting targets across inbound, recovery, and re-engagement work.

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

  • $18.00–$22.00 per hour, based on experience
    • Medical insurance and company sponsored life insurance

• Dental insurance

• Vision insurance• 401(k)

  • Paid time off
    • Paid holidays

• Equipment and software provided

CQC Registration Consultant (Self-Employed)

Location: UK Wide (Remote & Travel as Required)
Contract Type: Self-Employed Consultancy Assignments
Rate:£350 Per Day
Working Pattern: Flexible
Start Date: Immediate Opportunities Available

Help Providers Achieve Successful CQC Registration

Delphi Care Solutions is seeking experienced CQC Registration Consultants to join our growing network of specialist consultants.

We support care providers across England with new registrations, Registered Manager applications, change applications, service expansions and regulatory compliance projects. As demand continues to grow, we are looking for consultants with a proven track record of securing successful CQC registrations and guiding providers through the registration process from initial enquiry through to approval.

Whether supporting a first-time provider, launching a new domiciliary care service, registering a supported living service or preparing a Registered Manager for interview, you will play a key role in helping organisations establish safe, compliant and successful services.

This opportunity is ideally suited to experienced Registered Managers, Nominated Individuals, Operations Managers, Quality & Compliance Professionals and Independent Consultants with extensive knowledge of CQC registration requirements.

Typical Projects

  • New CQC Provider Registrations
  • Domiciliary Care Registrations
  • Supported Living Registrations
  • Residential Care Registrations
  • Nursing Care Registrations
  • Registered Manager Applications
  • Change of Provider Applications
  • Change of Location Applications
  • Addition of Regulated Activities
  • Statement of Purpose Development
  • Nominated Individual Support
  • Registration Interview Preparation
  • Compliance and Governance Reviews
  • Registration Readiness Assessments
  • Policy and Procedure Reviews

Our consultants provide practical, end-to-end support that gives clients the best possible chance of achieving a successful registration outcome.

Key Responsibilities

  • Managing registration projects from initial consultation through to submission
  • Supporting providers with Provider, Location and Registered Manager applications
  • Preparing and reviewing Statements of Purpose
  • Producing registration documentation and supporting evidence
  • Reviewing policies and procedures against regulatory requirements
  • Advising clients on CQC expectations and registration best practice
  • Conducting registration readiness assessments
  • Preparing applicants for registration interviews and fit person assessments
  • Managing project timelines and application progress
  • Providing regular communication and updates to clients
  • Supporting providers with post-registration compliance planning

What We're Looking For

  • A demonstrable track record of securing successful CQC registrations across one or more regulated activities
  • Strong knowledge of CQC regulations, standards and registration requirements
  • Experience drafting Statements of Purpose and registration documentation
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Strong organisational and project management skills
  • A professional, consultative and solutions-focused approach
  • The ability to work independently and manage multiple projects
  • Strong stakeholder management and client-facing skills
  • Enhanced DBS Certificate

Highly Desirable Experience

  • Previous Registered Manager experience
  • Previous Nominated Individual experience
  • Operations Management experience
  • Quality & Compliance Management experience
  • Experience supporting providers through registration interviews
  • Experience within Domiciliary Care, Supported Living, Residential Care or Nursing Care services
  • Experience managing multiple registration projects simultaneously

What We Offer

  • £350 Per Day
  • Flexible consultancy assignments
  • Remote and hybrid working opportunities
  • Access to Delphi's specialist support network
  • Ongoing project support
  • Prompt payment of approved invoices
  • A variety of registration and compliance projects
  • Opportunities for repeat and long-term consultancy assignments
  • The flexibility and autonomy of self-employed consultancy work

Why join Delphi?

Delphi Care Solutions works with providers at every stage of their journey, from registration and mobilisation through to compliance, growth and service improvement.

Our consultants combine regulatory expertise with practical operational knowledge, helping providers navigate what can often be a complex and challenging process. We value professionalism, integrity, attention to detail and, above all, successful outcomes for our clients.

By joining Delphi, you will become part of a specialist network trusted to support providers through one of the most important stages of their journey: achieving registration and building a compliant, successful service.

Interested?

Successful registrations don't happen by chance. They are built on experience, preparation and a thorough understanding of CQC expectations.

If you have a proven track record of securing successful CQC registrations, preparing high-quality application documentation and supporting providers through the registration process, we'd welcome a confidential conversation.

Join Delphi Care Solutions and become part of a specialist network of consultants trusted by providers to deliver successful registration outcomes and build compliant, high-quality services.

Registration Expertise. Regulatory Knowledge. Proven Results.
