About SAS

Strategic Association Solutions is an accounting, technology, design, and human resources outsourcing firm dedicated to serving membership-based nonprofits, including trade associations and professional societies. We understand the unique challenges these organizations face and provide tailored solutions to streamline their accounting operations. By partnering with SAS, organizations can focus on their mission while we handle the complexities of budgeting, reporting, compliance, and day-to-day accounting tasks. Our goal is to enhance operational efficiency and financial stability, building a foundation for long-term success for our clients.

Position Summary

The Web Developer, following the Strategic Association Solutions Best Practices, holds a critical role in administering, supporting, and developing websites for numerous clients. This role involves implementing custom plugins, modifying templates, and collaborating closely with project managers, designers, and developers to ensure the successful completion of assigned projects and tickets, adhering to industry best practices.

SAS is a fully remote company – this position will be 100% remote.

Essential Functions

Provide Support for Existing Client Sites

  • Troubleshoot problems and promptly address issues on existing client websites.
  • Implement requested features, ensuring seamless functionality.

Assist with the Build Out of New Client Websites

  • Administer pre-built themes and customize them to meet client needs.
  • Develop custom themes and plugins from scratch for unique client requirements.

Manage Integrations between Websites and reMembers

  • Oversee integrations between websites and Strategic Association Solutions’ Association Management Software, re:Members.
  • Ensure smooth functionality and data synchronization between the two platforms.

Ensure Compliance with Best Practices

  • Follow Strategic Association Solutions Best Practices in all development activities.
  • Stay updated on industry best practices and integrate them into daily workflows.

Other duties that align with the mission and vision of the company as assigned.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree preferred.
  • 2-3 years of experience as a Web Developer.
  • Proficient in HTML, CSS, and PHP.
  • Proficient in web development, including administration of plugins, settings, and layouts via the web Dashboard front end.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong analytical and critical thinking skills with the ability to efficiently solve unique problems.
  • Strong time management skills and the ability to meet deadlines.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with third-party web content editors such as Elementor and WP Bakery.
  • Experience with other CMS platforms such as Kentico, Drupal, and DNN.
  • Experience with JavaScript.
  • Experience with Python and C#.
  • Experience with RESTful APIs.
  • Experience with issue and project tracking software like JIRA.

raw.description:
Sidekick, an injury rehab products company, is running a fully virtual clinical study of a balance-training device for people recovering from ankle sprains. About 80 participants across Canada will complete a 28-day at-home program with virtual check-ins.

You'll be the participant's main point of contact. You will screen and enroll participants, run virtual study visits by video, guide them through standardized functional assessments, monitor daily symptom diaries and follow up on missed entries, and record data in the electronic data capture system according to protocol. You'll be trained on all assessments by the study's physiotherapist investigator and work alongside a clinical trial consultant on protocol compliance.

Requirements

  • Graduate degree (or in progress) in a health-related field: physiotherapy, kinesiology, nursing, public health, rehabilitation science, or similar
  • Experience with human-subject research, ideally in a coordinator or RA role
  • Current GCP certification, or willingness to complete it before start
  • Comfortable running structured video sessions with participants and keeping meticulous records
  • Available 20–25 hours per week, with some flexibility for participant scheduling (evenings/weekends)
  • Based in Canada

Benefits

  • $30/hour
  • Fully remote, set your own hours within participant availability
  • Hands-on clinical trial experience from enrolment through study close, on a study intended for peer-reviewed publication
  • Training on standardized functional assessments from a practicing physiotherapist
  • Small team with direct access to the investigator and study sponsor

raw.title: Mental Health Therapist - Illinois
raw.excerpt: About NOCD NOCD is the #1 telehealth provider for the treatment of obsessive-compulsive disorder (OCD).
raw.description:
About NOCD

NOCD is the #1 telehealth provider for the treatment of obsessive-compulsive disorder (OCD). OCD is one of the most severe, prevalent, and misunderstood mental health conditions. NOCD creates access to online therapy for people with OCD through our telehealth platform. In the NOCD app, Members can quickly access and schedule live, face-to-face video therapy sessions with our national network of licensed Therapists that specialize in Exposure and Response Prevention Therapy (ERP) - considered the "gold standard" in OCD treatment.

At NOCD, we help people reclaim their lives with clinically proven OCD treatment, by removing barriers to OCD care, and reducing the stigma associated with OCD. We’re changing the world and need other like-minded individuals to accelerate and expand our efforts.

About the Role

As the specialist virtual behavioral health provider, at NOCD, we want our Therapists to focus on what's most important - treating and caring for our members.

NOCD is looking for Independently Licensed Therapists (LP, LCPC, LMFT, LCSW) in Illinoisto join our team.

As a NOCD Therapist, you will see our team is committed to achieving clinical excellence, an exquisite Therapist experience and providing proven & visible clinical outcomes. We have dedicated teams to handle your marketing, billing, credentialing, and scheduling. Therapists will use valuable previous clinical experience, good judgment, and our clinical guidelines to discern when to refer members to external resources.

You'll enjoy growth and support through: ongoing consultation with other team members; specialized clinical training with experienced OCD providers; information on the latest research advancements in the field; technical support and clinical protocols; 1:1 mentorship to discuss complex cases; and an open, receptive environment to provide feedback.

What You'll Do

  • Help people with OCD get better and stay better by providing top-notch care through diagnoses, assessments, and evidence-based psychotherapy via the NOCD video platform
  • Manage your caseload and schedule
  • Maintain complete and timely clinical documentation using the NOCD EHR system
  • Participate in NOCD clinical consultation, training, and advance your knowledge and practice of evidence-supported treatments for OCD
  • Collaborate with our network of providers to help develop and reinforce treatment decisions

Requirements:

  • See credentialing information here.
  • Full Time Providers:
    • 40 hour work week
    • Complete 25 hours of direct clinical work per week
    • Attend a world-class training program developed by industry leaders.
    • Attend 2 hours of weekly group clinical consultation
    • Have 10 hours of weeknight/weekend availability after 5pm local time for Member Sessions
    • Will participate in and complete cross-license application process during Onboarding
    • Open and willing to treat children and adolescents after attending NOCD Child and Adolescent training
  • Practical experience independently diagnosing is required for this role (this practical experience can be during your pre-licensed experience).
    • If you do not have this direct practical experience, proof of completion (with certificate) of the following training will be accepted in its place: Tolin & Diamond Training Video.
    • Please note: submission of proof of completion does not guarantee hire, NOCD will not reimburse the cost of this course.

Who You Are

  • Full and unrestricted license in good standing to practice in your state.
    • Masters Degree Required
    • Illinois: Licensed Psychologist, Licensed Clinical Professional Counselor, Licensed Marriage and Family Therapist, Licensed Clinical Social Worker
  • At least 6 months of relevant experience with evidence-based therapies (e.g., ERP, CBT, ACT)
  • Knowledge and experience with treating OCD with ERP is preferable but not required
  • Organized, quick and enthusiastic learner, excellent communicator, good with time management
  • Have a confidential, private location to work remotely from with reliable internet access
  • Comfortable and efficient with using technology to communicate
  • Ambitious and ready to keep up with a goal-driven, start-up environment

What We Offer

  • A commitment to clinical excellence, an exquisite Therapist experience and proven & visible clinical outcomes.
  • Gain world-class training from experienced OCD providers to become a specialized Therapist in treating OCD and related disorders through evidence-based care.
  • A full suite of support through continued mentorship & feedback
  • Investment in new technology built to improve the NOCD Therapist experience and allow our Therapists to continue to focus on Member care.
  • Centralized scheduling
  • An investment in your personal growth through a clear career path
  • Access to NOCD Professional Development Trainings and ongoing consultation with other team members
  • One-on-one mentorship to discuss complex cases
  • Ability to work remotely from the comfort of your own home or office
  • Competitive compensation with a robust bonus program
    • Base Salary Comp Range in Illinois = $55,000 - $85,000
    • Bonus Program = $12,400 per year earned on average by those eligible
  • Comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision coverage, and 401(k) match for qualifying employees
  • Casual and engaging startup environment with an outstanding mission-driven team atmosphere
  • Generous PTO
  • NOCD provides 12 weeks of fully paid parental leave for the primary caregiver, and 6 weeks of fully paid leave for the secondary caregiver, for qualifying full-time employees.

NOCD is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. NOCD is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures.

Applicants have rights under Federal Employment Laws.Family and Medical Leave Act (FMLA);Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO);Employee Polygraph Protection Act (EPPA).

raw.description:
CUSTOMER EXPERIENCE SPECIALIST

Allied Roofing Partners

Remote | Full-Time | Hourly

$18.00–$22.00 per hour, based on experience

ABOUT THE ROLE

A Customer Experience (CX) Specialist is often the first person a homeowner talks to—whether they've called, filled out a web form, or clicked a social ad.

The CX Specialist role is designed to make sure customers hear back in minutes, not hours. CX will also help existing customers with questions and/or basic information as needed.

This role blends customer service and appointment setting. You'll work from proven scripts and playbooks while bringing real listening and judgment to every call.

You'll start by supporting Capstone Roofing, with room to grow into other brands and tools as our CX team expands.

Our goal is simple: Homeowners feel supported, not processed.

POSITION DETAILS

  • Location: Remote – United States(preferred Pst TIme)

• Employment Type: Full-Time, Hourly

  • Compensation: $18.00–$22.00 per hour, based on experience
    • Schedule: Daytime business hours, with evening and Saturday coverage during peak season
    • Overtime available
    • Reports to: Assistant Director, Customer Experience

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Outbound – Appointment Setting & Recovery

  • Call back homeowners who reached out but haven't booked and get them scheduled.
    • Work our recovery list of missed calls and unworked web leads. These are a high priority because they are leads we've already paid for.
    • When time allows, re-engage past quotes, older estimates, and past customers to help fill the calendar further out.

Inbound Customer Experience

  • Answer inbound calls from homeowners requesting to book an inspection or estimate.
    • Assist existing customers with job-related or basic questions.
    • Respond to new website and social media leads within minutes.

• Log every interaction in the CRM.

  • Transfer billing questions finance team.

Expectations

  • Follow our calling cadence, scripts, and playbooks while adapting with good judgment when a situation calls for it.
    • Meet daily and weekly targets for response speed, contact rate, and appointments booked.
    • Provide a professional, friendly, and helpful experience during every customer interaction.

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Required

  • Phone-based customer service, appointment setting, inside sales, or call-center experience, including experience working with scripts or playbooks.
    • Clear, confident, and friendly phone presence.

• Persistent without being pushy.

  • Empathy, patience, and quick thinking with the ability to respond thoughtfully rather than react.
    • Strong comfort with technology and the ability to learn and move between a CRM, dialer or softphone, and other tools as they evolve.
    • Self-discipline and the ability to work productively from home.
    • Quiet, professional home workspace with reliable high-speed internet.
    • Coachable and goal-driven mindset.
    • Authorization to work in the United States.

NICE TO HAVE

  • Experience in roofing, home services, or another trades or contractor business.

• Bilingual with conversational Spanish.

  • Previous lead-recovery calling experience.

YOUR FIRST 90 DAYS

Weeks 1–2

  • Learn Capstone's scripts and systems.

• Shadow live calls.

  • Begin handling inbound calls with support.

By Day 30

  • Handle inbound calls independently.

• Begin working the recovery list.

By Day 90

  • Consistently meet contact-rate and appointment-setting targets across inbound, recovery, and re-engagement work.

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

  • $18.00–$22.00 per hour, based on experience
    • Medical insurance and company sponsored life insurance

• Dental insurance

• Vision insurance• 401(k)

  • Paid time off
    • Paid holidays

• Equipment and software provided

EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY

Allied Roofing Partners and its operating companies are equal opportunity employers. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Reasonable accommodations are available for applicants and employees with disabilities.

Salary: $18.00–$22.00 per hour, based on experience

raw.description:
Manage & optimise campaigns across our magazine, summit and membership products

$3,000 - $4,000 per month | Full-time | Remote (UK, US overlap)

Watch this short video from Mark, our founder —

Autism Parenting Magazine is a publishing company supporting parents of autistic children with practical, expert-backed strategies they can use right away. We publish a monthly magazine, run our biannual Autism Parenting Summits, and operate a video-based membership subscription.

APM thrives in a fast-paced, high-performance environment. Our global, remote-first team spans the UK, USA, Philippines, South Africa, and Eastern Europe and is growing rapidly.

We use EOS to keep alignment and accountability, meet weekly, and use Hubstaff for time tracking.

We spend around $1 million a year on paid advertising, predominantly on Meta, with Google, Pinterest and Bing alongside it. That spend is the growth engine of the business, and right now our founder is running it himself. We need someone to take the execution off his hands.

This is a hands-on execution role, not a leadership one. You will not manage a team and you will not be asked to invent our marketing strategy from scratch.

Mark has been doing performance marketing for over 16 years and has a growth playbook that works in this niche, built around the Customer Value Journey, where we earn awareness and trust before we ask for the sale. Your job is to take that strategy and run it brilliantly, at pace, with real accountability for the numbers. Over time, as you learn the niche, you'll take increasing ownership and there's a genuine path to growing into the strategist seat. But that's earned over 12 months, not granted on day one.

What you'll be doing

📈 Paid Media & Growth: Meta will be your primary channel, so you should already be strong at building, managing and optimising campaigns at scale. You’ll also help expand into Google Search, Performance Max and Demand Gen, with future testing across channels such as TikTok and AppLovin.

📊 Analytics & Attribution:Use Meta Ads Manager, GA4 and Hyros to understand campaign and funnel performance. Compare data across platforms, spot tracking or attribution issues, and make decisions based on the best available evidence rather than blindly trusting one source.

✍️ Copywriting & Email Marketing: Write Meta ads, headlines, hooks, UGC scripts, landing-page copy and marketing emails. This may include promotional emails, nurture sequences, launch emails and follow-up campaigns.

🎨 Creative Production: Personally create and finalise static and video ads, including variations, UGC scripts and briefs, footage selection, editing, captions and overlays. Use tools such as Canva, ChatGPT, CapCut and other AI/creative tools to move quickly from concept to launch-ready creative.

🎯 Landing Pages & Funnels: Help improve lead-generation and sales pages, with a focus on message match and conversion rate optimisation.

🌐 SEO, Organic Social, Affiliate, & Offline Growth: Improve lead generation and subscription sales through development of our SEO, organic social, affiliate, and offline marketing efforts.

This is a full-time role, UK-based, with some overlap with US hours when needed for commercial or supplier meetings.

Requirements

✅ 3–5 years of hands-on paid advertising experience

✅ Strong practical Meta Ads experience — this is the non-negotiable one

✅ Experience managing meaningful monthly budgets (we'd love to see $50k+/month, but we care more about how you thought about the money than the size of it)

✅ Solid grasp of CAC, ROAS, CTR, CPC, LTV and conversion rate, and comfort being measured on them

✅ Comfortable in Meta Ads Manager and GA4, and able to spot patterns and when tracking or attribution data looks wrong and investigate

✅ Experience with Hyros or another attribution platform is highly desirable

✅ Strong written English and comfort writing direct-response advertising and email copy

✅ Good creative instincts and real curiosity about why one ad beats another

✅ Experience marketing in a compliance-sensitive niche health, medical, supplements, finance or similar is a significant advantage

✅ High attention to detail and strong self-QA: you check the landing page is live before you turn the spend on

✅ Coachable. You can take direction, ask good questions, disagree well, and then commit

✅ Experience with subscription or membership businesses, digital products, launches or events, email platforms, UGC, video editing, Canva and CRO is a bonus.

A note on how we market

We're marketing to overwhelmed parents in a sensitive niche, and words matter enormously both ethically and practically. There are specific ways of phrasing things that keep us compliant with Meta, and getting this wrong can get our ad account banned. We have zero tolerance for carelessness here. If you've worked somewhere the platform rules genuinely bite, you'll know exactly what we mean.

You're a great fit if…

✨ You're strong on Meta and want to become a more rounded direct-response marketer

✨ You enjoy the numbers and want to be accountable for commercial results

✨ You like running frequent tests and turning results into the next round of decisions

✨ You'd rather produce and launch things yourself than manage other people

✨ You're confident enough to bring ideas and challenge assumptions, and humble enough to accept that a business 16 years into its niche might already know some things you don't

✨ Your definition of "done" is work that sells, not work that was submitted by the deadline

✨ You take ownership rather than waiting for someone else to spot the problem

This role is NOT for you if…

❎ You want to be the strategist, or you want complete ownership of marketing direction

❎ You mainly want to manage other marketers

❎ You're primarily a brand marketer, or you prefer reach and engagement over revenue, CAC and ROAS

❎ You accept the numbers Meta shows you without ever questioning attribution or tracking quality

❎ You arrive with a fixed playbook from your last job and expect it to work here without adaptation

❎ You only want to work inside Ads Manager and expect other people to handle copy, creative, email and landing pages

❎ You dislike detailed feedback or get defensive when your ideas are questioned

❎ You prefer discussing strategy to launching and improving campaigns

❎ You need someone to keep telling you what to do next

Learning & development

We don't expect you to know everything. Mark will coach you directly on the playbook and the niche.

Be warned that this niche takes time. Most people need around six months to really get it. We're interested in someone hungry to learn and stick with it, not someone who believes they already have the answers.

Benefits

What’s in it for you?

💵 $3,000 - $4,000 per month*

🌍 Full-time, fully remote role

🏖️ 21 days paid time off

🤒 Sick pay

📈 Company performance-based bonus

  • Please note that this is a gross salary and that you are responsible for any tax-related procedures in your country of residence. We kindly ask you to apply only if you are happy to work remotely as an independent contractor.

This is our typical hiring process - occasionally, it may include extra steps.

For this role, JobRack is partnering with the company to find their next hire. We’ll handle all the screening and testing, so they see only the best-fit candidates - like you!

🔍 How to shine

• Read the role details carefully.

  • Submit a thoughtful, high-quality application.
    • Stay responsive - we’ll keep you updated at every stage.

✨ Important notes
• Apply only through JobRack; please don’t contact the company directly.
• We expect a respectful hiring experience - any disrespect means instant disqualification.

raw.description:
About Yordas Group
Yordas Group is an international provider of scientific and consultancy services, regulatory advice and training to industry in chemicals management, sustainability and risk assessment. We help companies understand and comply with the regulatory requirements affecting their products and supply chains. Our Hazard Communication team works with clients around the world to ensure chemical products are classified, documented and communicated safely and compliantly across different markets.

The opportunity
We are looking for scientifically minded people to join our growing Hazard Communication team in either the UK or Turkey.

We are deliberately keeping the experience level for this role broad.

You might be an early-career regulatory professional who already has some experience of Safety Data Sheets, chemical classification, GHS/CLP, labelling or chemical regulatory affairs and is looking for the next step in your career. Alternatively, you may have a strong scientific background and transferable experience with the aptitude to develop into a Hazard Communication specialist.

You do not need to arrive knowing everything. We have an established technical training and development programme and can tailor your development according to your existing knowledge and experience.

For candidates who already have relevant Hazard Communication experience, the role can offer greater responsibility and independence from the outset.

The important things for us are strong scientific reasoning, attention to detail, curiosity, good judgement and the ability to learn and apply complex regulatory requirements.

What you'll be doing

Depending on your existing experience and development needs, your work will include:
  • Safety Data Sheet and label authoring for chemical products supplied into different global markets.
  • Hazard classification of substances and mixtures, applying GHS-based regulatory requirements including EU/GB CLP and requirements in other international jurisdictions.
  • Reviewing technical and compositional data and making informed classification and Hazard Communication decisions.
  • Supporting Poison Centre Notification (PCN) and related regulatory activities.
  • Reviewing SDS and other Hazard Communication documentation for regulatory compliance and quality.
  • Researching regulatory requirements and helping the team respond to technical and client questions.
  • Working with colleagues on international Hazard Communication projects and managed services.
  • Communicating with clients and other Yordas teams to understand requirements and deliver high-quality work.
  • Contributing to improvements in our technical processes, guidance, systems and tools.
As your knowledge and experience develop, there will be opportunities to take greater ownership of client relationships and projects, provide regulatory consultancy, undertake quality review, support and mentor colleagues, contribute to training and help develop new services.

What we're looking for

We are interested in candidates at different stages of their early regulatory careers, so we don't expect everyone to tick every box.

You will ideally have:
  • A Bachelor's, Master's or PhD in a scientific discipline, particularly Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Pharmaceutical Science, Biology, Biomedicine, Natural Sciences or a related subject; or equivalent relevant industry experience.
  • An analytical mindset and the ability to interpret scientific and technical information.
  • Excellent attention to detail and an appreciation of the importance of accuracy and consistency.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • The ability to manage changing priorities and organise your own workload.
  • Confidence working both independently and collaboratively within an international team.
  • Curiosity and a willingness to develop your technical knowledge.
Relevant experience would be an advantage and we would particularly like to hear from you if you have some experience in one or more of the following:
  • Safety Data Sheet authoring or review
  • GHS or CLP classification
  • Chemical or product labelling
  • Chemical regulatory affairs or product stewardship
  • REACH or CLP
  • Poison Centre Notifications / UFI
  • Dangerous Goods
  • Chemical compliance within industry
  • Regulatory or scientific consultancy
  • SDS authoring or regulatory software

What we can offer

Hazard Communication is a specialist field, and we don't expect people to arrive knowing every regulation or every market.

You'll receive structured training and support from experienced Hazard Communication professionals while working on real client projects. As you develop, you'll have opportunities to build expertise across global GHS requirements and pursue a career path that suits your strengths.

That could include becoming a technical specialist, moving further into consultancy and client management, managing projects, undertaking quality review, delivering training, developing new services or progressing into team leadership.

Yordas also offers a range of benefits depending on location, including professional development opportunities, generous holidays, flexible working and pension/medical benefits where applicable.

Application
If this sounds interesting but you're unsure whether your experience is quite at the right level, we'd still encourage you to apply. We're more interested in finding someone with the right scientific aptitude, regulatory mindset and potential than matching a rigid number of years' experience.

Please send your CV and covering letter to , outlining your relevant experience and why you're interested in developing your career in Hazard Communication.

Shortlisted candidates may be invited to complete a hazard classification exercise. All information required to complete the exercise will be provided.

Yordas Group is an equal opportunities employer and welcomes applications from suitably qualified candidates from all backgrounds.

raw.excerpt: 💻 Kodland HakkındaKodland, 5–17 yaş arası çocuklara programlama, matematik, dijital tasarım ve teknoloji becerileri kazandıran uluslararası bir online eğitim platformudur.
raw.description:
💻 Kodland Hakkında

Kodland, 5–17 yaş arası çocuklara programlama, matematik, dijital tasarım ve teknoloji becerileri kazandıran uluslararası bir online eğitim platformudur.

Canlı online derslerimizde Python, Roblox, Minecraft, Dijital Yaratıcılık ve benzeri modern alanları proje tabanlı bir öğrenme yaklaşımıyla sunuyoruz.

Türkiye ekibimize katılacak, çocuklar ve velilerle birebir online deneme dersleri gerçekleştirecek Online Eğitim ve Satış Danışmanları (TCM) arıyoruz.

Bu pozisyon klasik bir öğretmenlik rolü değildir. Eğitim danışmanlığı, güçlü iletişim ve sonuç odaklı satışın birleştiği bir çalışma modelidir.

🎯 Bu rolde ne yapacaksın?

Zoom üzerinden çocuk ve en az bir velinin katıldığı, yaklaşık 60 dakikalık online deneme dersleri gerçekleştireceksin.

Görüşme boyunca:

  • Çocuk ve veliyle güvene dayalı iletişim kuracak,

  • Çocuğun ilgi alanlarını, hedeflerini ve eğitim ihtiyaçlarını anlayacak,

  • Hazır Kodland materyalleriyle kısa bir uygulamalı aktivite yönetecek,

  • Gözlemlerine göre en uygun kursu ve öğrenme modelini önerecek,

  • Velilerin sorularını yanıtlayacak ve tereddütlerini profesyonel şekilde ele alacak,

  • Uygun ailelerde kayıt, fiyatlandırma ve ödeme sürecini sonuçlandırmaya odaklanacaksın.

Kendi müşterini veya öğrencini bulman beklenmez. Görüşmeler, önceden belirlediğin çalışma programına göre Kodland tarafından planlanır.

Hazır ders yapısı, materyaller, eğitim ve ekip desteği sağlanır. Senden beklenen; görüşmeyi aktif şekilde yönetmen, ailelerin ihtiyaçlarını doğru anlaman, Kodland programlarının değerini net şekilde göstermen ve satış fırsatlarını sonuca ulaştırmandır.

🕒 Çalışma Modeli

Bu rol tamamen uzaktan ve freelance çalışma modeliyle yürütülür.

  • Haftada 5 gün

  • Haftada minimum 20–25 saat uygunluk

  • Hafta içi çalışma aralığı: 13.00–22.00

  • Hafta sonu çalışma aralığı: 10.00–22.00

Çalışma saatlerini bu zaman aralıkları içerisinde planlayabilirsin. Ailelerin görüşmeleri açtığın saatlere göre oluşturulduğu için programına düzenli ve tutarlı şekilde bağlı kalman beklenir.

Genellikle bir hafta içi ve bir hafta sonu günü izin olarak seçilebilir.

💰 Kazanç Modeli

Bu pozisyonda toplam kazanç aşağıdaki bileşenlerden oluşur:

  • Sabit ücret

  • Satış komisyonları

  • Performans primleri

Haftada yaklaşık 20–25 saat çalışan ekip üyeleri genellikle aylık 30.000–50.000 TL aralığında kazanç elde eder.

Güçlü ve istikrarlı satış performansı gösteren ekip üyeleri ise 70.000 TL ve üzeri kazanca ulaşabilir.

Toplam kazanç; çalışma yoğunluğuna, gerçekleştirilen görüşme sayısına, satış performansına ve kıdem seviyesine göre değişir. Sabit ücret ve toplam kazanç potansiyeli, Kodland’deki kıdemin ve performansın geliştikçe artabilir.

Belirtilen tutarlar garanti gelir değil, mevcut ekip performansına dayalı kazanç aralıklarıdır.

🧭 Eğitim ve İşe Alım Süreci

Başarılı adaylar gerçek ailelerle görüşmeye başlamadan önce yapılandırılmış bir eğitim ve değerlendirme sürecinden geçer.

Süreç genel olarak:

  1. Başvurunun değerlendirilmesi

  2. Kısa online işe alım görüşmesi

  3. Bireysel çalışmalar ve canlı eğitim webinarları

  4. Pratik ve role-play oturumları

  5. Simüle deneme dersi değerlendirmesi

  6. Sözleşme, sistem erişimleri ve adaptasyon süreci

adımlarından oluşur.

Başvurudan ilk gerçek deneme dersine kadar geçen süre, eğitim planına ve adayın katılım hızına bağlı olarak yaklaşık iki haftadır.

🚀 Kodland Sana Ne Sunuyor?

  • Tamamen uzaktan çalışma

  • Sabit ücret, komisyon ve performans primleri

  • Hazır ders ve satış materyalleri

  • Kapsamlı eğitim ve adaptasyon süreci

  • Trainer, Team Leader ve ekip desteği

  • Uluslararası bir EdTech şirketinde deneyim

  • Satış, iletişim ve eğitim alanlarında gelişim fırsatı

  • Çocukların gelecekte kullanacağı beceriler kazanmasına katkı sağlayan anlamlı bir ürün

Requirements

✅ Zorunlu Gereksinimler

  • Kendine ait, güvenilir bir laptop veya masaüstü bilgisayar

  • Çalışır durumda kamera ve mikrofon

  • Zoom görüşmelerini kesintisiz gerçekleştirebilecek stabil internet bağlantısı

  • Kamera açık çalışmaya uygun, sessiz ve profesyonel bir çalışma ortamı

  • Haftada minimum 20–25 saat düzenli uygunluk

  • Hafta içi öğleden sonra ve akşam saatlerinde çalışabilme

  • Hafta sonunun en az bir gününde uygunluk gösterebilme

  • Türkçeyi akıcı, net ve güven veren şekilde kullanabilme

  • Çocuklarla ve yetişkinlerle rahat iletişim kurabilme

  • Online görüşmelerde enerjik ve profesyonel bir duruş sergileyebilme

  • Satış yapmaya, fiyat konuşmaya ve kayıt kararını yönetmeye açık olma

  • Hedef ve performans odaklı çalışabilme

  • Uzaktan çalışma düzeninde zamanını disiplinli şekilde yönetebilme

  • Bu rolü ana çalışma düzeni olarak sürdürebilme

🌟 Avantaj Sağlayacak Deneyimler

Aşağıdaki alanlardan birinde deneyim sahibi olman avantaj sağlar:

  • Satış veya danışmanlık

  • Müşteri hizmetleri veya çağrı merkezi

  • Eğitim, özel ders veya koçluk

  • Çocuklar ya da velilerle birebir iletişim

  • Uzaktan çalışma

  • CRM veya benzeri takip sistemleri

Bu deneyimlere sahip olman zorunlu değildir. Güçlü iletişim becerilerine, satış motivasyonuna ve öğrenme isteğine sahip adaylar da değerlendirilir.

🎯 Bu Rol Sana Uygun Olabilir, Eğer:

  • İnsanlarla konuşmayı ve ihtiyaçlarını anlamayı seviyorsan,

  • Çocuklarla iletişim kurmaktan keyif alıyorsan,

  • Satış ve performans sorumluluğu seni motive ediyorsa,

  • İtirazların satış sürecinin doğal bir parçası olduğunu biliyorsan,

  • Düzenli takip yapmanın sonuç almak için gerekli olduğunun farkındaysan,

  • Geri bildirime ve gelişime açıksan,

  • Çalışma programına istikrarlı şekilde bağlı kalabiliyorsan.

⚠️ Bu Rol Sana Uygun Olmayabilir, Eğer:

  • Yalnızca 09.00–17.00 saatleri arasında çalışabileceğin bir rol arıyorsan,

  • Akşam veya hafta sonu çalışmak istemiyorsan,

  • Satış yapma ya da fiyat konuşma konusunda rahat değilsen,

  • Kamera açık şekilde çalışmak istemiyorsan,

  • Performansının ölçüldüğü bir çalışma modeli sana uygun değilse,

  • Çocuklar ve velilerle birebir iletişim kurmak istemiyorsan.

raw.excerpt: About NOCD NOCD is the #1 telehealth provider for the treatment of obsessive-compulsive disorder (OCD).
raw.description:
About NOCD

NOCD is the #1 telehealth provider for the treatment of obsessive-compulsive disorder (OCD). OCD is one of the most severe, prevalent, and misunderstood mental health conditions. NOCD creates access to online therapy for people with OCD through our telehealth platform. In the NOCD app, Members can quickly access and schedule live, face-to-face video therapy sessions with our national network of licensed Therapists that specialize in Exposure and Response Prevention Therapy (ERP) - considered the "gold standard" in OCD treatment.

At NOCD, we help people reclaim their lives with clinically proven OCD treatment, by removing barriers to OCD care, and reducing the stigma associated with OCD. We’re changing the world and need other like-minded individuals to accelerate and expand our efforts.

About the Role

As the specialist virtual behavioral health provider, at NOCD, we want our Therapists to focus on what's most important - treating and caring for our members.

NOCD is looking for Independently Licensed Therapists (LPC, LMFT, LCSW or Licensed Psychologist)in New Jersey to join our team.

As a NOCD Therapist, you will see our team is committed to achieving clinical excellence, an exquisite Therapist experience and providing proven & visible clinical outcomes. We have dedicated teams to handle your marketing, billing, credentialing, and scheduling. Therapists will use valuable previous clinical experience, good judgment, and our clinical guidelines to discern when to refer members to external resources.

You'll enjoy growth and support through: ongoing consultation with other team members; specialized clinical training with experienced OCD providers; information on the latest research advancements in the field; technical support and clinical protocols; 1:1 mentorship to discuss complex cases; and an open, receptive environment to provide feedback.

What You'll Do

  • Help people with OCD get better and stay better by providing top-notch care through diagnoses, assessments, and evidence-based psychotherapy via the NOCD video platform
  • Manage your caseload and schedule
  • Maintain complete and timely clinical documentation using the NOCD EHR system
  • Participate in NOCD clinical consultation, training, and advance your knowledge and practice of evidence-supported treatments for OCD
  • Collaborate with our network of providers to help develop and reinforce treatment decisions

Requirements:

  • See credentialing information here.
  • Full Time Providers:
    • 40 hour work week
    • Complete 25 hours of direct clinical work per week
    • Attend a world-class training program developed by industry leaders.
    • Attend 2 hours of weekly group clinical consultation
    • Have 10 hours of weeknight/weekend availability after 5pm local time for Member Sessions
    • Will participate in and complete cross-license application process during Onboarding
    • Open and willing to treat children and adolescents after attending NOCD Child and Adolescent training
  • Practical experience independently diagnosing is required for this role (this practical experience can be during your pre-licensed experience).
    • If you do not have this direct practical experience, proof of completion (with certificate) of the following training will be accepted in its place: Tolin & Diamond Training Video.
    • Please note: submission of proof of completion does not guarantee hire, NOCD will not reimburse the cost of this course.

Who You Are

  • Full and unrestricted license in good standing to practice in your state.
    • Masters Degree Required
    • New Jersey: Licensed Psychologist, Licensed Professional Counselor, Licensed Marriage and Family Therapist, Licensed Clinical Social Worker
  • At least 6 months of relevant experience with evidence-based therapies (e.g., ERP, CBT, ACT)
  • Knowledge and experience with treating OCD with ERP is preferable but not required
  • Organized, quick and enthusiastic learner, excellent communicator, good with time management
  • Have a confidential, private location to work remotely from with reliable internet access
  • Comfortable and efficient with using technology to communicate
  • Ambitious and ready to keep up with a goal-driven, start-up environment

What We Offer

  • A commitment to clinical excellence, an exquisite Therapist experience and proven & visible clinical outcomes.
  • Gain world-class training from experienced OCD providers to become a specialized Therapist in treating OCD and related disorders through evidence-based care.
  • A full suite of support through continued mentorship & feedback
  • Investment in new technology built to improve the NOCD Therapist experience and allow our Therapists to continue to focus on Member care.
  • Centralized scheduling
  • An investment in your personal growth through a clear career path
  • Access to NOCD Professional Development Trainings and ongoing consultation with other team members
  • One-on-one mentorship to discuss complex cases
  • Ability to work remotely from the comfort of your own home or office
  • Competitive compensation with a robust bonus program
    • Base Salary Comp Range in New Jersey = $65,000 - $88,000
    • Bonus Program = $12,400 per year earned on average by those eligible
  • Comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision coverage, and 401(k) match for qualifying employees
  • Casual and engaging startup environment with an outstanding mission-driven team atmosphere
  • Generous PTO
  • NOCD provides 12 weeks of fully paid parental leave for the primary caregiver, and 6 weeks of fully paid leave for the secondary caregiver, for qualifying full-time employees.

NOCD is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. NOCD is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures.

Applicants have rights under Federal Employment Laws.Family and Medical Leave Act (FMLA);Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO);Employee Polygraph Protection Act (EPPA).

raw.description:
The company

Norbert is building autonomous robots that deliver healthcare.

Our AI sensing platform mounts on mobile robots and does the work of a care team member—rounding on patients, capturing vitals without contact (FDA-cleared for pulse and respiratory rate, more in the pipeline), running assessments, documenting to the EMR, and escalating when something's wrong. Autonomously.

We're not building demos. We're deployed in real facilities today, monitoring hundreds of patients daily. We're solving one of healthcare's hardest problems: a global nursing shortage that will hit 40% by 2030.

We're a small, international team backed by top-tier VCs, with offices in Brooklyn and Paris. We ship things that matter.

The position

We're looking for a Signal Processing Engineer to join our algorithm and development team, working on remote vital sign monitoring from video. You'll develop and validate algorithms that extract clinical-grade physiological signals (heart rate, blood pressure, respiration) from camera data, working closely with computer vision engineers in our algorithm team.

What You'll Do:

  • Design and implement signal processing algorithms for extracting vital signs from video-based sensors (rPPG, rBP)
  • Develop real-time filtering, denoising, and feature extraction methods to achieve clinical-grade accuracy
  • Build validation pipelines comparing our video-based measurements against clinical reference devices (ECG, PPG, BP monitors)
  • Help design studies that ensure millisecond-level synchronization between video streams and reference sensors for accurate ground truth
  • Integrate with the computer vision pipeline (C++) to leverage multi-modal signal enhancement techniques
  • Architect cloud-based QA and automated verification systems for reproducible algorithm validation
  • Prototype algorithms in Python and C++ before deploying them on our production system

What We're Looking For:

  • Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, or related field (or PhD)
  • Strong fundamentals in digital signal processing, statistical methods, and real-time systems
  • Deep expertise in physiological signal processing (Radar, PPG, ECG, respiration, blood pressure)
  • Experience processing low-frequency physiological signals with challenging SNR characteristics
  • Proficiency in both Python (prototyping) and C++ (production integration)
  • Experience with spectral analysis, adaptive filtering, and time-domain methods for real-time applications
  • Ability to work independently, solve complex problems, and drive projects to completion
  • 5+ years industry experience developing signal processing algorithms for medical or physiological sensing applications (or equivalent with PhD)

Bonus Points:

  • Experience with contact-based and contactless vital sign measurement technologies especially radar
  • Background working with medical-grade measurement devices and clinical reference standards
  • Experience with embedded signal processing (ARM, edge devices)
  • Knowledge of motion artifact removal and noise reduction in challenging environments
  • Familiarity with DevOps practices for reproducible research (experiment tracking, data versioning)
  • Background in medical devices, regulated environments, or clinical validation studie

What We Offer:

  • Real impact: your code provides care for patients today
  • High autonomy and technical ownership - you'll define our signal processing approach
  • Work at the intersection of cutting-edge AI, edge computing, and healthcare
  • A talented, excellent, diverse and international team
  • Talented, international team tackling meaningful problems in healthcare
  • Equity participation in the company's future
  • Cutting-edge stack: embedded AI, robotics, LLMs, multimodal sensing
  • Transparent, mission-driven culture focused on continuous learning
  • Competitive salary and equity

Who we are:

At Wagepoint, we're good people. It's easy to feel that way when you're surrounded by folks doing the best work of their careers, building great payroll software for small businesses across Canada.

Our team brings together diverse backgrounds, perspectives, experiences, and ideas to make payroll the easiest part of running a business.

We're remote-first, growing, and looking for passionate people who don't settle for the first solution or the way it's been done before. We care deeply about our customers and each other, and understand that when it comes to payroll, getting it right matters.

Our values guide how we work and what we expect from one another:

  • Cultivate Impactby focusing on what matters most and delivering meaningful outcomes for our customers.

  • Unify as One Teamby collaborating openly, communicating clearly, and rallying around shared goals.

  • Stay Curious and Kindby challenging assumptions, learning quickly, and leading with empathy.

If you want to build the future of payroll in a place where your ideas are welcomed and your contributions matter, look no further!

The role at high level:

We’re looking for a talented Onboarding Specialist who’s eager to help small businesses feel confident using payroll technology even if they’ve never touched it before. You’ll guide new clients through setup, ensure compliance, and set them up for long-term success with Wagepoint. You will report directly to our Onboarding Team Lead.

What you'll be expected to own:

  • Manage the end-to-end onboarding process for new Wagepoint clients, guiding them from account submission through to a successful first payroll run.

  • Ensure payroll accounts are configured accurately and in full compliance with Wagepoint policies and government requirements.

  • Deliver clear, effective training through calls, emails, and online sessions to help clients confidently navigate Wagepoint’s payroll platform.

  • Track, document, and resolve onboarding issues by collaborating with Sales, Risk, and Support teams to keep clients on track.

  • Maintain complete and accurate onboarding records, including setup instructions, support notes, and system configurations in internal tools.

  • Identify pain points and recurring issues in the onboarding journey and recommend improvements to streamline the process and enhance the client experience.

What you bring to the table:

  • 1+ year of experience processing Canadian payroll or supporting clients in payroll onboarding, support, or implementation.

  • Solid understanding of payroll compliance and taxation basics.

  • Willingness to learn and adapt as payroll legislation, internal processes, and product features change.

  • Strong communication skills with the ability to explain payroll concepts clearly.

  • Experience managing KYC/KYB and other compliance documentation.

  • High attention to detail and strong organizational skills.

  • Ability to investigate and resolve onboarding issues independently while knowing when to collaborate or escalate.

  • Comfortable working in a CRM-driven environment (e.g., HubSpot) to track onboarding progress, tasks, and client communication, along with tools like Google Workspace and video conferencing platforms.

  • Collaborative, self-directed, and adaptable in a fast-paced, remote environment.

Bonus points if:

  • You have your PCP designation or are working toward it.

  • You’re a member of the National Payroll Institute (NPI).

  • You’ve worked with payroll software or HR/payroll platforms.

  • You’re bilingual in French and English.

  • You’ve worked in a remote or distributed team environment.

What we bring to the table:

Impact:Dig in and directly contribute to Wagepoint’s growth and success.

Culture:Work alongside a team that genuinely enjoys solving problems together, celebrates wins, supports one another through challenges, and still finds time for the occasional terrible joke.

Growth:We believe learning is part of the job. We’re committed to helping you Get Better Every Day (a representation of our Stay Curious and Kind value!) by offering professional development, new experiences, and career growth as we continue to evolve.

Innovation:Curiosity and experimentation encouraged! Bring ideas, challenge assumptions, responsibly utilize AI, and help shape better ways of working.

Remote:Work from wherever you do your best work. Wagepoint has always been remote-first, giving you flexibility, autonomy, and hopefully a little extra time with the people (and pets) you love.

Ready to join the team? Apply now and help us continue making payroll the easiest part of running a business.

If this sounds like the right fit, we’d love to hear from you! No need for a formal cover letter, just send us your resume and if you’d like, a few lines about what excites you about the opportunity.

If we agree it's a great match, someone from our team will reach out to schedule a call.

In 2026, we were recognized as one of Canada's Best Workplaces for Mental Wellness and Inclusion. That commitment extends to our hiring process, where we strive to create an experience that is welcoming, respectful, and inclusive from day one.

We welcome applicants from all backgrounds, experiences, identities, and perspectives, and we're committed to building a workplace where everyone can thrive.

About Animalz

Animalz is a content marketing agency that partners with B2B SaaS companies, venture capital firms, and other tech organizations to drive long-term, sustainable growth through high-quality content.

Our fully remote team of experienced content marketers delivers strategies and content tailored to each customer's goals and context. We pride ourselves on our deep interest and understanding of software products and audiences, our commitment to thought leadership, and our relentless pursuit of mastering our craft.

Our customers include industry leaders like Amplitude, Ramp, and Wistia, as well as high-growth early-stage startups.

About the Role

We are looking for a freelance developmental editor to review B2B SaaS content written by our in-house and freelance writers. You’ll focus on long-form content, from SEO/AEO/GEO to thought leadership, though editors are occasionally called upon to review copy for LinkedIn, landing pages, or other formats.

Editors at Animalz play a key role in ensuring the work we deliver meets our internal bar for quality and helps our clients meet their business goals. You sit between writers and copyeditors, and while you should be able to edit prose at the line level, your primary focus is editing for substance. Does the piece of content you’re editing effectively execute the brief? Is it aligned with the client’s business goals and tailored for their audience? Is it structurally and logically sound?

To ensure each piece of content we deliver answers these questions, you’ll review content and provide writers with actionable feedback, from big-picture guidance down to inline edits. You’ll be dedicated to a specific pool of customers so you can get deeply familiar with their business and brand and provide feedback that takes into account their holistic strategy, not just each individual piece.

Requirements

  • Experience writing and editing diverse forms of content for B2B tech, especially long-form content (blog posts, ebooks, guides, etc.)
  • Working knowledge of SEO and AEO/GEO best practices. You don’t need to be an expert, but you should know the basics
  • Ability to deliver actionable feedback. You can communicate why changes should be made, balancing candor with respect
  • Ability to quickly get up to speed on new industries, companies, and products
  • Knowledge of and interest in the B2B tech industry and content marketing trends and best practices
  • Available 5-10 hours per week (schedule varies; you’ll be expected to deliver edits within 1 business day of receiving an assignment)

Nice to Have:

  • Experience working in-house at a B2B tech company
  • Experience developing and executing content strategies
  • Experience as a manager, mentor, or coach for writers (formal or informal)

Working Arrangements

Location: Fully remote (Americas or EMEA)

Employment type: Freelancer

Rate: $65/hour

Salary: $65/hour

About LearneoLearneo is a platform of builder-driven businesses, including Course Hero, CliffsNotes, LitCharts, Quillbot, Symbolab, and Scribbr, all united around a shared mission of supercharging productivity and learning for everyone. We attract and scale high growth businesses built and run by visionary entrepreneurs. Each team innovates independently but has a unique opportunity to collaborate, experiment, and grow together, and they are supported by centralized corporate operations functions, including HR, Finance and Legal.

Role Overview

In this role, you'll work directly with our CEO to help determine in whom, what, where, when, and why Learneo invests. You will research and recommend potential investments across categories, asset classes, and deal types. You'll do the deep research behind those decisions and turn it into a clear view on where our capital should go. We believe AI is reshaping most of the economy, and the biggest opportunities are still ahead. We have a close-up view of how fast it's moving and where it's headed, and we want someone who sees the same opportunity and wants to help us get there early.

This is a hands-on, individual-contributor role for someone with the ambition and work ethic to become a world-class investor. You'll drive the entire process, including recommending investment themes, creating market maps, deep dives, sourcing, analyzing, diligencing, and recommending specific investments. This role will have direct access to the CEO, minimal bureaucracy, and real influence over how our capital is allocated. It's a rare chance to help shape an investment strategy, not just execute one.

Here are some ways you'll make an impact!

  • Develop Learneo's perspective on where to invest: researching, sizing, and stress-testing potential investment themes across emerging categories, verticals, and asset classes
  • Run rigorous quantitative and qualitative market mapping and benchmarking exercises, forming a clear thesis on competitive dynamics, market structure, and where value is being created
  • Conduct deep-dive investigations into companies, business models, and competitive landscapes, going beyond surface-level research to surface non-obvious insights
  • Track market trends and industry signals across technology and adjacent sectors, helping Learneo stay ahead of shifts relevant to its strategic direction
  • Source and own outreach with target companies and founders, and build systems for tracking companies and knowing when to engage
  • Form and present recommendations to senior leadership in a clear, answer-first format that enables fast, confident decision-making
  • Help build Learneo's market intelligence function from the ground up, including building scorecard criteria and a repeatable evaluation process for investment and acquisition decisions

Are you our Senior Associate, Strategy & Market Intelligence?

  • 3+ years of experience in investment banking, venture capital, private equity, management consulting, hedge fund analysis, or an early-stage startup, backgrounds where forming and defending a view under pressure is the job
  • A genuine, intrinsic passion and curiosity for investing and how companies create value
  • Demonstrated ability to build a well-reasoned point of view on an unfamiliar market, from scoping the research question to delivering a clear, evidence-backed conclusion
  • Strong independent judgment; able to form a confident thesis from ambiguous or incomplete information, and defend it clearly when challenged
  • Gets up to speed quickly in new domains; intellectually curious and comfortable operating without a pre-existing framework or subject matter expertise
  • Advanced ability to translate quantitative and qualitative research into concise, actionable recommendations for senior audiences
  • Strong business, financial, and economic literacy; comfort reading cap tables, investor memos, and market data as primary sources

Bonus Points

  • A point of view on how AI is reshaping specific industries or business models
  • Experience conducting primary research (expert interviews, founder calls, customer discovery) alongside secondary research
  • Familiarity with deal flow, market mapping, or investment memo writing
  • Proficient in analytics or data tools (Pitchbook, CB Insights, or similar)
  • Founder experience, especially having sold a business into or worked at a serial acquirer platform

  • Competitive salary and annual bonus
  • Medical coverage, including full dental and vision
  • Retirement savings plans
  • Life and disability benefits
  • Vacation & leaves of absence

raw.excerpt: Join Cyntegrity, one of the leading clinical trial risk management technology providers in the industry.
raw.description:
Join Cyntegrity, one of the leading clinical trial risk management technology providers in the industry. We're proud of our bespoke and highly rated MyRBQM® Portal and MyRBQM® Academy brands. If you want to join a rapidly expanding organization, have a growth mindset, and are looking for an exciting, dynamic, and pioneering position in the healthcare industry, this is a great opportunity for you.

We are looking for a Technical Data Engineering Manager to join our R&D team.

This is a technically driven role at the intersection of data engineering, clinical study delivery, and customer requirements. You will play a key role in translating business and study needs into clear technical requirements, supporting Data Engineers in delivering high-quality data workflows, troubleshooting complex data issues, and contributing to scalable data solutions across our products and clinical studies.

You will work closely with Data Engineering, Project Management, Science, Product, and R&D teams, while also participating in customer discussions and helping bridge the gap between business requirements and technical implementation.

Key Responsibilities

As a Technical Data Engineering Manager at Cyntegrity, you will:

  • Translate Requirements: Turn customer and study requirements into clear technical tasks, specifications, and acceptance criteria for Data Engineering and R&D teams.
  • Drive Data Delivery: Oversee the creation, transformation, mapping, and validation of datasets across clinical studies and platform components.
  • Support Technical Solutions: Review data flows, mapping logic, database queries, data quality, and performance, and help troubleshoot complex data issues.
  • Coordinate Across Teams: Act as a technical bridge between customers, Project Management, Data Engineering, Science, Product, and R&D.
  • Improve Data Workflows: Contribute to scalable data architecture, reusable components, validation approaches, and technical best practices.
  • Guide the Team: Support onboarding and capability development of Data Engineers, provide technical guidance, and help establish clear goals and ways of working.
  • Manage Risks & Delivery: Track technical progress, risks, dependencies, and blockers and ensure timely escalation where needed.

Education

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, or another relevant technical field.
  • Additional training or experience in data management or clinical research is a plus.

Experience

  • 2+ years of relevant professional experience in data engineering, data management, software/data development, or a related technical field.
  • Strong experience working with data pipelines, data transformation, integration, mapping, and data-quality processes.
  • Experience translating business or customer requirements into technical solutions and developer-ready tasks.
  • Experience working cross-functionally with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Experience coordinating or technically guiding engineers or other technical specialists.
  • Experience working directly with customers or external stakeholders is highly valued.

Skills & Knowledge

  • Strong working knowledge of SQL and NoSQL databases.
  • Good understanding of ETL/data-processing pipelines, data mapping, validation, and performance optimization.
  • Experience with data formats such as CSV, XML, JSON, SAS, and ideally clinical data standards such as CDISC.
  • Understanding of common data integration methods, including APIs, SFTP, Azure Storage, and AWS S3.
  • Scripting experience with Python, Node.js, C#, or similar is an advantage.
  • Good analytical and problem-solving skills, with an understanding of data-processing complexity and scalability.
  • Basic understanding of statistics and their application in medical research.
  • Experience with LLMs and prompt engineering.
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to clearly document requirements, decisions, and technical discussions.

Nice to Have

  • Knowledge of clinical trials, RBQM, GCP, ICH E6/E8, and 21 CFR Part 11.
  • Experience with SaaS products or data-intensive software platforms.
  • Product management or Business Analysis experience, including requirements elicitation, user stories, functional specifications, and acceptance criteria.
  • Experience collaborating closely with engineering teams throughout product or study development.
  • Knowledge of Microsoft Azure, AWS, DevOps, or cloud-based data architectures.
  • Experience using AI/LLM tools to support data engineering, requirements analysis, or technical workflows.

What We Offer

  • A purpose-driven mission to improve global clinical research.
  • A collaborative, international team that values flexibility, autonomy, and transparency.
  • Fully remote work setup with a results-driven culture.
  • The opportunity to work at the intersection of data engineering, clinical research, SaaS technology, and AI.
  • Opportunities for professional growth and development.

About Cyntegrity

We support sponsors and CROs with clinical trial risk management technology and related educational programs to bring therapies to market faster, safer, and more cost-effectively. Cyntegrity is a fast-growing scale-up company powered by a diverse, international team of industry experts.

Our aim is to be the leading provider of specialized cloud and SaaS solutions for ICH GCP E6(R3)-compliant risk-based quality management and clinical research. Learn more about us and our MyRBQM® Portal and MyRBQM® Academy brands at Cyntegrity.

If this position interests you and you would like to learn more, please submit your application. We would be particularly interested to hear about your experience in data engineering, translating business requirements into technical solutions, and working with complex data environments.

raw.description:
We're so happy you're here! Thank you for checking our job out and we hope to have the chance to meet you in our interview process!

About the role

Our supply chain team has built something solid. We're looking for a Director of Supply Chain to take it over and take it further: leveling up how we negotiate with suppliers, building out demand planning and a real S&OP cadence, taking ownership of our logistics network end to end, and growing a small team as the work scales. You'll inherit something that runs, and you'll have the room to make it even better. This role reports directly into our VP of Operations.

This role is part of our remote HQ! We have a fully remote, high-trust work environment - and also come together on a biannual basis for amazing off-sites where we can connect IRL.

In this role, you will:

  • Own the monthly supply plan across our network of contract manufacturers and pack-out partners, working from demand down to purchase orders
  • Take over supplier relationships directly and build a negotiation program on top of them: pricing tiers, capacity commitments, and quarterly business reviews backed by scorecards on delivery, yield, quality, and cost
  • Publish and own our fully burdened cost per unit, partner with Finance to track it, and find the levers to bring it down through smarter allocation and procurement
  • Build and run demand planning and a monthly S&OP cycle that gets Finance, Marketing, and Retail committed to one number
  • Design and de-risk our logistics and 3PL network, including routing and freight decisions that affect landed cost
  • Manage and develop your team, staying hands-on in the model while building the leadership the function needs as scope grows
  • Move our planning process off spreadsheets and onto a system built for it

We're looking for someone who:

  • Has 8-12 years in CPG supply chain, with at least 3 years owning a function or a major end to end scope
  • Has run an asset-light contract manufacturing network: allocating volume across multiple co-manufacturers or co-packers, working within MOQs and capacity ceilings, and managing long lead times
  • Has a strong track record negotiating supplier agreements directly
  • Has owned a cost-per-unit or COGS number and can tell us the baseline, what they did, and the result
  • Has built a supply plan themselves in a model: net requirements, safety stock, on-hand, and open POs
  • Has run or stood up an S&OP process and gotten cross-functional teams to commit to a number, including an unpopular one

Approach to the role:

  • You see a working system as a foundation, not a finish line, and you're excited to build on top of it rather than around it
  • You stay in the model yourself and bring recommendations, not just data
  • You're decisive with incomplete information. You make the call, name the assumption you're carrying, and say what would change your mind
  • You're commercially aggressive and relationally durable: you push hard on price and still get the call answered when you need a favor six months later
  • You communicate with brevity. Whether it's Finance, the CEO, or a cross-functional partner, they get what they need and nothing extra.
  • You move with urgency and low ego, and you don't need a lot of infrastructure to get going

Compensation & Benefits:

At Grüns, we're committed to providing a competitive total compensation package — grounded in market data that considers our size, stage, industry, and location. For this role, the base salary range is $180,000-$200,000 plus incentive compensationdepending on experience, paired with a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the well-being and growth of our team.

A bit about us...

At Grüns, we believe that foundational nutrition should be simple and convenient for everyone. We're dedicated to bringing comprehensive and real nutrition to you through our gummies, formulated from 60 nutrient-dense and whole-food ingredients. Simply enjoy a grab-and-go snack pack of gummies daily whenever fits best in your schedule and wherever life takes you.

Like you, we were disappointed. There’s an infinite number of “nutrition” companies, all focused on what’s best for them — not what’s best for you. Hundreds of products to sell you on, low-quality ingredients, and small nutrient doses. We’ve seen it all.

So we decided it was time to fix it. No more choking on and popping pills like a pharmacy. No more clean-up and disgust from gross powders. And no more cobbling together handfuls to dozens of supplements. Grüns is comprehensive nutrition, made convenient and delicious.

What we care about...

Be the Best: We hold ourselves, our teams, and our partners to an incredibly high standard - and we raise the bar constantly. "We've never done this before" isn't an excuse here. It's an invitation.

Own It: We act like our name is on the door. That means taking complete ownership of outcomes, collaborating deeply, working through roadblocks - not around them - and never waiting for someone else to solve the problem. Great owners are great partners.

Drive Impact, Urgently: We measure impact, not effort. We work smart and hard, move fast, and use every tool at our disposal - including AI - to focus our energy where it matters most.

Compensation & Perks:

For every role, we aim to have highly competitive compensation and opportunity for impact and career growth.

Everyone at Grüns works hard, but we believe in wellness and balance too. We have super strong benefits coverage -- for you and your family, generous PTO, free Grüns, and a few more perks centered around health and well-being that we can't wait to tell you about!

Our teams collaborate across marketing, IT, analytics, and media buying to build, test, and optimize high-performing funnels that help clients achieve predictable growth across industries such as Home Improvement, Health, Legal, and Insurance.

We’re looking for a Creative MarketingProducer who thinks like a researcher - someone who senses trends, understands storytelling, and knows how to turn marketing insights into videos that actually sell.

Your role is not only production, but to lead creative evolution - generating ideas, refining proven creative approaches, finding new styles, testing them, and scaling what works. You’ll work at the intersection of project management, creative, analytics, and production.

You’ll also shape and pitch creative concepts that challenge existing ad formats and explore new storytelling angles.

Responsibilities:

  • Monitor and document emerging video trends across Meta, TikTok, YouTube, and other platforms.
  • Market and Content development Research
  • Research new video styles, not just iterate on existing ones.
  • Translate insights into creative hypotheses.
  • Project management, supporting various teams from idea to delivery
  • Ensure each concept accurately reflects the client’s value proposition and target audience.
  • Coordinate creators, influencers, and bloggers.
  • Develop and manage test plans with media buyers to validate creative hypotheses.
  • Review performance data (CTR, hook rate, watch time, CPA).
  • Understand a consistent “create → test → learn → scale” workflow for ongoing creative optimization.
  • Communicating effectively between marketing, creation and testing departments.

AI & Experimentation Mindset:

You know how to experiment with AI tools - from generating references in Midjourney to using Claude to organise your workspace. We don’t expect you to know every tool, but we value a “prompt-first” mindset - when you create faster than you search.

Requirements

Essential

  • 3+ years of experience in marketing - ideally within paid social or performance marketing.
  • Solid understanding of short-form video formats and what drives performance on Meta, TikTok, and YouTube.
  • Comfortable collaborating with creators and bloggers: sourcing, briefing, and overseeing remote shoots.
  • Confident in interpreting marketing performance data.
  • Exceptional communication and organization skills - able to keep projects on track, people aligned, and expectations clear.
  • Strong attention to detail, accountability, and the ability to prioritize multiple projects effectively.
  • Fluent English - both spoken and written

Nice to Have

Why do we deserve your attention?

Not only do we offer fair and competitive pay, but we also provide perks and benefits that support your well-being and growth. Here are some of them:

Remote Work

We are a truly remote-first company. You choose where you feel the most productive and comfortable to make an impact.

Paid Time Off

Work-life balance matters to us, and we support it with paid time off for rest, personal time, or simply doing what makes you happy.

Ongoing Learning

We believe in curiosity and growth. That’s why we support continuous learning with workshops, online courses, conferences, and certifications.

Home Office

We help you set up your perfect workspace by covering equipment and furniture expenses, so you can do your best work from home.

Physical Well-Being

From gym memberships and yoga classes to home workout equipment or even a bicycle, we give you the flexibility to stay active your way.

Unlimited Sick Days

Your health matters. Take the time you need to rest and recover - we’ll be here when you’re ready to return.

Medical Coverage

We support you and your family with reimbursement for medical insurance and health-related expenses, including dental care and psychological support.

Co-Working Space

If you sometimes crave a change of scenery or more social interaction, we’ll cover the full cost of a co-working space.

Fun Stuff

From gaming nights and fitness challenges to annual retreats at world-class resorts, we make sure there’s never a shortage of fun and connection.
